**Question**

$\ldots \times 40 = 280$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\ldots \times 40 = 280$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing  number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 40 &= 280 \\\\
a           &= \dfrac{280}{40} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac{7 \times 40}{40} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac{7 \times \cancel{40}}{\cancel{40}} \\\\
a           &= 7 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
200 \times a     &= 160 \\\\

a                 &= \dfrac { \cancel{40} \times 4} { \cancel{40} \times 5} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {4} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $14$ boys in year $4$.

Given that $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the year are boys, how many are girls?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $14$ boys in year $4$.
<emptyline>
Given that $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the year are boys, how many are girls?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of students in year $4 = a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{2}{5} \times a                          &= 14  \\\\
\dfrac{2 \times a}{5}                          &= 14  \\\\
a                                              &= \dfrac{14 \times 5}{2} \\\\
                                               &= \dfrac{7 \times 2 \times 5}{2} \\\\
                                               &= \dfrac{7 \times \cancel{2} \times 5}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
                                               &= 7 \times 5 \\\\
                                               &= 35
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total children}   &= 35 \\\\
\text{Total girls}      &= \text{Total children} - \text{Total boys} \\\\      
                        &= 35 - 14  \\\\
                        &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I am thinking of a number.

If I add $5$ to it and then divide by $2$, I get $6$. 

What number am I thinking of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am thinking of a number.
<emptyline>
If I add $5$ to it and then divide by $2$, I get $6$. 
<emptyline>
What number am I thinking of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a + 5} { 2}    &= 6 \\\\
a + 5                  &= 6 \times 2 \\\\
a + 5                  &= 12 \\\\
a                      &= 12 - 5 \\\\
a                      &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

The number I am thinking of $= 7$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Solve the following equation to find $x$.

$5x - 7 = 43$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

x              &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Gino is thinking of a number. 

If he

- halves it,
- then adds $5$ to it
- and then squares it and gets $121$.

Circle the number that Gino was thinking of.

$12 \quad 17 \quad 32$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Gino is thinking of a number. 
<emptyline>
If he
<emptyline>
- halves it,
- then adds $5$ to it
- and then squares it and gets $121$.
<emptyline>
Circle the number that Gino was thinking of.
<emptyline>
$12 \quad 17 \quad 32$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number Gino thought of $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\bigg(\dfrac{a}{2} + 5 \bigg)^2     &= 121 \\\\
\dfrac{a}{2} + 5                    &= \sqrt{121} \\\\
\dfrac{a}{2} + 5                    &= 11 \\\\
\dfrac{a}{2}                        &= 11 - 5 \\\\
a                                   &= 2 \times (11 - 5) \\\\
a                                   &= 2 \times 6 \\\\
a                                   &= 12 
\end{aligned}
$

The number that Gino thought of $= 12$.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$12$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The entry prices for a group are

|                  | Price                 |
|:-----------:     |:---------------------:|
|   Adults         |   $\pounds 5.00$ each |
|   Children       |   $\pounds 3.00$ each |
 
A group of adults and children goes to the theme park for a cost of $\pounds 44$.

There are $4$ adults in the group.
How many children are in the group? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The entry prices for a group are
<emptyline>
|                  | Price                 |
|:-----------:     |:---------------------:|
|   Adults         |   $\pounds 5.00$ each |
|   Children       |   $\pounds 3.00$ each |
<emptyline>
A group of adults and children goes to the theme park for a cost of $\pounds 44$.
<emptyline>
There are $4$ adults in the group.
How many children are in the group? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of children $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 5 + c \times 3       &= 44 \\\\
20 + 3c                       &= 44 \\\\
3c                            &= 44 - 20 \\\\
3c                            &= 24 \\\\
c                             &= \dfrac {24} {3} \\\\
c                             &= \dfrac {3 \times 8} {3} \\\\
c                             &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 8} {\cancel 3} \\\\
c                             &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Number of children $= 8$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The total weight of one large and three small cans of Best Beans is $1.25 \ \text{kg}$. 
The large can weighs $425 \ \text{grams}$.

![papers/aldenham-school/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q08-i00.png](/assets/papers/aldenham-school/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q08-i00.png "papers/aldenham-school/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q08-i00.png")
![papers/aldenham-school/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q08-i01.png](/assets/papers/aldenham-school/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q08-i01.png "papers/aldenham-school/sample/sample-paper-2/s01-q08-i01.png")

Work out the weight of one small can.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The total weight of one large and three small cans of Best Beans is $1.25 \ \text{kg}$. 
The large can weighs $425 \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
%image%
%image%
<emptyline>
Work out the weight of one small can.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of a small can (in $\text{grams}$) $= w$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total weight} &= 1.25 \ \text{kg}\\\\
                    &= 1.25 \times 1000 \ \text{grams} \\\\
                    &= 1250 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
425 + 3w              &= 1250  \\\\
3w                    &= 1250 - 425  \\\\
3w                    &= 825  \\\\
w                     &= \dfrac{825}{3}  \\\\
w                     &= \dfrac{275 \times 3} {3}  \\\\
w                     &= \dfrac{275 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3}  \\\\
w                     &= 275 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of a small can $= 275 \ \text{grams}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$275 \ \text{grams}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $24$ pupils in $7\text{S}$.

Two thirds of them are boys.

Half of the boys have brown hair.

How many of pupils in $7\text{S}$ are boys with brown hair?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $24$ pupils in $7\text{S}$.
<emptyline>
Two thirds of them are boys.
<emptyline>
Half of the boys have brown hair.
<emptyline>
How many of pupils in $7\text{S}$ are boys with brown hair?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of boys $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boys}      &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 24 \\\\
a                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 24} {3} \\\\
a                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 8 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 8 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                          &= 2 \times 8 \\\\
a                          &= 16
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Boys with brown hair}       &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times a\\\\
                                  &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 16 \\\\
                                  &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $2$ apples and $1$ banana cost $\pounds 1.20$ 

and

$1$ apple and $2$ bananas cost $\pounds 1.35$, find the cost of an apple and a banana separately.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $2$ apples and $1$ banana cost $\pounds 1.20$ 
<emptyline>
and
<emptyline>
$1$ apple and $2$ bananas cost $\pounds 1.35$, find the cost of an apple and a banana separately.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of an apple $= a$

Let the cost of a banana $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
2a + b &=  1.20 \\\\
a + 2b &= 1.35
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply the second equation by $2$.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2 \times a + 2 \times 2b     &= 2 \times 1.35 \\\\
2a + 4b                      &= 2.70
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the first equation from the second to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2a + 4b - (2a + b)     &= 2.70 - 1.20 \\\\
2a + 4b -2a  -b        &= 1.50 \\\\
3b                     &= 1.50 \\\\
b                      &= \dfrac {1.50} {3} \\\\
b                      &= \pounds 0.50
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a banana $= \pounds 0.50$

Let's substitute the value of $b$ in one of the initial equations to find the cost of an apple.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2a + b     &=  1.20 \\\\
2a + 50    &=  1.20 \\\\
2a         &=  1.20 - 0.50 \\\\
2a         &=  0.70 \\\\
a          &= \dfrac {0.70} {2} \\\\
a          &= \pounds 0.35
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of an apple $= \pounds 0.35$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Cost of an apple $= \pounds 0.35$

Cost of a banana $= \pounds 0.50$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

I am thinking of a number.

If I add $6$ then double it I get $46$.

What number am I thinking of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 6) \times 2            &= 46 \\\\
a + 6                       &= \dfrac {46} {2} \\\\
a + 6                       &= \dfrac {23 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a + 6                       &= \dfrac {23 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a + 6                       &= 23 \\\\
a                           &= 23 - 6 \\\\
a                           &= 17
\end{aligned}
$

The number I am thinking of $= 17$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$17$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

x           &= \dfrac {9 \times 6} {9} \\\\
x           &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 6} {\cancel 9} \\\\
x           &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Emilie is thinking of a number. If she

-  adds $2$ to it,
-  then squares it
-  and then subtracts $4$ she gets $60$.

Circle the number that Emilie was thinking of.

$4 \quad 6 \quad 30$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Emilie is thinking of a number. If she
<emptyline>
-  adds $2$ to it,
-  then squares it
-  and then subtracts $4$ she gets $60$.
<emptyline>
Circle the number that Emilie was thinking of.
<emptyline>
$4 \quad 6 \quad 30$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number Emilie thought of $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 2 ) ^ {2} - 4     &= 60 \\\\
(a + 2 ) ^ {2}         &= 60 + 4 \\\\
(a + 2 ) ^ {2}         &= 64 \\\\
a + 2                  &= \sqrt {64} \\\\
a + 2                  &= 8 \\\\
a                      &= 8 - 2 \\\\
a                      &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

Number that Emilie thought is $= 6$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

$\dfrac{}{18} + \dfrac{1}{18} = \dfrac{1}{2}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac{}{18} + \dfrac{1}{18} = \dfrac{1}{2}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {18} + \dfrac {1} {18}     &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {18} + \dfrac {1} {18}     &= \dfrac {1 \times 9} {2 \times 9} \\\\
\dfrac {a + 1} {18}                   &= \dfrac {9} {18} \\\\
a + 1                                 &= 9 \\\\
a                                     &= 9 - 1 \\\\
a                                     &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Solve the following equation to find $b$.

$2b - 25 = 41$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Solve the following equation to find $b$.
<emptyline>
$2b - 25 = 41$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2b - 25     &= 41 \\\\
2b          &= 41 + 25 \\\\
2b          &= 66 \\\\
b           &= \dfrac {66} {2} \\\\
b           &= \dfrac {33 \times 2} {2} \\\\
b           &= \dfrac {33 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
b           &= 33
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$33$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Given that two teas and a coffee cost $ \pounds 2.50$ and one tea and three coffees cost $ \pounds 3.50$. 

How much does a single coffee cost?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Given that two teas and a coffee cost $ \pounds 2.50$ and one tea and three coffees cost $ \pounds 3.50$. 
<emptyline>
How much does a single coffee cost?
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a cup of tea $= t$

Let the cost of a cup of coffee $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
2t + c &= 2.50 \\\\
t + 3c &= 3.50
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply the second equation by $2$.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2 \times t + 2 \times 3c &= 2 \times 3.50 \\\\
2t + 6c &= 7.00
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the first equation from the second to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned} 
(2t + 6c) - (2t + c) &= 7.00 - 2.50 \\\\
2t + 6c - 2t - c &= 4.50 \\\\
5c &= 4.50 \\\\
c &= \dfrac {4.50} {5} \\\\
c &= \pounds 0.90
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a cup of coffee $= \pounds 0.90$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 0.90$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The **perimeter** of a regular hexagon is $42a + 18$.
Write an expression for the lengths of one of its sides.

![papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/2019/sample-paper-1/s02-q18-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/2019/sample-paper-1/s02-q18-s01-i00.png "papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/2019/sample-paper-1/s02-q18-s01-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The **perimeter** of a regular hexagon is $42a + 18$.
Write an expression for the lengths of one of its sides.
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of one side}   &= \dfrac {\text{Perimeter}} {\text{Number of sides}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {42a + 18} {6} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {6 \times 7a + 6 \times 3} {6} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {6 \times (7a + 3)} {6} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times (7a + 3)} {\cancel 6} \\\\
                            &= 7a + 3
\end{aligned}
$

Length of one side $= 7a + 3$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7a + 3$

</div>

**Question**

The **perimeter** of a different regular polygon is $75b - 20$.
The length of one of its sides is $15b - 4$.
How many sides does the regular polygon have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The **perimeter** of a different regular polygon is $75b - 20$.
The length of one of its sides is $15b - 4$.
How many sides does the regular polygon have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of sides}   &= \dfrac {\text{Perimeter}} {\text{Length of one side}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {75b - 20} {15b - 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 15b - 5 \times 4} {15b - 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times (15b - 4)} {15b - 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel {(15b - 4)}} {\cancel {15b - 4}} \\\\
                            &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Number of sides $= 5$.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number in this number sentence? 

$3.6 \times {?} = 1.8 \times 7$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the missing number in this number sentence? 
<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3.6 \times a                 &= 1.8 \times 7  \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {1.8 \times 7} {3.6}  \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {18 \times 7 \times 10} {36 \times 10} \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {18 \times 7 \times 10} {18 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {18} \times 7 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {18} \times 2 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {7} {2} \\\\
a                            &= 3.5
\end{aligned}
$

The missing number $= 3.5$
</div>

Put a ring round the correct equation.

- $y = 2x$
- $y = 2 + x$
- $y = x^2$
- $y = \dfrac{x}{2}$

- $y = \dfrac{x}{2}$

|:--------------------:|:-------------------------:|:-----------------------:|:------------:|

| $y = \dfrac {x} {2}$ | $y = \dfrac {-4} {2} = -2$| $y = \dfrac {4} {2} = 2$|     No       |

$y = x ^ 2$ gives the same value of $y$ for both $x = 4$ and $x = -4$.

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bags $A$ and $B$ contain some counters.

![papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s03-q10-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s03-q10-s01-i00.png "papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s03-q10-s01-i00.png")

Bag A: $6y + 1$ counters

Bag B: $4y + 7$ counters

The number of counters in each bag is the same.

Work out the value of $y$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bags $A$ and $B$ contain some counters.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Bag A: $6y + 1$ counters
<emptyline>
Bag B: $4y + 7$ counters
<emptyline>
The number of counters in each bag is the same.
<emptyline>
Work out the value of $y$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6y + 1                                  &= 4y + 7 \\\\
6y - 4y                                 &= 7 - 1 \\\\
2y                                      &= 6 \\\\
y                                       &= \dfrac {6} {2} \\\\
y                                       &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
y                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3} {\cancel 2} \\\\
y                                       &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bag $C$ contains more counters than bag $D$.

![papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s03-q10-s02-i00.png](/assets/papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s03-q10-s02-i00.png "papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s03-q10-s02-i00.png")

Bag C: $4k$ counters

Bag D: $k + 12$ counters

What is the smallest possible value of $k$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bag $C$ contains more counters than bag $D$.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Bag C: $4k$ counters
<emptyline>
Bag D: $k + 12$ counters
<emptyline>
What is the smallest possible value of $k$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4k                                  &> k + 12 \\\\
4k - k                              &> 12 \\\\
3k                                  &> 12 \\\\
k                                   &> \dfrac {12} {3} \\\\
k                                   &> \dfrac {3 \times 4} {3} \\\\
k                                   &> \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
k                                   &> 4
\end{aligned}
$

Smallest possible value of $k = 5$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$4k > k + 12$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out the value of $k$ which satisfies the condition above.

| $k$ | Bag $C$ | Bag $D$ |  Bag $C$ > Bag $D$  |
|:-:|:-----------------:|:-----------------:|:---------------:|
|$1$| $4k = 4 \times 1 = 4$  |   $k + 12 = 1 + 12 = 13$   |       No        |
|$2$| $4k = 4 \times 2 = 8$  |   $k + 12 = 2 + 12 = 14$   |       No        |
|$3$| $4k = 4 \times 3 = 12$ |   $k + 12 = 3 + 12 = 15$   |       No        |
|$4$| $4k = 4 \times 4 = 16$ |   $k + 12 = 4 + 12 = 16$   |       No        |
|$5$| $4k = 4 \times 5 = 20$ |   $k + 12 = 5 + 12 = 17$   |       Yes       |

Smallest possible value of k $= 5$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I buy a pen and a pencil for $\pounds 1.10$. The pen costs $50 \ \text{p}$ more than the pencil. How much is the pen?

-  $50 \ \text{p}$        
-  $60 \ \text{p}$        
-  $70 \ \text{p}$        
-  $80 \ \text{p}$        
-  $90 \ \text{p}$       

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I buy a pen and a pencil for $\pounds 1.10$. The pen costs $50 \ \text{p}$ more than the pencil. How much is the pen?
<emptyline>
-  $50 \ \text{p}$        
-  $60 \ \text{p}$        
-  $70 \ \text{p}$        
-  $80 \ \text{p}$        
-  $90 \ \text{p}$       
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the price of pencil (in pence) $= a$ 

Price of pen (in pence) $= a + 50$ 

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + a + 50)            &= 1.1 \times 100 \\\\
2a + 50                 &= 110 \\\\
2a                      &= 110 - 50 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {60} {2} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {30 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                       &= 30 \ \text{p}  \\\\
\text {Price of pen}    &= 50 + a \\\\
                        &= 50 + 30 \\\\
                        &= 80 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>D</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$80 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 0.75 \div {\dfrac {3} {4}} \\\\
&= 0.75 \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {75} {100} \times \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {75 \times 4} {100 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 25 \times 4} {4 \times 25 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{25} \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4} \times \cancel{25} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two numbers have a difference of $3$ and a sum of $27$. What are the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two numbers have a difference of $3$ and a sum of $27$. What are the two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Second number $= a + 3$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (a + 3)                 &= 27 \\\\
2a + 3                      &= 27 \\\\
2a                          &= 27 - 3 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {24} {2} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {2 \times 12} {2} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 12} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                           &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{First number} &= 12 \\\\
\text{Second number} &= 12 + 3 \\\\
                         &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12, 15$

**Question**

Start with the number $20$, then multiply by $4$, then add $16$, 
then divide by $12$, then find three-quarters of your answer. 

What number do you get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Start with the number $20$, then multiply by $4$, then add $16$, 
then divide by $12$, then find three-quarters of your answer. 
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number}  &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times  ((20 \times 4 + 16) \div 12) \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times  \dfrac {96} {12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 96}{4 \times 12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times 4 \times 2} {4 \times 12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {12} \times \cancel 4 \times 2} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel {12}} \\\\
                        &= 3 \times 2 \\\\
                        &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

*ABBR: TODO:: Find the right katex symbol.*

On the cards below, each club $\spadesuit$ has the same value and 
each spade $\spadesuit$ has the same value (but a different value to each club).

The number on each card is the total value of the symbols on that card. 

Find the value of one club.

![papers/bancrofts-school/2013/sample-paper-1/s01-q26-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/bancrofts-school/2013/sample-paper-1/s01-q26-s01-i00.png "papers/bancrofts-school/2013/sample-paper-1/s01-q26-s01-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">rtq_abbr_working_katex_show_correct_symbol
On the cards below, each club $\spadesuit$ has the same value and 
each spade $\spadesuit$ has the same value (but a different value to each club).
<emptyline>
The number on each card is the total value of the symbols on that card. 
<emptyline>
Find the value of one club.
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the value of spade $= s$

Value of club $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2c + 2s             &= 20 \\\\
2c + 3s             &= 27
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable.

Subtract the first equation from the second to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
2c + 3s - (2c + 2s)                 &= 27 - 20 \\\\
2c + 3s - 2c - 2s                   &= 7 \\\\
s                                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $s$ in the first equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
2c + 2s          &= 20 \\\\
2c + 2 \times 7  &= 20 \\\\
2c + 14          &= 20 \\\\
2c               &= 20 - 14 \\\\
2c               &= 6 \\\\
c                &= \dfrac {6} {2} \\\\
c                &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Value of club $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

*Use* the fact that $17 \times 18 \times 19 = 5814$

to work out the value of $34 \times 36 \times 38$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">*Use* the fact that $17 \times 18 \times 19 = 5814$
<emptyline>
to work out the value of $34 \times 36 \times 38$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 34 \times 36 \times 38 \\\\
&= 17 \times 2 \times 18 \times 2 \times 19 \times 2 \\\\
&= 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 17 \times 18 \times 19 \\\\
&= 8 \times 5814 \\\\
&= 46512
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Seven *consecutive* whole numbers add up to $7357$.  What is the largest of the seven numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Seven *consecutive* whole numbers add up to $7357$.  What is the largest of the seven numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the seven consecutive whole numbers $= a, a+1, a+2, a+3, a+4, a+5, a+6$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + a + 1 + a + 2 + a + 3 + a + 4 + a + 5 + a + 6   &= 7357 \\\\
7a + 21                                             &= 7357 \\\\
7a                                                  &= 7357 - 21 \\\\
7a                                                  &= 7336 \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac {7336} {7} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac {7 \times 1048} {7} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 1048} {\cancel 7} \\\\
a                                                   &= 1048
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{The largest whole number}     &= 1048 + 6 \\\\
                                    &= 1054
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$1054$

**Question**

When three *consecutive* whole numbers are multiplied together, the answer is $990$. What are the three numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When three *consecutive* whole numbers are multiplied together, the answer is $990$. What are the three numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the three consecutive whole numbers $= a, a + 1, a+2$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times (a + 1) \times (a + 2)         &= 990
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. 

| $a$ | Product $(a)(a+1)(a+2)$       | Equals $990$? |
|:-------------:|:------------------------------:|:--------------:|
| $a = 8$           | $8 \times 9 \times 10 = 720$   | No             |
| $a = 9$           | $9 \times 10 \times 11 = 990$  | Yes          |
| $a = 10$          | $10 \times 11 \times 12 = 1320$| No             |

Numbers $= 9, 10, 11$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9, 10, 11$

</div>
</div>

a                               &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Missing number $= 4$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$40 \%$ of the children on a school trip are boys and there are $72$ girls. How many children are on the trip?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$40 \%$ of the children on a school trip are boys and there are $72$ girls. How many children are on the trip?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of children $= a$

If $40 \%$ of the children are boys, then the girls are $100 - 40 = 60 \%$.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
60 \%  \text{ of }  a         &= 72 \\\\
\dfrac {60} {100} \times a          &= 72 \\\\
a                                   &= 72 \times \dfrac {100} {60} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {72 \times 100} {60} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {12 \times 6 \times 100} {6 \times 10} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel 6 \times 10 \cancel 0} {\cancel 6 \times 1 \cancel 0} \\\\
a                                   &= 12 \times 10 \\\\
a                                   &= 120
\end{aligned}
$

Number of children $= 120$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$120$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many people chose water?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many people chose water?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{People who choose water}    &= 20 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 20 - 7 - 30 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \\\\
                                            &= 20 - \dfrac {20} {4} - 7 - \dfrac {30} {100} \times 20 \\\\
                                            &= 20 - \dfrac {4 \times 5} {4} - 7 - \dfrac {30 \times 20} {100} \\\\
                                            &= 20 - \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 5} {\cancel 4} - 7 -  \dfrac {3 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 20 - 5 - 7 - 6 \\\\
                                            &= 2
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The difference between $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of a certain number and $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the same number is $3$. 

What is the number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The difference between $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of a certain number and $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the same number is $3$. 
<emptyline>
What is the number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {3} \times a - \dfrac {1} {4} \times a                       &= 3 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {3} - \dfrac {a} {4}                                         &= 3 \\\\
\dfrac {a \times 4} {3 \times 4} - \dfrac {a \times 3} {4 \times 3}     &= 3 \\\\
\dfrac {4a} {12} - \dfrac {3a} {12}                                     &= 3 \\\\
\dfrac {4a - 3a} {12}                                                   &= 3 \\\\
4a - 3a                                                                 &= 3 \times 12 \\\\
a                                                                       &= 36
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 36$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$36$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$383$ and $6226$ are examples of palindromic numbers as they read the 
same when the order of their digits is reversed. 

Write down the largest five-digit palindromic number that is a multiple of $5$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$383$ and $6226$ are examples of palindromic numbers as they read the 
same when the order of their digits is reversed. 
<emptyline>
Write down the largest five-digit palindromic number that is a multiple of $5$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question, the number is a five-digit palindromic number.

Unit place digit of multiple of $5$ can be $= 0$ or $5$. The first digit of five-digit number cannot be $0$ and so the digit at unit place $= 5$.

To get the largest such number, lets make the middle digits as large as possible.

So the number is $5 \ 9 \ 9 \ 9 \ 5$, which is $59995$.

Answer $ = 59995$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$59995$

</div>
</div>

<emptyline>

<emptyline>
Answer $ = 59995$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The order of the digits is reversed in a certain two-digit whole number. 

This gives a new whole number which is one less than half of the original number. What is the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The order of the digits is reversed in a certain two-digit whole number. 
<emptyline>
This gives a new whole number which is one less than half of the original number. What is the original number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the digit at unit place $= a$

Digit at tens place $= b$

Original number $= 10b + a$

Reversed number $= 10a + b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
10a + b                     &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (10b + a) - 1 \\\\
10a + b                     &= \dfrac {10b + a} {2} - 1 \\\\
10a + b + 1                 &= \dfrac {10b + a} {2} \\\\
2 \times (10a + b + 1)      &= 10b + a \\\\
20a + 2b + 2                &= 10b + a \\\\
2                           &= 10b - 2b + a - 20a \\\\
2                           &= 8b - 19a \\\\
8b - 19a                    &= 2 \\\\
8b                          &= 19a + 2 \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {19a + 2} {8}
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out a number that satisfies the above equation.

|  $a$  |            $19a + 2$              | Whole Multiple of $8$? |
|:-----:|:---------------------------------:|:----------------:|
| $1$   | $19 \times 1 + 2 = 21$            | No               |
| $2$   | $19 \times 2 + 2 = 40$            | Yes            |
| $3$   | $19 \times 3 + 2 = 59$            | No               |
| $4$   | $19 \times 4 + 2 = 78$            | No               |
| $5$   | $19 \times 5 + 2 = 97$            | No               |
| $6$   | $19 \times 6 + 2 = 116$           | No            |
| $7$   | $19 \times 7 + 2 = 135$           | No               |
| $8$   | $19 \times 8 + 2 = 154$           | No               |
| $9$   | $19 \times 9 + 2 = 173$           | No               |

The digit at unit place $= 2$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Digit at tens place}          &= \dfrac {19 \times 2 + 2} {8} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {40} {8} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 8} {8} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel 8} {\cancel 8} \\\\
                                        &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Original number $= 52$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$52$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sholto has $40$ helium balloons. Some of the balloons are red, some are blue and some are green. There are three times as many green balloons as there are red balloons and there are twice as many blue balloons as there are green balloons. 

How many balloons are blue? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sholto has $40$ helium balloons. Some of the balloons are red, some are blue and some are green. There are three times as many green balloons as there are red balloons and there are twice as many blue balloons as there are green balloons. 
<emptyline>
How many balloons are blue? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of red balloons $= r$

Number of green balloons $= 3r$

Number of blue balloons $= 2 \times 3r = 6r$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
r + 3r + 6r &= 40 \\\\
10r &= 40 \\\\
r &= \dfrac{40}{10} \\\\
r &= \dfrac{4 \times 10}{10} \\\\
r &= \dfrac{4 \times \cancel{10}}{\cancel{10}} \\\\
r &= 4 \\\\
\text{Number of blue balloons} &= 6r \\\\
&= 6 \times 4 \\\\
&= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I think of a number. I multiply my number by $9$ and add $5$ to the result. The answer is $50$. What is my number? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number. I multiply my number by $9$ and add $5$ to the result. The answer is $50$. What is my number? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
9 \times a + 5    &= 50 \\\\
9a                &= 50 - 5 \\\\
9a                &= 45 \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {45} {9} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {5 \times 9} {9} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel {9}} {\cancel {9}} \\\\
a                 &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 5$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

**Working**

Let the value of a triangle $= t$

Let the value of a square $= s$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3t + 2s     &= 16 \\\\
2t + s      &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

 Lets subtract the second equation from the first.

$
\begin{aligned}
3t + 2s - (2t + s)        &= 16 - 9 \\\\
3t + 2s - 2t - s          &= 7 \\\\
t + s                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

$t + s= 7$
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve. Let's reduce it to just $1$ equation,

Multiply the second equation by $2$.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2 \times 2t + 2 \times s     &= 2 \times 9 \\\\
4t + 2s                      &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the first equation from the second to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
4t + 2s - (3t + 2s)        &= 18 - 16 \\\\
4t + 2s - 3t - 2s          &= 2 \\\\
t                          &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $t$ in second equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
2t + s          &= 9 \\\\
2 \times 2 + s    &= 9 \\\\
4 + s             &= 9 \\\\
s                 &= 9 - 4 \\\\
s                 &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $ = 5$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Substituting the value of $t$ in second equation,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
2t + s          &= 9 \\\\
2 \times 2 + s    &= 9 \\\\
4 + s             &= 9 \\\\
s                 &= 9 - 4 \\\\
s                 &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Answer $ = 5$
</code></pre>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Faye called Emily's number $x$ and formed the following equation.

$4x - 5 = 2x + 1$

Solve this equation and write down the value of $x$, showing your working clearly.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Faye called Emily's number $x$ and formed the following equation.
<emptyline>
$4x - 5 = 2x + 1$
<emptyline>
Solve this equation and write down the value of $x$, showing your working clearly.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
4 x - 5     &= 2 x + 1 \\\\
4 x - 2 x   &= 1 + 5 \\\\
2 x         &= 6 \\\\
x           &= \dfrac {6} {2} \\\\
x           &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
x           &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 3} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
x           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

Find Gemma's number, showing your working clearly.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned}
2 a + 5     &= 23 - a \\\\

a           &= \dfrac {3 \times 6} {3} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 6} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
a           &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Farmer John has $14$ horses and farmer Paul has $27$.

John buys some horses from Paul and then $3$ more horses than Paul.

How many did John buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Farmer John has $14$ horses and farmer Paul has $27$.
<emptyline>
John buys some horses from Paul and then $3$ more horses than Paul.
<emptyline>
How many did John buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of horses John buy $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(14 + a)    &= (27 - a) + 3 \\\\
14 + a      &= 30 - a \\\\
a + a       &= 30 - 14 \\\\
2a          &= 16 \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {2 \times 8} {2} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 8} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a           &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The front row of a theatre has $48$ seats and each other row has four more seats than the row in front. There are $80$ seats in the last row. How many seats are there altogether in the theatre?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The front row of a theatre has $48$ seats and each other row has four more seats than the row in front. There are $80$ seats in the last row. How many seats are there altogether in the theatre?
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total seats}    &= 48 + (48 + 4) + (48 + 8) + (48 + 12) \ + \\\\
                       &= (48 + 16) + (48 + 20) + (48 + 24) \ + \\\\
                       &= (48 + 28) + (48 + 32) \\\\
                       &= 48 + 52 + 56 + 60 + 64 + 68 + 72 + 76 + 80 \\\\
                       &= 570
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$570$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Martha and Sally each have the same amount of money.

If Martha spends $\pounds 10$ and Sally spends $\pounds 20$, then Martha has three times as much as Sally.

If Martha spends $\pounds 15$ and Sally spends $\pounds 20$, then Martha has twice as much as Sally.

How much money do they have altogether?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Martha and Sally each have the same amount of money.
<emptyline>
If Martha spends $\pounds 10$ and Sally spends $\pounds 20$, then Martha has three times as much as Sally.
<emptyline>
If Martha spends $\pounds 15$ and Sally spends $\pounds 20$, then Martha has twice as much as Sally.
<emptyline>
How much money do they have altogether?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of money Martha has $= m$

Since Sally has the same amount of money, the amount Sally has $= m$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
m - 10 &= 3(m - 20) \\\\
m - 10 &= 3m - 60 \\\\
3m - m &= 60 - 10 \\\\
2m &= 50 \\\\
m &= \dfrac{50}{2} \\\\
m &= \dfrac{2 \times 25}{2} \\\\
m &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times 25}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
m &= 25 \\\\
\text{Total money} &= m + m \\\\
&= 25 + 25 \\\\
&= \pounds 50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The sum of two whole numbers is $30$ and their difference is $20$.

What are the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sum of two whole numbers is $30$ and their difference is $20$.
<emptyline>
What are the two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Let the second number $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
a + b                    &= 30 \\\\
a - b                    &= 20
\end{aligned}
$

We have $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Lets eliminate to reduce it to just one variable.

Let's add the second equation to the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + b) + (a - b)            &= 30 + 20 \\\\
2a                       &= 50 \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {50} {2} \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 25} {2} \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 25} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
a                        &= 25
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $a$ in one of the equations.

$
\begin{aligned} 
a + b                    &= 30 \\\\
25 + b                   &= 30 \\\\
b                        &= 30 - 25 \\\\
b                        &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Numbers are $= 25$, $5$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I think of a number multiply it by $3$ and then subtract $8$, if the answer is $-5$, what number did I start with? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number multiply it by $3$ and then subtract $8$, if the answer is $-5$, what number did I start with? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
