<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$52$ ladies did not lose their gloves.

Some ladies lost one glove and some lost both gloves. 

After the party, the $29$ missing gloves were found.

How many ladies lost only one glove?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$52$ ladies did not lose their gloves.
<emptyline>
Some ladies lost one glove and some lost both gloves. 
<emptyline>
After the party, the $29$ missing gloves were found.
<emptyline>
How many ladies lost only one glove?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Number of ladies who lost their gloves $= 72 - 52 = 20$

Let the ladies who lost only one glove $= a$

Ladies who lost both gloves $= 20 - a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (20 - a) \times 2                 &= 29 \\\\
a + 40 - 2a                           &= 29 \\\\
a                              &= 40 - 29 \\\\
a                                     &= 11
\end{aligned}
$

Ladies who lost only one glove $= 11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

</div>
</div>

**Working**

Let the number of sweets Dominic has $= d$

Number of sweets Hannah has $= 2d$

Number of sweets Abdul has $= 3 \times 2d = 6d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
d + 2d + 6d             &= 36 \\\\
9d                      &= 36 \\\\
d                       &= \dfrac {36} {9} \\\\
d                       &= \dfrac {9 \times 4} {9} \\\\
d                       &= \dfrac {\cancel{9} \times 4} {\cancel{9}} \\\\
d                       &= 4 \\\\
\text{Sweets Abdul has} &= 6d \\\\
                        &= 6 \times 4 \\\\
                        &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Find $a$ when $a \ \hearts \ 4 = 32$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $a$ when $a \ \hearts \ 4 = 32$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

a                 &= 6 
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Find $x$ when $x \ \hearts \ x = 72$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $x$ when $x \ \hearts \ x = 72$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
x \ \hearts \ x &= 72 \\\\
x \times x - x         &= 72 \\\\
x \times (x - 1)       &= 72 
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out $2$ numbers which meets the following critiera based on the equations above.

- The product of the $2$ numbers is $72$. 
- The difference between the $2$ numbers is $1$.

Factor pairs of $72 = (1, 72), (2, 36), (4, 18), (6, 12), (8, 9)$

Factor pairs of $72$ that have difference of $1 = (8,9)$

$x = 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$9$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
x \ \hearts \ x &= 72 \\\\
x \times x - x         &= 72 \\\\
x \times (x - 1)       &= 72 
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out $2$ numbers which meets the following critiera based on the equations above.
<emptyline>
- The product of the $2$ numbers is $72$. 
- The difference between the $2$ numbers is $1$.
<emptyline>
Factor pairs of $72 = (1, 72), (2, 36), (4, 18), (6, 12), (8, 9)$
<emptyline>
Factor pairs of $72$ that have difference of $1 = (8,9)$
<emptyline>
$x = 9$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

You multiply a number by itself. You then multiply the new number by three. The answer is $192$.

What is your starting number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">You multiply a number by itself. You then multiply the new number by three. The answer is $192$.
<emptyline>
What is your starting number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times a \times 3 &= 192 \\\\
a ^ 2                 &= \dfrac {192} {3} \\\\
a ^ 2                 &= \dfrac {64 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a ^ 2                 &= \dfrac {64 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
a ^ 2                 &= 64 \\\\
a                     &= \sqrt {64} \\\\
a                     &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Number $=8$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**


For Sale

|Tomatoes     |$\pounds 1.5$ per pound|
|:-----------:|:---------------------:|
|Green Peppers|$40 \ \text{p}$ each   |
|Cucumbers    |$30 \ \text{p}$ each   |

Brendan and Sophie got $\pounds 0.20$ change when they paid with $\pounds 5$ for some tomatoes, green peppers and cucumbers which they bought at a farm stand.

They bought $5$ tomatoes, which weighed $2 \ \text{pounds}$ altogether. 

They bought two more tomatoes than green peppers.

How many cucumbers did they buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">
For Sale
<emptyline>
|Tomatoes     |$\pounds 1.5$ per pound|
|:-----------:|:---------------------:|
|Green Peppers|$40 \ \text{p}$ each   |
|Cucumbers    |$30 \ \text{p}$ each   |
<emptyline>
Brendan and Sophie got $\pounds 0.20$ change when they paid with $\pounds 5$ for some tomatoes, green peppers and cucumbers which they bought at a farm stand.
<emptyline>
They bought $5$ tomatoes, which weighed $2 \ \text{pounds}$ altogether. 
<emptyline>
They bought two more tomatoes than green peppers.
<emptyline>
How many cucumbers did they buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of cucumbers $= a$

Number of green peppers $= 5 - 2 = 3$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times 1.50 + 3 \times 0.40 + a \times 0.30 &= 5 - 0.20 \\\\
3 + 1.2 + 0.3 a                           &= 4.8 \\\\
0.3 a                                       &= 4.8 - 3 - 1.2 \\\\
0.3 a                                       &= 0.6 \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {0.6} {0.3} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {0.6 \times 10} {0.3 \times 10} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {6} {3} \\\\
a                                           &= 2	
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cucumbers $= 2$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bus started off from a bus station with $24$ people.

At  the the first stop $4$ people got off and some people got on.

At the second stop, no one got off but $3$ people got on.

There were then $34$ people.

How many people got on at the first stop?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>
At the second stop, no one got off but $3$ people got on.
<emptyline>
There were then $34$ people.
<emptyline>
How many people got on at the first stop?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

**Working**

Let the number of people who got on at the first stop $= p$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
24 - 4 + p + 3 &= 34 \\\\
p + 23         &= 34 \\\\
p              &= 34 - 23 \\\\
p              &= 11
\end{aligned}
$

Number of people who got on $=11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The Jones children take their dogs for a walk.

There are $3$ times as many dogs as children.

The total number of legs is $56$. How many Jones children are then?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The Jones children take their dogs for a walk.
<emptyline>

<emptyline>
The total number of legs is $56$. How many Jones children are then?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of children $= c$

Number of dogs $= 3 c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times c + 4 \times 3 c &= 56 \\\\
2 c + 12 c                &= 56 \\\\
14 c                      &= 56 \\\\
c                         &= \dfrac {56} {14} \\\\
c                         &= \dfrac {14 \times 4} {14} \\\\
c                         &= \dfrac {\cancel {14} \times 4} {\cancel {14}} \\\\
c                         &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Number of children $=4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>

**Question**

If $x \ \spadesuit \ 2 = 23$, what number is $x$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $x \ \spadesuit \ 2 = 23$, what number is $x$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
x \ \spadesuit \ 2 &= 23 \\\\
x + 2 + (x \times 2)   &= 23 \\\\
x + 2 + 2x             &= 23 \\\\
3x + 2                 &= 23 \\\\
3x                     &= 23 - 2 \\\\
3x                     &= 21 \\\\
x                      &= \dfrac{21}{3} \\\\
x                      &= \dfrac{3 \times 7}{3} \\\\
x                      &= \dfrac{\cancel 3 \times 7}{\cancel 3} \\\\
x                      &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $n \ \spadesuit \ n = 99$, what number is $n$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $n \ \spadesuit \ n = 99$, what number is $n$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
n \ \spadesuit \ n &= 99 \\\\
n + n + (n \times n) &= 99 \\\\
n \times n + 2n       &= 99 \\\\
n \times (n + 2)     &= 99
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out $2$ numbers which meets the following critiera based on the equations above.

- The product of the $2$ numbers is $99$ 
- The difference between the $2$ numbers is $2$.

Factor pairs of $99 = (1, 99), (9, 11)$

Factor pairs of $99$ that have difference of $2 = (9,11)$

$n = 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bat ate $1050$ mosquitoes in four nights. Each night she ate $25$ more than the night before. 
How many did she eat on the first night? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bat ate $1050$ mosquitoes in four nights. Each night she ate $25$ more than the night before. 
How many did she eat on the first night? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the mosquitoes eaten on the first night $= m$

As per the question

$
\begin{aligned}
m + (m + 25) + (m + 50) + (m + 75) &= 1050 \\\\
4m + 150 &= 1050 \\\\
4m &= 1050 - 150 \\\\
4m &= 900 \\\\
m &= \dfrac{900}{4} \\\\
m &= \dfrac{225 \times 4}{4} \\\\
m &= \dfrac{225 \times \cancel{4}}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
m &= 225
\end{aligned}
$

Number of mosquitoes eaten on first night $= 225$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$225$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

If two numbers multiply to give $36$ and their difference is $5$, what are the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times b          &= 36 \\\\

- The product of the $2$ numbers is $36$. 
- The difference between the $2$ numbers is $5$.

Factor pairs of $36 = (1, 36), (2, 18), (3, 12), (4, 9), (6, 6)$

Factor pairs of $36$ that have difference of $5 = (4,9)$

Numbers $= 4$, $9$

$4, 9$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tasha thinks of a number, multiplies it by $3$ and then adds $8$. 
Her answer is $35$. What is the number she first thought of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tasha thinks of a number, multiplies it by $3$ and then adds $8$. 
Her answer is $35$. What is the number she first thought of?
</code></pre>

3a + 8   &= 35 \\\\

a        &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 9} {\cancel {3} } \\\\
a        &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number $=9$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kristina and Ravi shared a box of sweets. 
Kristina ate $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of them. 

If $12$ sweets were left for Ravi, how many sweets were 
there in the box at the start?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q16-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q16-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q16-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Kristina and Ravi shared a box of sweets. 
Kristina ate $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of them. 
<emptyline>
If $12$ sweets were left for Ravi, how many sweets were 
there in the box at the start?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of sweets in the box at the start $= a$

If Kristina ate $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of them, then the number of sweets left for Ravi $= 1 - \dfrac{3}{5} = \dfrac{2}{5}$ of the total sweets.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{2}{5} \times a &= 12 \\\\
\dfrac{2a}{5} &= 12 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{12 \times 5}{2} \\\\
a &= \dfrac{2 \times 6 \times 5}{2} \\\\
a &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times 6 \times 5}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
a &= 6 \times 5 \\\\
a &= 30
\end{aligned}
$

Number of sweets $= 30$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$30$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sharpay is going shopping for some new stationery.

She can buy three pencils and a ruler for $50 \ \text{p}$ or two pencils and two rulers for $56 \ \text{p}$. 

How much does each pencil cost her?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q37-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q37-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q37-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sharpay is going shopping for some new stationery.
<emptyline>
She can buy three pencils and a ruler for $50 \ \text{p}$ or two pencils and two rulers for $56 \ \text{p}$. 
<emptyline>
How much does each pencil cost her?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a pencil $= p$

Let the cost of a ruler $= r$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
3p + r      &= 50 \\\\
2p + 2r     &= 56         
\end{aligned}
$

There are two variables, $p$ and $r$. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply the first equation by $2$

$
\begin{aligned} 
3p + r                      &= 50 \\\\
2 \times 3p + 2 \times r    &= 2 \times 50 \\\\
6p + 2r                     &= 100
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the second equation from the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
6p + 2r - (2p + 2r)         &= 100 - 56 \\\\
6p + 2r - 2p - 2r           &= 44 \\\\
4p                          &= 44 \\\\
p                           &= \dfrac{44}{4} \\\\
p                           &= \dfrac{11 \times 4}{4} \\\\
p                           &= \dfrac{11 \times \cancel 4}{\cancel 4} \\\\
p                           &= 11 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a pencil$= 11 \ \text{p}$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alice has saved $\pounds 10$ more than Becky. 

Becky has saved $\pounds 3$ more than Charlie.

Altogether Alice, Becky and Charlie have saved $\pounds 26.50$.


How much has Alice saved?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q39-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q39-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2010/group-1/s01-q39-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alice has saved $\pounds 10$ more than Becky. 
<emptyline>
Becky has saved $\pounds 3$ more than Charlie.
<emptyline>
Altogether Alice, Becky and Charlie have saved $\pounds 26.50$.
<emptyline>

How much has Alice saved?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let Alice's savings $= a$

Becky's savings $= a - 10$

Charlie's savings $= (a - 10) - 3 = a - 13$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (a - 10) + (a - 13) &= 26.50 \\\\
3a - 23 &= 26.50 \\\\
3a &= 26.50 + 23 \\\\
3a &= 49.50 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{49.50}{3} \\\\
a &= \pounds 16.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$ \pounds 16.50$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Find $a$ when $a*2 = 30$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $a$ when $a*2 = 30$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
a*2 &= 30 \\\\
(a + 2) \times 2 &= 30 \\\\
a + 2            &= \dfrac{30}{2} \\\\
a + 2            &= \dfrac{15 \times 2}{2} \\\\
a + 2            &= \dfrac{15 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 2} \\\\
a + 2            &= 15 \\\\
a                &= 15 - 2 \\\\
a                &= 13
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Find $a$ when $a*a = 50$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find $a$ when $a*a = 50$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
a*a &= 50 \\\\
(a + a) \times a   &= 50 \\\\
2a \times a        &= 50 \\\\
2a ^2              &= 50 \\\\
a ^2               &= \dfrac{50}{2} \\\\
a ^2               &= \dfrac{25 \times 2}{2} \\\\  
a ^2               &= \dfrac{25 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 2} \\\\ 
a ^2               &= 25 \\\\
a                  &= \sqrt{25} \\\\
a                  &= 5              
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$5$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Give two numbers which add up to make $40$ and have a difference of $10$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Give two numbers which add up to make $40$ and have a difference of $10$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Let the second number $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
a + b      &= 40   \\\\
a - b      &= 10         
\end{aligned}
$

There are two variables, $a$ and $b$. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable.

Subtract the second equation from the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b - (a - b)     &= 40 - 10 \\\\
a + b -a + b        &= 30 \\\\
2b                  &= 30 \\\\
b                   &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
b                   &= \dfrac{15 \times 2}{2} \\\\
b                   &= \dfrac{15 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 2} \\\\
b                   &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $b$ in one of the initial equations.

$
\begin{aligned} 
a + b                          &= 40  \\\\
a + 15                         &= 40 \\\\
a                              &= 40 - 15 \\\\
a                              &= 25
\end{aligned}
$

First number $= 25$

Second number $= 15$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25, 15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Josie and Holly share $\pounds 42$ in between them. Josie 
has three times as much as Holly. How much has Holly?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Josie and Holly share $\pounds 42$ in between them. Josie 
has three times as much as Holly. How much has Holly?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount Holly has $= h$

Amount Josie has $= 3h$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
h + 3h &= 42 \\\\
4h &= 42 \\\\
h &= \dfrac{42}{4} \\\\
h &= \dfrac{2 \times 21}{2 \times 2} \\\\
h &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times 21}{\cancel{2} \times 2} \\\\
h &= \pounds 10.50
\end{aligned}
$

Holly has $=\pounds 10.50$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 10.50$

</div>
</div>

As per the question,

$\begin{aligned}
3a + r &= 58 \\\\

\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}
3a + r + (a + 3r) &= 58 + 62 \\\\
4a + 4r &= 120
\end{aligned}$

Cost  $= 120 \ \text{p}$
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

He holds up a card. He says *'If I multiply the number on this
card by $5$ and then add $2$, the answer is $47$'*

What is the number on the card?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">He holds up a card. He says *'If I multiply the number on this
card by $5$ and then add $2$, the answer is $47$'*
<emptyline>
What is the number on the card?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \times a + 2       &= 47 \\\\
5a                   &= 47 - 2 \\\\
5a                   &= 45 \\\\
a                    &= \dfrac{45}{5} \\\\ 
a                    &= \dfrac{9 \times 5}{5} \\\\  
a                    &= \dfrac{9 \times \cancel 5}{\cancel 5} \\\\ 
a                    &= 9   
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

He holds up a second card. 
He says *'If i divide the number on this card by $6$ and then subtract $3$, the answer is $5$'*

What is the number on the second card?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">He holds up a second card.

<emptyline>
What is the number on the second card?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{a}{6} - 3       &= 5 \\\\
\dfrac{a}{6}           &= 5 + 3 \\\\
\dfrac{a}{6}           &= 8 \\\\
a                      &= 8 \times 6 \\\\ 
a                      &= 48 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

*'If i subtract this number from $50$ and then halve it, the answer is $19$.'*

What is the number on the third card?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>

$
\begin{aligned}

a                    &= 12 
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Find the value of $6 * \dfrac{1}{3}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the value of $6 * \dfrac{1}{3}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 6 * \dfrac{1}{3} \\\\
&= 6 \times 6 + 6 \times \dfrac{1}{3} \\\\
&= 36 + \dfrac{6}{3} \\\\
&= 36 + \dfrac{3 \times 2}{3} \\\\
&= 36 + \dfrac{\cancel 3 \times 2}{\cancel 3} \\\\
&= 36 + 2 \\\\
&= 38
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$3 * x$ gives $24$. What is $x?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3 * x$ gives $24$. What is $x?$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
3 * x        &= 24 \\\\
3 \times 3 + 3 \times x        &= 24 \\\\
9 + 3x                         &= 24 \\\\
3x                             &= 24 - 9 \\\\
3x                             &= 15 \\\\
x                              &= \dfrac{15}{3} \\\\
x                              &= \dfrac{3 \times 5}{3} \\\\
x                              &= \dfrac{\cancel 3 \times 5}{\cancel 3} \\\\
x                              &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

$y * y$ gives $32$. What is $y?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$y * y$ gives $32$. What is $y?$

y                              &= \sqrt{16} \\\\
y                              &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The difference between two numbers is $7$.

When the numbers are multiplied, the result is $60$. 

What are the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The difference between two numbers is $7$.
<emptyline>
When the numbers are multiplied, the result is $60$. 
<emptyline>
What are the two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Let the second number $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times b &= 60 \\\\
a - b      &= 7  
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out $2$ numbers which meets the following critiera based on the equations above.

- The product of the $2$ numbers is $60$ 
- The difference of the $2$ numbers is $7$.

Factor pairs of $60 = (1, 60), (2, 30), (3, 20), (4, 15), (5, 12), (6, 10)$

Factor pairs of $60$ that have difference of $7 = (5, 12)$

Numbers are $= 5$, $12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5, 12$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The sweet shapes below cost $52 \ \text{p}$ altogether. Each heart 
costs half the price of a triangle and each star costs double the 
cost of each triangle. 

What is the cost of a heart?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q33-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q33-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q33-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sweet shapes below cost $52 \ \text{p}$ altogether. Each heart 
costs half the price of a triangle and each star costs double the 
cost of each triangle. 
<emptyline>
What is the cost of a heart?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of heart $= h$

Cost of each triangle $= 2h$

Cost of each star $= 4h$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 4h + 4 \times h + 3 \times 2h &= 52 \\\\
16h + 4h + 6h                       &= 52 \\\\
26h                               &= 52 \\\\
h                                 &= \dfrac{52}{26} \\\\
h                                 &= \dfrac{2 \times 26}{26} \\\\
h                                 &= \dfrac{2 \times \cancel {26}}{\cancel {26}} \\\\
h                                 &= 2 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of each heart $= 2 \ \text{p}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I bought a packet of fruit gums and ate $2$ of them, secretly, in my Music lesson.

At break, I shared one third of the remaining fruit gums with 
my friends. I then finished the fruit gums, eating an equal amount in each of 
the next four lessons.

What is the smallest number of fruit gums there could have been in the packet?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I bought a packet of fruit gums and ate $2$ of them, secretly, in my Music lesson.
<emptyline>
At break, I shared one third of the remaining fruit gums with 
my friends. I then finished the fruit gums, eating an equal amount in each of 
the next four lessons.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of fruit gums there could have been in the packet?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of fruit gums in the packet $= x$

As per the question,

$\begin{aligned}
\text{After eating 2 gums}              &= x - 2 \\\\
\text{Amount left after sharing}        &=  (1 - \dfrac {1} {3}) \times (x - 2) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times (x - 2) \\\\
\text{Amount per lesson}                &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times (x - 2) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \times (x - 2)} {4 \times 3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \times (x - 2)} {2 \times 2 \times 3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{2}\times  (x - 2)} {\cancel{2} \times 2 \times 3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {x - 2} {6}
\end{aligned}$

For the number of fruit gums per lesson to be a whole number, $(x - 2)$ must be a multiple of $6$. 
To find the smallest number, we assume the amount per lesson is $1$.

$\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {x - 2} {6} &= 1 \\\\
x - 2 &= 6 \\\\
x &= 6 + 2 \\\\
x &= 8
\end{aligned}$

Smallest number of fruit gums $= 8$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If Pia keeps her cards in the order $A \ B \ C$ and starts with $11$, what is her answer?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If Pia keeps her cards in the order $A \ B \ C$ and starts with $11$, what is her answer?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= ((11 \times 5) + 3) \div 2 \\\\
&= (55 + 3) \div 2 \\\\
&= 58 \div 2 \\\\
&= \dfrac{58}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{29 \times 2}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{29 \times  \cancel 2}{\cancel 2} \\\\
&= 29
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What whole number would she need to start with to get an answer of $19$, if 
her cards were still arranged in the order $A \ B \ C$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What whole number would she need to start with to get an answer of $19$, if 
her cards were still arranged in the order $A \ B \ C$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the starting number $= a$

As per the question, 

$
\begin{aligned}
((a \times 5) + 3) \div 2 &= 19 \\\\
(a \times 5) + 3          &= 19 \times 2 \\\\
(a \times 5) + 3          &= 38 \\\\
a \times 5                &= 38 - 3 \\\\
a \times 5                &= 35 \\\\
a                         &= \dfrac {35} {5} \\\\
a                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 5} {5} \\\\
a                         &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a                         &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

If Pia arranges her cards in the order $C \ B \ A$ and starts with number $4$, what is her answer?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If Pia arranges her cards in the order $C \ B \ A$ and starts with number $4$, what is her answer?

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
&= ((4 \div 2) + 3) \times 5 \\\\
&= (\dfrac{4}{2} + 3) \times 5 \\\\
&= (\dfrac{2 \times 2}{2} + 3) \times 5 \\\\
&= (\dfrac{2 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 2} + 3) \times 5 \\\\
&= (2 + 3) \times 5 \\\\
&= 5 \times 5 \\\\
&= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Pia changes the order of the cards. She starts with a whole number and 
ends up with $15$. Give all the possible orders in which she could have used her three cards.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pia changes the order of the cards. She starts with a whole number and 
ends up with $15$. Give all the possible orders in which she could have used her three cards.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Possible arrangement are $= \text{BAC, BCA,  CBA}$

Let's verify,

Let the whole number $= a$

$\text{BAC} \rightarrow $

$
\begin{aligned}
((a + 3) \times 5) \div 2      &= 15 \\\\
(a + 3) \times \dfrac{5}{2}    &= 15 \\\\
(a + 3) \times 5               &= 15 \times 2 \\\\
(a + 3) \times 5               &= 30 \\\\
5a + 15                        &= 30 \\\\
5a                             &= 30 - 15 \\\\
5a                             &= 15 \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac{15}{5} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac{5 \times 3}{5}\\\\
a                              &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 3}{\cancel 5}\\\\
a                              &= 5 
\end{aligned}
$

$\text{BCA} \rightarrow $

$
\begin{aligned}
(((a + 3) \div 2 ) \times 5 )  &= 15 \\\\
(a + 3) \div 2                 &= \dfrac{15}{5} \\\\
(a + 3) \div 2                 &= \dfrac{5 \times 3}{5} \\\\
(a + 3) \div 2                 &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 3}{\cancel 5} \\\\
(a + 3) \div 2                 &= 3 \\\\
(a + 3)                        &= 3 \times 2 \\\\
a + 3                          &= 6 \\\\
a                              &= 6 - 3 \\\\
a                              &= 3                    
\end{aligned}
$

$\text{CBA} \rightarrow $ 

$
\begin{aligned}
(((a \div 2 ) + 3) \times 5 )   &= 15 \\\\
(a \div 2 ) + 3                 &= \dfrac{15}{5} \\\\
(a \div 2 ) + 3                 &= \dfrac{5 \times 3}{5} \\\\
(a \div 2 ) + 3                 &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 3}{\cancel 5} \\\\
(a \div 2 ) + 3                 &= 3 \\\\
a \div 2                        &= 3 - 3 \\\\
a \div 2                        &= 0 \\\\
a                               &= 0 \times 2 \\\\
a                               &= 0
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text{BAC, BCA,  CBA}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

$(\boxed{\phantom{5555}} + 7) \times 6 = 54$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$(\boxed{\phantom{5555}} + 7) \times 6 = 54$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 7) \times 6 &= 54 \\\\
a + 7            &= \dfrac{54}{6} \\\\
a + 7            &= \dfrac{9 \times 6}{6} \\\\
a + 7            &= \dfrac{9 \times \cancel 6}{\cancel 6} \\\\
a + 7            &= 9 \\\\
a                &= 9 - 7 \\\\
a                &= 2 
\end{aligned}
$

Missing number $=2$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Lucy is thinking of two numbers.

The sum of the two numbers is $17$. 

When she multiplies them together, the result is $66$.

What are the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Lucy is thinking of two numbers.
<emptyline>

<emptyline>
When she multiplies them together, the result is $66$.
<emptyline>
What are the two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first numbers $= a$ 

Let the second number $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b               &= 17 \\\\
a \times b          &= 66 
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out $2$ numbers which meets the following critiera based on the equations above.

- The sum of the $2$ numbers is $17$.
- The product of the $2$ numbers is $66$ 

Factor pairs of $66 = (1, 66), (2, 33), (3, 22), (6, 11)$

| Factor pair $(a, b)$ |  $a + b$ | $= 17$? |
|:--------------------:|:------------------:|:------------------:|
| $(1, 66)$            | $1 + 66 = 67$      | No                 |
| $(2, 33)$             | $2 + 33 = 35$      | No                 |
| $(3, 22)$             | $3 + 22 = 25$      | No                 |
| $(6, 11)$             | $6 + 11 = 17$      | Yes                |

A quick check shows $6$ and $11$ meets the criteria above.

Numbers $= 6$, $11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6, 11$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 3 + 5 &= 23 \\\\
3a + 5         &= 23 \\\\

a              &= \dfrac{18}{3} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac{6 \times 3}{3} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac{6 \times \cancel 3}{\cancel 3} \\\\
a              &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Patrick has made $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of the designs in his origami book.

If he has made $24$ designs, how many are there altogether in his book?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Patrick has made $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of the designs in his origami book.
<emptyline>
If he has made $24$ designs, how many are there altogether in his book?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of designs $=d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{3}{4} \times d            &= 24 \\\\
d                                &= \dfrac{24 \times 4}{3} \\\\
d                                &= \dfrac{8 \times 3 \times 4}{3} \\\\
d                                &= \dfrac{8 \times \cancel 3 \times 4}{\cancel 3} \\\\
d                                &= 8 \times 4 \\\\
d                                &= 32 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$32$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A cat, her $4$ kittens and their cat basket altogether have a mass of $6 \dfrac{1}{2} \ \text{kilograms}$.

The cat basket has a mass of $500  \ \text{grams}$.

Each kitten has a mass of $0.6 \ \text{kilograms}$.

What is the mass of the cat?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A cat, her $4$ kittens and their cat basket altogether have a mass of $6 \dfrac{1}{2} \ \text{kilograms}$.
<emptyline>
The cat basket has a mass of $500  \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
Each kitten has a mass of $0.6 \ \text{kilograms}$.
<emptyline>
What is the mass of the cat?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the mass of the cat $= c$

Mass of the cat basket $= 500 \ \text{grams} = 0.5 \ \text{kg}$

As per the question,

$\begin{aligned}
c + 4 \times 0.6 + 0.5  &= 6.5 \\\\
c + 2.4 + 0.5          &= 6.5 \\\\
c + 2.9                 &= 6.5 \\\\
c &= 6.5 - 2.9 \\\\
c &= 3.6 \ \text{kg} 
\end{aligned}$

Mass of the cat $= 3.6 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3.6 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Simon bought a cup of tea and fizzy drink, paying $\pounds 2.60$ in total.

The fizzy drink cost $30  \text{p}$ more than the cup of tea.

How much did the fizzy drink cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Simon bought a cup of tea and fizzy drink, paying $\pounds 2.60$ in total.
<emptyline>
The fizzy drink cost $30  \text{p}$ more than the cup of tea.
<emptyline>
How much did the fizzy drink cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a cup of tea $= t$

Cost of a fizzy drink $= t + 30$

Total cost $= \pounds 2.60 = 260 \ \text{p}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
t + (t + 30) &= 260 \\\\
2t + 30 &= 260 \\\\
2t &= 260 - 30 \\\\
2t &= 230 \\\\
t &= \dfrac{230}{2} \\\\
t &= \dfrac{2 \times 115}{2} \\\\
t &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times 115}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
t &= 115 \ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Cost of fizzy drink} &= 115 + 30 \\\\
&= 145 \ \text{p} \\\\
&= \pounds 1.45
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.45$ 

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On Monday, Claire bought an apple and a banana. The total cost was $57  \text{p}$.

On Tuesday, Claire bought a banana and a pear. The total cost was $56  \text{p}$.

On Wednesday, Claire bought an apple and a pear. The total cost was $69  \text{p}$.

On Thursday, Claire bought an apple, a banana, and a pear.

How much did Claire spend on Thursday?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On Monday, Claire bought an apple and a banana. The total cost was $57  \text{p}$.
<emptyline>
On Tuesday, Claire bought a banana and a pear. The total cost was $56  \text{p}$.
<emptyline>
On Wednesday, Claire bought an apple and a pear. The total cost was $69  \text{p}$.
<emptyline>
On Thursday, Claire bought an apple, a banana, and a pear.
<emptyline>
How much did Claire spend on Thursday?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let cost of an apple $= a$

Let cost of a banana $= b$

Let cost of a pear $= p$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b &= 57 \\\\
b + p &= 56 \\\\
a + p &= 69
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add the three equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + b) + (b + p) + (a + p) &= 57 + 56 + 69 \\\\
2a + 2b + 2p &= 182 \\\\
2 \times (a + b + p) &= 182 \\\\
a + b + p &= \dfrac{182}{2} \\\\
a + b + p &= \dfrac{2 \times 91}{2} \\\\
a + b + p &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times 91}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
a + b + p &= 91 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

Total cost on Thursday $= 91 \ \text{p}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$91 \ \text{p}$ 

</div>
</div>

**Question**

On Planet Hat, the symbol $\boxed{\wedge}$ has a special meaning in arithmetic.

$a \ \boxed{\wedge} \ b$ means multiply $a$ by $4$, and then subtract $b$.

For example, 

$
\begin{aligned} 
3  \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 2 &= 3 \times 4 - 2  \\
                        &= 12 - 3         \\
                        &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out the value of $m$ so that $m \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 6 = 26$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the value of $m$ so that $m \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 6 = 26$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
m \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 6 &= 26 \\\\
m \times 4 - 6  &= 26 \\\\
4m              &= 26 + 6 \\\\
4m              &= 32 \\\\
m               &= \dfrac{32}{4} \\\\
m               &= \dfrac{8 \times 4}{4} \\\\
m               &= \dfrac{8 \times \cancel 4}{ \cancel 4} \\\\
m               &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

It is possible to use the symbol twice in a calculation.

For example, 

$
\begin{aligned} 
3 \ \boxed{\wedge} \ (2 \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 1) &= 3  \ \boxed{\wedge} \ (2 \times 4 - 1). \\
                                              &= 3  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  7    \\
                                              &= 3 \times 4 - 7               \\
                                              &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Work out $5  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  (4  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  3)$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">It is possible to use the symbol twice in a calculation.

                                              &= 3  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  7    \\
                                              &= 3 \times 4 - 7               \\
                                              &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Work out $5  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  (4  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  3)$.
</code></pre>
</div>

\begin{aligned} 
&= 5  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  (4  \ \boxed{\wedge} \  3) \\\\

&= 5  \ \boxed{\wedge} \ (4 \times 4 - 3) \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out the value of $p$ so 
that $(6 \ \boxed{\wedge} \ p) \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 4 = 56$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the value of $p$ so 
that $(6 \ \boxed{\wedge} \ p) \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 4 = 56$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
(6 \ \boxed{\wedge} \ p) \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 4 &= 56  \\\\
(6 \times 4 - p) \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 4         &= 56  \\\\
(24 - p) \ \boxed{\wedge} \ 4         &= 56  \\\\
(24 - p) \times 4 - 4                         &= 56  \\\\                                              
96 - 4p -4                                    &= 56 \\\\
4p                                            &= 96 - 4 - 56 \\\\
4p                                            &= 36 \\\\
p                                             &= \dfrac{36}{4} \\\\
p                                             &= \dfrac{9 \times 4}{4} \\\\
p                                             &= \dfrac{9 \times \cancel 4}{\cancel 4} \\\\
p                                             &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>

**Question**

$24 \div (\boxed{\phantom{5555}} -  8) = 6$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Let the missing number $=a$

$
\begin{aligned}
24 \div (a - 8)     &= 6 \\\\
\dfrac{24}{a - 8}  &= 6 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Caley starts with a number, doubles it and then subtracts $7$.

The result is $31$.

What number did Caley start with?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Caley starts with a number, doubles it and then subtracts $7$.
<emptyline>
The result is $31$.
<emptyline>
What number did Caley start with?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times a - 7 &= 31 \\\\
2 a            &= 31 + 7 \\\\
2 a            &= 38 \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {38} {2} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {19 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {19 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a              &= 19
\end{aligned}
$

Number $=19$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

On Monday, Helen hangs $8$ shirts and $4$ jumpers on the washing line.

How many pegs does she use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                 &= 24 + 8 \\\\
                 &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

$32$

**Question**

On Wednesday, Helen hangs $5$ shirts and some jumpers on the line.

She uses $21$ pegs altogether.

How many jumpers does Helen hang on the line?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On Wednesday, Helen hangs $5$ shirts and some jumpers on the line.
<emptyline>
She uses $21$ pegs altogether.
<emptyline>
How many jumpers does Helen hang on the line?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of jumpers $= j$

As per the question,

$\begin{aligned}
(5 \times 3) + (j \times 2) &= 21 \\\\
15 + 2j                     &= 21 \\\\
2j                          &= 21 - 15 \\\\
2j                          &= 6 \\\\
j                           &= \dfrac{6}{2} \\\\
j                       &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
j                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 3} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
j                           &= 3
\end{aligned}$

Number of jumpers $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

On Friday, Helen uses $65$ pegs.

She hangs an equal number of shirts and jumpers on the line.

How many shirts does she hang on the washing line on Friday?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

j                       &= \dfrac {13 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
j                       &= 13
\end{aligned}
$

Number of Shirts $= 13$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Half of a certain number is $17$. What is the number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned} 
\dfrac {1} {2} \times a                           &= 17 \\\\
a                                                 &= 17 \times 2 \\\\
a                                                 &= 34
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two numbers add to give $15$ and multiply to give $56$.

What is the difference between the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two numbers add to give $15$ and multiply to give $56$.
<emptyline>
What is the difference between the two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Let the second number $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b &= 15 \\\\
ab &= 56
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error. Let's find out $2$ numbers which meets the following critiera based on the equations above.

- The sum of the $2$ numbers is $15$.
- The product of the $2$ numbers is $56$ 

Factor pairs of $56 = (1, 56), (2, 28), (4, 14), (7, 8)$

| Factor pair $(a, b)$ |  $a + b$ | $= 15$? |
|:--------------------:|:------------------:|:------------------:|
| $(1, 56)$            | $1 + 56 = 57$      | No                 |
| $(2, 28)$             | $2 + 28 = 30$      | No                 |
| $(4, 14)$             | $4 + 14 = 18$      | No                 |
| $(7, 8)$             | $7 + 8 = 15$      | Yes                |

A quick check shows $7$ and $8$ meets the criteria above.

Numbers $= 7$, $8$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Difference} &= 8 - 7 \\\\
&= 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 12  &= 18 \div 3 \\\\
a \times 12  &= \dfrac {18} {3} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac {18} {3 \times 12} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac {6 \times 3} {3 \times 2 \times 6} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3 \times 2 \times \cancel 6} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
