<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a taxi journey with one particular taxi company, the fare is worked out using a set starting charge plus a charge for each quarter of a mile travelled (the QMC).

So if the starting charge is $\pounds 1$ and the QMC (charge for each quarter of a mile) is $50 \text{p}$ then the total fare for a one mile journey is given by

Total Fare $= \pounds 1 + 4 \times 50 \ \text{p} = \pounds 3$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If the Total Fare for a two and a half mile $(2 \dfrac {1}{2} \ \text{mile})$ journey at another taxi company is $\pounds 9.60$ and the QMC (charge for each quarter of a mile) is $80 \text{p}$, what is the starting charge?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the Total Fare for a two and a half mile $(2 \dfrac {1}{2} \ \text{mile})$ journey at another taxi company is $\pounds 9.60$ and the QMC (charge for each quarter of a mile) is $80 \text{p}$, what is the starting charge?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the starting charge $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Quaters in} \ 2 \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {miles} &= 2 \dfrac {1} {2} \times 4 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {5} {2} \times 4 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {2} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 2 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 2 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                                                     &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 9.60                                         &= a + (10 \times 80 \ \text{p}) \\\\
\pounds 9.60                                         &= a + 800 \ \text{p} \\\\
\pounds 9.60                                         &= a + \pounds \dfrac {800} {100} \\\\
9.60                                                 &= a + \dfrac {8 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
9.60                                                 &= a + 8 \\\\
9.60 - 8                                             &= a \\\\
a                                                    &= 9.60 - 8 \\\\
a                                                    &= \pounds 1.60
\end{aligned}
$

Starting charge $= \pounds 1.60$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.60$

</div>
</div>

                                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {2} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 2 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 2 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                                                     &= 10
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>

$

9.60                                                 &= a + \dfrac {8 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
9.60                                                 &= a + 8 \\\\
9.60 - 8                                             &= a \\\\
a                                                    &= 9.60 - 8 \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

Starting charge $= \pounds 1.60$
</code></pre>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If the starting charge at a third company is $\pounds 2.20$ and the Total Fare for a $6 \dfrac {1}{4} \ \text{mile}$ journey is $\pounds 12.20$, what is the QMC?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the starting charge at a third company is $\pounds 2.20$ and the Total Fare for a $6 \dfrac {1}{4} \ \text{mile}$ journey is $\pounds 12.20$, what is the QMC?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the QMC $= q$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Quaters in} \ 6 \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text{miles} &= 6 \dfrac {1} {4} \times 4 \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {25} {4} \times 4 \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {25 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
                                                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 2.20 + (25 \times q)     &= \pounds 12.20 \\\\
25 \times q                      &= 12.20 - 2.20 \\\\
25 \times q                      &= 10 \\\\
q                                &= \pounds \dfrac {10} {25} \\\\
q                                &= \dfrac {10 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {25} \\\\
q                                &= \dfrac {10 \times 25 \times 4} {25} \\\\
q                                &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel {25} \times 4} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
q                                &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel {25} \times 4 \ \text{p}} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
q                                &= 4 \times 10 \\\\
q                                &= 40\ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40\ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out their total income that evening.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out their total income that evening.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 80 lots of fish and chips }   &= 80 \times (1.50 + 3.50) \\\\
                                            &= 80 \times 5 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 400 \\\\
\text{Cost of 70 lots of pie and chips }    &= 70 \times (2.00 + 1.50) \\\\
                                            &= 70 \times 3.50 \\\\
                                            &= 7 \times 10 \times 3.50 \\\\
                                            &= 7 \times 35 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 245 \\\\
\text{Cost of 50 lots of chips}             &= 50 \times 1.50 \\\\
                                            &= 5 \times 10 \times 1.50 \\\\
                                            &= 5 \times 15 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 75 \\\\
\text{Total Savings}                        &= 400 + 245 + 75 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 720 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 720$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 80 lots of fish and chips }   &= 80 \times (1.50 + 3.50) \\\\
                                            &= 80 \times 5 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 400 \\\\
\text{Cost of 70 lots of pie and chips }    &= 70 \times (2.00 + 1.50) \\\\
                                            &= 70 \times 3.50 \\\\
                                            &= 7 \times 10 \times 3.50 \\\\
                                            &= 7 \times 35 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 245 \\\\
\text{Cost of 50 lots of chips}             &= 50 \times 1.50 \\\\
                                            &= 5 \times 10 \times 1.50 \\\\
                                            &= 5 \times 15 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 75 \\\\
\text{Total Savings}                        &= 400 + 245 + 75 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 720 
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

**Question**

The owner bought two $25 \ \text{kilogram}$ bags of potatoes which cost $\pounds 40$ each for the chips.  

He paid $\pounds 2.00$ for each of the fish he sold and $\pounds 1.20$ for each of the pies.

How much did the food that the owner sold that evening cost him?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                                &= 80 + 160 +  (7 \times 12)  \\\\
                                &= 80 + 160 +  84 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 324
\end{aligned}
$

What are the **__TOTAL__** costs for the evening, including the food, the staff and the other materials?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                      &= \pounds 446 
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $\dfrac{3}{7}$ of a number is $18$, what is $\dfrac{5}{6}$ of the **same** number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $\dfrac{3}{7}$ of a number is $18$, what is $\dfrac{5}{6}$ of the **same** number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{3} {7} \times a &= 18 \\\\
a                      &= \dfrac {18 \times 7} {3} \\\\
a                      &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 7} {3} \\\\
a                      &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel{3} \times 7} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
a                      &= 6 \times 7 \\\\
a                      &= 42 \\\\
\dfrac {5} {6} \text{ of } a &= \dfrac {5} {6} \times 42 \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 42} {6}  \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times 6} {6}  \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times \cancel{6}} {\cancel{6}}  \\\\
&= 5 \times 7 \\\\
&= 35
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$35$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{3} {7} \times a &= 18 \\\\
a                      &= \dfrac {18 \times 7} {3} \\\\
a                      &= \dfrac {6 \times 3 \times 7} {3} \\\\
a                      &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel{3} \times 7} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
a                      &= 6 \times 7 \\\\
a                      &= 42 \\\\
\dfrac {5} {6} \text{ of } a &= \dfrac {5} {6} \times 42 \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 42} {6}  \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times 6} {6}  \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times \cancel{6}} {\cancel{6}}  \\\\
&= 5 \times 7 \\\\
&= 35
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Amna takes a test with $50$ questions. Four marks are given for each correct answer but one mark is taken off for each 
question she gets wrong. If Amna scores $168$ in the test and doesn't attempt $3$ questions at all, how many 
questions did she answer correctly? (There is no penalty for not attempting a question in this test that Amna takes.)

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Amna takes a test with $50$ questions. Four marks are given for each correct answer but one mark is taken off for each 
question she gets wrong. If Amna scores $168$ in the test and doesn't attempt $3$ questions at all, how many 
questions did she answer correctly? (There is no penalty for not attempting a question in this test that Amna takes.)
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Amna did not attempt $3$ questions, so she answered $50 - 3 = 47$ questions.

Let the number of questions Anna answered correctly $= a$

Number of incorrect questions $= 47 - a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 4 - (47 - a) \times 1              &= 168 \\\\
4a - 47 + a                                 &= 168 \\\\
5a                                          &= 168 + 47 \\\\
5a                                          &= 215 \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {215} {5} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {43 \times 5} {5} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {43 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a                                           &= 43
\end{aligned}
$

Number of correct answers $= 43$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$43$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Five friends raise $\pounds 400$ for their favourite charity. 
Alan collects $\pounds 74$  and Bilal raises $\pounds 86$. 
Chloe collects twice as much as David who raises three times as much as Emily. How much did Chloe collect?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Five friends raise $\pounds 400$ for their favourite charity. 
Alan collects $\pounds 74$  and Bilal raises $\pounds 86$. 
Chloe collects twice as much as David who raises three times as much as Emily. How much did Chloe collect?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let Emily's collection $= a$

David's collection $= 3a$

Chloe's collection $= 2 \times  3a = 6a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}  
74 + 86 + 6a + 3a + a   &= 400 \\\\
160 + 10a               &= 400 \\\\
10a                     &= 400 - 160 \\\\
10a                     &= 240 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {240} {10} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {24 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0}} \\\\
a                       &= \pounds 24 \\\\
\text{Chloe's collection} &= 6a \\\\
                          &= 6 \times 24 \\\\
                          &= \pounds 144
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 144$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If one cake and two biscuits provide $450 \ \text {calories}$ and two cakes and three biscuits provide $800 \ \text {calories}$, how many calories are provided by one biscuit?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If one cake and two biscuits provide $450 \ \text {calories}$ and two cakes and three biscuits provide $800 \ \text {calories}$, how many calories are provided by one biscuit?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the calories in one cake $= c$

Let the calories in one biscuit $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
c + 2b &= 450 \\\\
2c + 3b &= 800
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply the first equation by $2$.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2 \times c + 2 \times 2b &= 2 \times 450 \\\\
2c + 4b &= 900
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the second equation from this new equation to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned} 
(2c + 4b) - (2c + 3b) &= 900 - 800 \\\\
2c + 4b - 2c - 3b &= 100 \\\\
b &= 100 \ \text{calories}
\end{aligned}
$

Calories provided by one biscuit $= 100 \ \text{calories}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$100  \ \text {calories}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a bag of money to take to the bank I have only $5 \ \text{p}$, $10 \ \text{p}$ and $20 \ \text{p}$ coins.

I have twice as many $20 \ \text{p}$ coins as $10 \ \text{p}$ coins and half as many $5 \ \text{p}$ coins as $10 \ \text{p}$ coins.

If the bag contains $\pounds 15.75$, how many $20 \ \text{p}$ coins are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a bag of money to take to the bank I have only $5 \ \text{p}$, $10 \ \text{p}$ and $20 \ \text{p}$ coins.
<emptyline>
I have twice as many $20 \ \text{p}$ coins as $10 \ \text{p}$ coins and half as many $5 \ \text{p}$ coins as $10 \ \text{p}$ coins.
<emptyline>
If the bag contains $\pounds 15.75$, how many $20 \ \text{p}$ coins are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of $5 \ \text{p}$ coins $= c$

Number of $10 \ \text{p}$ coins $= 2c$

Number of $20 \ \text{p}$ coins $= 4c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}  
5 \ \text{p} \times c + 10 \ \text{p}  \times 2c + 20 \ \text{p} \times 4c    &= \pounds 15.75 \\\\
5 \ \text{p} \times c + 10 \ \text{p}  \times 2c + 20 \ \text{p} \times 4c    &= 1575 \ \text{p} \\\\
5c + 20c + 80c                                                          &= 1575 \\\\
105c                                                                    &= 1575 \\\\
c                                                                       &= \dfrac {1575} {105} \\\\
c                                                                       &= \dfrac {21 \times 5 \times 15} {21 \times 5} \\\\
c                                                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel{21} \times \cancel{5} \times 15} {\cancel{21} \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
c                                                                       &= 15 \\\\
\text{Number of }20 \ \text{p coins}             &= 4c \\\\
                                       &= 4 \times 15 \\\\
                                       &= 60
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$60$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alison buys $6$ cups of coffee which cost $\pounds 2.20$ each, $4$ glasses of juice which cost $\pounds 1.15$ each 
and some packets of crisps which cost $55 \ \text{p}$ each. She pays by giving the member of staff $\pounds 25$ and receives $\pounds 2.80$ in change.

Using this information, complete the bill below by filling in the five spaces

| $6$ cups of coffee costing $\pounds 2.20$ each         | $\pounds \ldots$   |
|:------------------------------------------------------:|:------------------:|
| $4$ glasses of juice costing $\pounds 1.15$ each       | $\pounds \ldots$   |
| $\ldots$ packets of crisps costing $55 \ \text{p}$ each  | $\pounds \ldots$ |
| Total                                                  | $\pounds \ldots$   |


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alison buys $6$ cups of coffee which cost $\pounds 2.20$ each, $4$ glasses of juice which cost $\pounds 1.15$ each 
and some packets of crisps which cost $55 \ \text{p}$ each. She pays by giving the member of staff $\pounds 25$ and receives $\pounds 2.80$ in change.
<emptyline>
Using this information, complete the bill below by filling in the five spaces
<emptyline>
| $6$ cups of coffee costing $\pounds 2.20$ each         | $\pounds \ldots$   |
|:------------------------------------------------------:|:------------------:|
| $4$ glasses of juice costing $\pounds 1.15$ each       | $\pounds \ldots$   |
| $\ldots$ packets of crisps costing $55 \ \text{p}$ each  | $\pounds \ldots$ |
| Total                                                  | $\pounds \ldots$   |
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of one packet of crisps $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}           &= 25 - 2.80 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 22.2 \\\\
\text{Total cost of coffee} &= 6 \times 2.20 \\\\
                            &= 6 \times 2.20 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 13.2 \\\\
\text{Total cost of juices} &= 4 \times 1.15 \\\\
                            &= 4 \times 1.15 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 4.6 
\end{aligned}
$

The cost of crisps is given in pence and the total cost is asked in pounds.Lets convert the costs of crisps in pounds.

$
\begin{aligned}
\pounds 4.6 + \pounds 13.2 + 55 \ \text{p} \times a                 &= \pounds 22.2   \\\\
\pounds 4.6 + \pounds 13.2 + \pounds \dfrac{55}{100}\times a      &= \pounds 22.2   \\\\
17.8 + 0.55 \times a                                              &= 22.2   \\\\
0.55 \times a                                                     &= 22.2 - 17.8  \\\\
0.55 \times a                                                     &= 4.4 \\\\
a                                                                 &= \dfrac{4.4}{0.55} \\\\
a                                                                 &= \dfrac{4.4 \times 100 }{0.55 \times 100} \\\\
a                                                                 &= \dfrac{440 }{55} \\\\
a                                                                 &= \dfrac{11 \times 5 \times 8}{11 \times 5} \\\\
a                                                                 &= \dfrac{\cancel {11} \times \cancel {5} \times 8}{\cancel {11} \times \cancel {5}} \\\\
a                                                                 &= \pounds 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 13.2 , \pounds 4.6, \pounds 8, \pounds 22.2$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Find the values of $d$ and $e$ for which $2^d \times 3^e = 144$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
2^d \times 3^e   &= 144 \\\\
2^d \times 3^e   &= 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3 \\\\
2^d \times 3^e   &= 2^4 \times 3^2
\end{aligned}
$

$d = 4$

$e = 2$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number in the following sum? 

$4060800 = 4000000 + \ldots + 800$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the missing number in the following sum? 
<emptyline>
$4060800 = 4000000 + \ldots + 800$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4060800                     &= 4000000 + a + 800 \\\\
a                           &= 4060800 - 4000000 - 800  \\\\
a                           &= 60000
\end{aligned}
$

Missing number is $= 60000$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$60000$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John thinks of a number. He multiplies that number by four and then adds three to the result. If the answer he obtains is $35$, what is the number he first thought of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John thinks of a number. He multiplies that number by four and then adds three to the result. If the answer he obtains is $35$, what is the number he first thought of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4a + 3    &= 35 \\\\
4a        &= 35 - 3 \\\\
4a        &= 32 \\\\
a         &= \dfrac {32} {4} \\\\
a         &= \dfrac {8 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a         &= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
a         &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 8$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two bottles of water and three small bags of fruit cost a total of $\pounds 2.55$. If a bottle of water costs $15 \ \text{p}$ **more** than a bag of fruit, what is the cost of a bag of fruit?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two bottles of water and three small bags of fruit cost a total of $\pounds 2.55$. If a bottle of water costs $15 \ \text{p}$ **more** than a bag of fruit, what is the cost of a bag of fruit?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a bag of fruit $= f$

Cost of a bottle of water $= f + 15$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times (f + 15) + 3 \times f    &= \pounds 2.55 \\\\
2 \times (f + 15) + 3 \times f    &= 255 \ \text{p} \\\\
2f + 30 + 3f               &= 255 \\\\
5f&= 255 - 30 \\\\
5f&= 225 \\\\
f &= \dfrac{225}{5} \\\\
f &= \dfrac{45 \times 5}{5} \\\\
f &= \dfrac{45 \times \cancel 5}{\cancel 5} \\\\
f &= 45 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a bag of fruit $= 45 \ \text{p}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$45 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Chen writes down a two digit number. He finds that if he swaps the digits of the number round, the new number he creates is three more than one third of the original number.

What was the **original** number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Chen writes down a two digit number. He finds that if he swaps the digits of the number round, the new number he creates is three more than one third of the original number.
<emptyline>
What was the **original** number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

original no. = a number between $11$ and $99$ ($2$ digits)

original no.  $>$ new number

the original no., the new number and $\dfrac {1}{3}$
are all multiples of $3$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Trial and error method

$12$ is the smallest $2$ digit number which is a multiple of $3$

certain combinations can be ruled out as the reverse is not near to $\dfrac {1}{3}$ of the original number

possible combinations:

$
\begin{aligned}
\quad \cancel{12-21}, \ 15-51, \ \cancel{18-81},\\\\ 
\cancel{24-42},\ 27-72, \ \cancel{36-63},\\\\
\cancel{39-93}, \ \cancel{45-54}, \ \cancel{48-84}
\end{aligned}
$

Let's try combination $1$ : $15$ and $51$ 

original number = $51$

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {51}{3}  &= 17\\\\
17 + 3          &= 20 \text{ (wrong)}
\end{aligned}
$

Let's try combination $2$ : $27$ and $72$ 

original number = $72$

So reverse no. is,

$
\begin{aligned}
&=\dfrac {72}{3}+3\\\\
&= 27
\end{aligned}
$

$27$ and $472$ is the right combination. So $72$ is the original number.
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the two digit number be $xy$

$x$ in the tenth place and $y$ in the unit place.

The original no. $= 10x + y$

The swapped no.  $= 10y + x$

As per the question, the new number is $3$ more than $\dfrac {1}{3}$ of the original number. 

The swapped no. $= 3 + \dfrac {(10y + x)}{3}$

i.e.  $= 10y + x = 3 + \dfrac {(10y + x)}{3}$

Let's solve

$
\begin{aligned}
3 + \dfrac{(10x + y)}{3} &= 10y + x \\\\
\dfrac{9 + (10x + y)}{3} &= 10y + x \\\\
           9 + (10x + y) &= (10y + x) \times 3 \\\\
             9 + 10x + y &= 30y + 3x \\\\
    9 + 10x + y -30y -3x &= 0 \\\\
            9 + 7x - 29y &= 0 \\\\
                 7x -29y &= -9 
\end{aligned}
$

The values $x$ and $y$ are between $0$ to $9$

On substituting the only possibility that matches

$
\begin{aligned}
 x                               &= 7 \\\\
 y                               &= 2 \\\\
(7 \times 7) - (29 \times 2)     &= -9 \\\\
49 - 58                          &= -9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$72$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In fact, M-power also have to add $5\%$ to Andrew's bill which is the tax known as VAT. What will be the **final** bill that Andrew has to pay for his gas?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In fact, M-power also have to add $5\%$ to Andrew's bill which is the tax known as VAT. What will be the **final** bill that Andrew has to pay for his gas?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Final Bill}       &= \text{Total bill} + \text{VAT} \\\\ 
                        &= 276.60 + (5 \% \ \text {of } 276.60) \\\\
                        &= 276.60 + (5 \% \times 276.60) \\\\
                        &= 276.60 + (\dfrac {5} {100} \times 276.60) \\\\
                        &= 276.60 + (\dfrac {276.60 \times 5}{100}) \\\\
                        &= 276.60 + \dfrac {1383} {100} \\\\
                        &= 276.60 + 13.83 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 290.43
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 290.43$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A particular two digit number is blasted and then that answer is also Blasted. If the final answer is $9$, what was the **original** number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A particular two digit number is blasted and then that answer is also Blasted. If the final answer is $9$, what was the **original** number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's first find $9$ is a blast of which two digit number,

$
\begin{aligned}
9       &= 3 \times 3 \\\\
9       &= 3^2
\end{aligned}
$

$9$ is a blast of $32$

Now, we need to find $32$ is a blast of which two digit number to find our original number,

$
\begin{aligned}
32      &= 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \\\\
32      &= 2^5
\end{aligned}
$

$32$ is a blast of $25$

The original number is $25$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$25$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a plant is $1 \ \text{metre}$ tall at the end of the first month, how tall will it be after five months?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a plant is $1 \ \text{metre}$ tall at the end of the first month, how tall will it be after five months?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

To find out the height of the plant after five months, we should know the height of plant at the end of first, second, third and fourth month.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Height of the plant at the end of the first month}       &= 1 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text {Height of the plant at the end of the second month}      &= 1 + \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 1 \\\\
                                                                &= 1 + \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {1 \times 2} {1 \times 2} + \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {2} {2} + \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {2 + 1} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= 1.5 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text {Height of the plant at the end of the third month}       &= 1.5 + \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text {of} \ 1.5 \\\\
                                                                &= 1.5 + \dfrac {1} {3} \times 1.5 \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {3} {6} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {3} {2} + \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {3 + 1} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {4} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= 2 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text {Height of the plant at the end of the fourth month}      &= 2 + \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text {of} \ 2 \\\\
                                                                &= 2 + \dfrac {1} {4} \times 2 \\\\
                                                                &= 2 + \dfrac {2} {4} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 4} {1 \times 4} + \dfrac {2} {4} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {8} {4} + \dfrac {2} {4} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {8 + 2} {4} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {10} {4} \\\\
                                                                &= 2.5 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text {Height of the plant at the end of the fifth month}       &= 2.5 + \dfrac {1} {5} \ \text {of} \ 2.5 \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {5} {2} + \dfrac {1} {5} \times \dfrac {5} {2} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {5} {2} + \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 5} {2 \times 5} + \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {25} {10} + \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {25 + 5} {10} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {30} {10} \\\\
                                                                &= \dfrac {3 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0}} \\\\
                                                                &= 3 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

The plant will be $3 \ \text{m}$ tall after five months.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a plant **grows** $90 \ \text{cm}$ in the third month, how tall was it after one month?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a plant **grows** $90 \ \text{cm}$ in the third month, how tall was it after one month?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the size of plant at the end of first month $= a$

Size of plant at the end of second month $= a + \dfrac {1} {2} \times a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{1}{3} \times \text {Size of plant at the end of second month}    &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{3} \times (a + \dfrac {1} {2} \times a)                       &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{3} \times (a + \dfrac {a} {2})                                &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{3} \times (\dfrac {a \times 2} {1 \times 2} + \dfrac {a} {2}) &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{3} \times (\dfrac {2a} {2} + \dfrac {a} {2})                  &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{3} \times \dfrac {2a + a} {2}                                 &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac{1}{3} \times \dfrac {3a} {2}                                     &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac {3a} {3 \times 2}                                                &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac {3 \times a} {3 \times 2}                                        &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel{3} \times a} {\cancel{3} \times 2}                      &= 90 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {2}                                                          &= 90 \\\\
a                                                                       &= 90 \times 2 \\\\
a                                                                       &= 180 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

The plant was $180 \ \text{cm}$ tall after one month.

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a plant is $2 \ \text{metres}$ tall at the end of the first month, **how much will it have grown**, in total, by the end of the fifth month?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a plant is $2 \ \text{metres}$ tall at the end of the first month, **how much will it have grown**, in total, by the end of the fifth month?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Height of the tree at the end of first month}  &= 2 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Height of the tree at the end of second month} &= 2 + 2 \times \dfrac {1}{2}\\\\
                                                     &= 2 + 1 \\\\
                                                     &= 3 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Height of the tree at the end of third month}  &= 3 + 3 \times \dfrac {1}{3}\\\\
                                                     &= 3 + 1 \\\\
                                                     &= 4 \ \text{m} \\
\text{Height of the tree at the end of fourth month} &= 4 + 4 \times \dfrac {1}{4}\\\\
                                                     &= 4 + 1 \\\\
                                                     &= 5 \ \text{m} \\
\text{Height of the tree at the end of fifth month}  &= 5 + 5 \times \dfrac {1}{5}\\\\
                                                     &= 5 + 1 \\\\
                                                     &= 6 \ \text{m} 
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total growth from end of first month to end of fifth month}  &= 6 - 2 \\\\
                                                                    &= 4 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

Work out the density of a forearm of length $30 \ \text{cm}$, with a radius of $2 \ \text{cm}$ which weighs $480 \ \text{g}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the density of a forearm of length $30 \ \text{cm}$, with a radius of $2 \ \text{cm}$ which weighs $480 \ \text{g}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
30 \times 2 \times 2 \times D &= 480 \\\\
120 \times D                  &= 480 \\\\
D                             &= \dfrac{480}{120} \\\\
D                             &= \dfrac{120 \times 4}{120} \\\\
D                             &= \dfrac{\cancel {120} \times 4}{\cancel {120}} \\\\
D                             &= 4 
\end{aligned}
$

Density of forearm $= 4$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Work out the radius of a thigh bone of length $50 \ \text{cm}$ which has a density of $8$ and weighs $3600 \ \text{g}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the radius of a thigh bone of length $50 \ \text{cm}$ which has a density of $8$ and weighs $3600 \ \text{g}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
50 \times R \times R \times 8   &= 3600 \\\\
50 \times R^2 \times 8          &= 3600 \\\\
400 \times R^2                  &= 3600 \\\\
R^2                             &= \dfrac{3600}{400} \\\\
R^2                             &= \dfrac{400 \times 9}{400} \\\\
R^2                             &= \dfrac{\cancel {400} \times 9}{\cancel {400}} \\\\
R^2                             &= 9 \\\\
R                               &= \sqrt{9} \\\\
R                               &= 3 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Radius of the thigh bone$= 3 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A pair of numbers written as a column like this $\dbinom {5}{2}$ is known as a $\text{VEC}$.

$\text{VECs}$ can be combined together in two different ways, as follows

$\dbinom {5}{2} \ldotp \dbinom {6}{7} = 5 \times 6 + 2 \times 7 = 30 + 14 = 44$

$\dbinom {5}{2} \wedge \dbinom {6}{7} = 5 \times 7 - 2 \times 6 = 35 - 12 = 23$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A pair of numbers written as a column like this $\dbinom {5}{2}$ is known as a $\text{VEC}$.
<emptyline>
$\text{VECs}$ can be combined together in two different ways, as follows
<emptyline>
$\dbinom {5}{2} \ldotp \dbinom {6}{7} = 5 \times 6 + 2 \times 7 = 30 + 14 = 44$
<emptyline>
$\dbinom {5}{2} \wedge \dbinom {6}{7} = 5 \times 7 - 2 \times 6 = 35 - 12 = 23$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

p                              &= 2

**Question**

Find the value of t if $\dbinom {12}{t} \wedge  \dbinom {t}{8} = 47$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the value of t if $\dbinom {12}{t} \wedge  \dbinom {t}{8} = 47$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
(12 \times 8) - (t \times t)  &= 47  \\\\
96 - t^2                      &= 47  \\\\
t^2                           &= 96 - 47  \\\\
t^2                           &= 49 \\\\ 
t                             &= \sqrt{49} \\\\ 
t                             &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

$(8 + \boxed{\phantom{5}} )\times 7 =91$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$(8 + \boxed{\phantom{5}} )\times 7 =91$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Let the missing number $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(8 + a)\times 7     &= 91 \\\\
8 + a               &= \dfrac {91} {7} \\\\ 
8 + a               &= \dfrac {7 \times 13} {7} \\\\
8 + a               &= \dfrac {\cancel {7} \times 13} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
8 + a               &= 13 \\\\
a                   &= 13 - 8 \\\\
a                   &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

                                &= \pounds 5
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the missing numbers so that the answer is always $56$

![papers/the-perse-school/sample/specimen-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-perse-school/sample/specimen-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png "papers/the-perse-school/sample/specimen-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the missing numbers so that the answer is always $56$
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

*ABBR: TODO:: Add drawing starts.*

{/* ![missing image](/papers/missing_image.svg) */}
TODOIMAGE


*TODO:: Add the image with variable written in the missing place according to the solution. Like: in 17 + ... write a, in 131 - ... write b, and so on.*

*ABBR: TODO:: Add drawing ends.*


Let the missing number $= a, b, c, d, e$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
17 + a                                                  &= 56 \\\\
a                                                       &= 56 - 17 \\\\
a                                                       &= 39 \\\\
131 - b                                                 &= 56 \\\\
b                                                       &= 131 - 56 \\\\
b                                                       &= 75 \\\\
50 \% \ \text{of} \ c                                   &= 56 \\\\
\dfrac {50} {100} \times c                              &= 56 \\\\
\dfrac {50} {50 \times 2} \times c                      &= 56 \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel {50}} {\cancel {50} \times 2} \times c  &= 56 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {2} \times c                                 &= 56 \\\\
c                                                       &= 56 \times 2 \\\\
c                                                       &= 112 \\\\
560 \div d                                              &= 56 \\\\
d                                                       &= \dfrac {560} {56}  \\\\
d                                                       &= \dfrac {56 \times 10} {56}  \\\\
d                                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {56} \times 10} {\cancel {56}}  \\\\
d                                                       &= 10 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {2} \times e                                 &= 56 \\\\
e                                                       &= 56 \times 2 \\\\
e                                                       &= 112

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ben wants to buy $17$ small bottles of drink for a party. A shop sells them at: $15 \ \text{p}$ for $1$ bottle; $28 \ \text{p}$ for two bottles; $60 \ \text{p}$ for  two bottles; $60 \ \text{p}$ for a pack of $5$ bottles. What is the smallest amount of money he needs to spend?  [Give your answer in $\pounds$]

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ben wants to buy $17$ small bottles of drink for a party. A shop sells them at: $15 \ \text{p}$ for $1$ bottle; $28 \ \text{p}$ for two bottles; $60 \ \text{p}$ for  two bottles; $60 \ \text{p}$ for a pack of $5$ bottles. What is the smallest amount of money he needs to spend?  [Give your answer in $\pounds$]
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To spend the smallest amount Ben needs to buy maximum possible pack of 5 bottles.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Bottles needed} &= 17 \\\\
                      &= 15 \ \text {bottles} + 2 \ \text {bottles} \\\\
                      &= 3 \times 5 \ \text {pack} + 1 \times 2 \ \text {pack}
\end{aligned}
$

Let's calculate the amount of money he needs to spend.

The costs are given in pence and the answer is required in pounds. Lets convert all the costs into pounds.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Smallest amount he spends}    &= 3 \times \text{Cost of 5 packs} + 1 \times \text{Cost of 2 packs} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 60 \ \text{p} + 1 \times 28 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times \pounds \dfrac{60}{100} + 1 \times \pounds \dfrac {28}{100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac{180}{100} + \dfrac{28}{100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {208} {100} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 2.08
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2.08$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On the planet Zog, all numbers are written with the digits in reverse order. For example, forty-five is written as $54$. Pluto, an inhabitant of Zog, was given the subtraction $729-26$. If no mistakes were made, what answer did Pluto write down?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}
&= 729 - 26 \\\\

\end{aligned}

**Question**

The same number if missing from all three boxes.

Write the same missing number in each box.

$\boxed{\phantom{15}} \quad \times \quad \boxed{\phantom{15}} \quad \times \quad \boxed{\phantom{15}} \quad = \quad 512$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I am five years older than my brother. Our ages add up to $23$. How old am I? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am five years older than my brother. Our ages add up to $23$. How old am I? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the age $=a$

Brother's age $= a - 5$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (a - 5)                                   &= 23 \\\\
2a - 5                                      &= 23 \\\\
2a                                          &= 23 + 5 \\\\
2a                                          &= 28 \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {28} {2} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {2 \times 14} {2} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 14} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                                           &= 14 \ \text {years}
\end{aligned}
$

Age $= 14$ years
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$14 \ \text {years}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bob's bucket weighs $21\,\text{kg}$ when full of water. After he pours half the water from the bucket, it weighs $12\,\text{kg}$. What is the weight of the empty bucket?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bob's bucket weighs $21\,\text{kg}$ when full of water. After he pours half the water from the bucket, it weighs $12\,\text{kg}$. What is the weight of the empty bucket?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of the water $= w$

Let the weight of the bucket $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
w + b              &= 21 \\\\
\dfrac{w}{2} + b   &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

Let's subtract the second equation from the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
w + b - (\dfrac{w}{2} + b)  &= 21 - 12 \\\\
w + b - \dfrac{w}{2} - b    &= 9 \\\\
\dfrac{w}{2}                &= 9 \\\\
w                           &= 9 \times 2 \\\\
w                           &= 18 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $w$ in the first equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
w + b                       &= 21 \\\\
18 + b                      &= 21 \\\\
b                           &= 21 - 18 \\\\
b                           &= 3 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of the empty bucket $= 3 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Find the distance from $A$ to $B$ in centimetres.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the distance from $A$ to $B$ in centimetres.
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the distance from $B$ to $C = d$

Distance from $A$ to $B = 4d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4d + d                                  &= 80 \\\\
5d                                      &= 80 \\\\
d                                       &= \dfrac {80} {5} \\\\
d                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 16} {5} \\\\
d                                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 16} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
d                                       &= 16 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Distance A to B} &= 4d \\\\
                            &= 4 \times 16 \\\\
                            &= 64 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$t \times 0.805 = 8050$

What is the value of $t$? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$t \times 0.805 = 8050$
<emptyline>
What is the value of $t$? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
t \times 0.805 &= 8050 \\\\
t &= \dfrac{8050}{0.805} \\\\
t &= \dfrac{8050 \times 1000}{0.805 \times 1000} \\\\
t &= \dfrac{805 \times 10 \times 1000}{805} \\\\
t &= \dfrac{\cancel{805} \times 10 \times 1000}{\cancel{805}} \\\\
t                   &= 10000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10000$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$x+\dfrac{1}{3}=1\dfrac{1}{4}$

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$x+\dfrac{1}{3}=1\dfrac{1}{4}$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

x + \dfrac {1} {3}                   &= 1 \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\

x                                    &= \dfrac {15} {12} - \dfrac {4} {12} \\\\
x                                    &= \dfrac {15 - 4} {12} \\\\
x                                    &= \dfrac {11} {12}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On the ski slopes the depth of the snow is $160\,\text{cm}$ and each day $3\,\text{cm}$ melts. After how many days will the depth of snow have fallen to $124\,\text{cm}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On the ski slopes the depth of the snow is $160\,\text{cm}$ and each day $3\,\text{cm}$ melts. After how many days will the depth of snow have fallen to $124\,\text{cm}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of days $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
160 - 3d &= 124 \\\\
3d &= 160 - 124 \\\\
3d &= 36 \\\\
d &= \dfrac{36}{3} \\\\
d &= \dfrac{12 \times 3}{3} \\\\
d &= \dfrac{12 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
d &= 12 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Number of days $=12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Granddad spends one quarter of his weekly pension on a Friday night out, and one third of what remains on a Saturday night. What fraction of his weekend pension is left for him to spend during the rest of the week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Granddad spends one quarter of his weekly pension on a Friday night out, and one third of what remains on a Saturday night. What fraction of his weekend pension is left for him to spend during the rest of the week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weekly pension $= p$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Spent on Friday}     &= \dfrac{p}{4} \\\\
\text{Remaining}           &= p - \dfrac{p}{4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{3p}{4} \\\\
\text{Spent on Saturday}   &= \dfrac{1}{3} \times \text{Remaining} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{1}{3} \times \dfrac{3p}{4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{3 \times p}{3 \times 4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times p}{\cancel{3} \times 4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{p}{4} \\\\
\text{Pension left}        &= \text{Remaining} - \text{Spent on Saturday} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{3p}{4}  - \dfrac{p}{4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{2p}{4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{2 \times p}{2 \times 2} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times p}{\cancel{2} \times 2} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac{p}{2}
\end{aligned}
$

Fraction left $= \dfrac{1}{2}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{1} {2}$

</div>
</div>
