<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the values of $A$, $B$ and $C$ in the following addition sum.

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
&         &     C      &   6   &   7       \\
&         &     7      &   4   &   A       \\ 
&    +    &     8      &   B   &   4       \\
\hline
&    2    &     0      &   0   &   6     
\end{array}
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the values of $A$, $B$ and $C$ in the following addition sum.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
&         &     C      &   6   &   7       \\
&         &     7      &   4   &   A       \\ 
&    +    &     8      &   B   &   4       \\
\hline
&    2    &     0      &   0   &   6     
\end{array}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
7 + A + 4  &= 16 \\\\
11 + A     &= 16 \\\\
A          &= 16 - 11 \\\\
A          &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
6 + 4 + B  &= 20 \\\\
10 + B     &= 20 \\\\
B          &= 20 - 10 \\\\
B          &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
C + 7 + 8  &= 22 \\\\
15 + C     &= 22 \\\\
C          &= 22 - 15 \\\\
C          &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5, 10, 7$

</div>
</div>

10 + B     &= 20 \\\\
B          &= 20 - 10 \\\\
B          &= 10
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
C + 7 + 8  &= 22 \\\\
15 + C     &= 22 \\\\
C          &= 22 - 15 \\\\
C          &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I have $3$ cats - Fred, Gary and Harry. When I weigh Fred and Gary they come to $12\,\text{kg}$ more than Harry. When I weigh Gary and Harry they weigh $8\,\text{kg}$ more than Fred and when I weigh Fred and Harry they weigh $14\,\text{kg}$ more than Gary. What is the combined weight of all three cats?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I have $3$ cats - Fred, Gary and Harry. When I weigh Fred and Gary they come to $12\,\text{kg}$ more than Harry. When I weigh Gary and Harry they weigh $8\,\text{kg}$ more than Fred and when I weigh Fred and Harry they weigh $14\,\text{kg}$ more than Gary. What is the combined weight of all three cats?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of Fred $= f$

Let the weight of Gary $= g$

Let the weight of Harry $= h$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
f + g &= h + 12 \\\\
g + h &= f + 8 \\\\
f + h &= g + 14
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add all three equations together.

$
\begin{aligned}
(f + g) + (g + h) + (f + h) &= (h + 12) + (f + 8) + (g + 14) \\\\
2f + 2g + 2h                &= f + g + h + 12 + 8 + 14 \\\\
2f + 2g + 2h -f - g - h    &= 34 \\\\
f + g + h                   &= 34 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Combined weight $= 34 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$34$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Aled had $67$ marbles when he went to school. He gave $19$ to his best friend Owen. He did a swap with Jess giving her $5$ coloured ones in exchange for $9$ plain ones. Then he played marbles with Meg and won $27$ marbles and played with Ben and lost $34$ marbles. How many marbles did he have when he got home?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Aled had $67$ marbles when he went to school. He gave $19$ to his best friend Owen. He did a swap with Jess giving her $5$ coloured ones in exchange for $9$ plain ones. Then he played marbles with Meg and won $27$ marbles and played with Ben and lost $34$ marbles. How many marbles did he have when he got home?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Initial number of marbles $= 67$

Changes in marbles:

Given to Owen: $-19$

Swap with Jess: $-5 + 9$

Won from Meg: $27$

Lost to Ben: $-34$

Total number of marbles at the end:

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Final marbles} &= 67 - 19 - 5 + 9 + 27 - 34 \\\\
&= 45
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a CD $= c$

Let the cost of a DVD $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4c + 2d &= 46 \\\\
3c + 2d &= 39
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Lets eliminate to reduce it to just one variable.

Subtract the second equation from the first to eliminate $d$.

$
\begin{aligned}
(4c + 2d) - (3c + 2d) &= 46 - 39 \\\\
4c - 3c &= 7 \\\\
c &= \pounds 7
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of one CD $= \pounds 7$
</div>
</div>

Substitute the value of $c$ into the second equation.

$
\begin{aligned}
3c + 2d &= 39 \\\\
3 \times 7 + 2d &= 39 \\\\

2d &= 39 - 21 \\\\
2d &= 18 \\\\
d &= \dfrac{18}{2} \\\\
d &= \pounds 9
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of one DVD $= \pounds 9$
</div>

**Question**

From the top of a planetary mountain, height $H \ \text{km}$, the angle $A$ degrees between the horizontal and the horizon is connected to the radius $R \ \text{km}$ of the planet by the formula 

$R=H\begin{pmatrix}
   \dfrac {6570}{A^2}-1
\end{pmatrix}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

R             &= 9 \times (683.66 - 1) \\\\
R             &= 9 \times 682.66  \\\\
R             &= 6143.96 
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

H             &\approx 4
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

If $R = 8500$ and $H = 7.8$, find $A$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $R = 8500$ and $H = 7.8$, find $A$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
R                                    &= H \times (\dfrac{6570}{A^2} -1 ) \\\\
8500                                 &= 7.8 \times (\dfrac{6570}{A^2} -1 ) \\\\
7.8 \times (\dfrac{6570}{A^2} -1 )   &= 8500 \\\\
\dfrac{6570}{A^2} -1                 &= \dfrac{8500}{7.8} \\\\
\dfrac{6570}{A^2} -1                 &= 1089.74 \\\\
\dfrac{6570}{A^2}                    &= 1090+ 1\\\\
\dfrac{6570}{A^2}                    &= 1091 \\\\
\dfrac{6570}{1091}                   &= A^2 \\\\
A^2                                  &= \dfrac{6570}{1091} \\\\
A^2                                  & \approx 6 \\\\
A                                    &= \sqrt{6} \\\\
A                                    &= 2.4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Solve the simultaneous equations:

$\dfrac{1}{2}x+\dfrac{1}{3}y=\dfrac{1}{4}$ 

$2x + 3y = 4$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Solve the simultaneous equations:
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{1}{2}x+\dfrac{1}{3}y=\dfrac{1}{4}$ 
<emptyline>
$2x + 3y = 4$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{1}{2}x+\dfrac{1}{3}y    &= \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
2x + 3y                        &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply the first equation by $4$.

$
\begin{aligned} 
4 \times \dfrac{1}{2}x + 4 \times \dfrac{1}{3}y                             &= 4 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
\dfrac{2 \times 2 }{2}x + 4 \times \dfrac{1}{3}y                            &= \cancel 4 \times \dfrac{1}{\cancel 4} \\\\
\dfrac{\cancel 2 \times 2}{\cancel 2}x + 4 \times \dfrac{1}{3}y             &= 1 \\\\
2x + \dfrac{4}{3}y                                                          &= 1
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the above equation from the second equation to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2x + 3y - (2x + \dfrac{4y}{3} )                                  &= 4 - 1 \\\\
2x + 3y - 2x - \dfrac{4y}{3}                                     &= 3 \\\\
3y - \dfrac{4y}{3}                                               &= 3 \\\\ 
\dfrac{3y \times 3}{1 \times 3} - \dfrac{4y}{3}                  &= 3 \\\\
\dfrac{9y - 4y}{3}                                               &= 3 \\\\
\dfrac{5y}{3}                                                     &= 3 \\\\
y                                                                &= \dfrac{3 \times 3}{5} \\\\
y                                                                &= \dfrac{9}{5} \\\\
y                                                                &= 1.8
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $y$ in one of the equations.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2x + 3y            &= 4 \\\\
2x + 3 \times 1.8  &= 4 \\\\
2x                 &= 4 - 5.4 \\\\
2x                 &= -1.4 \\\\
x                  &= \dfrac{1.4}{2} \\\\  
x                  &= \dfrac{1.4 \times 10 }{2 \times 10} \\\\
x                  &= -\dfrac{14 }{2 \times 10} \\\\  
x                  &= -\dfrac{2 \times 7 }{2 \times 10} \\\\ 
x                  &= -\dfrac{\cancel 2 \times 7 }{\cancel 2 \times 10} \\\\
x                  &= -\dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
x                  &= -0.7                                                   
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$-0.7, 1.8$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

One piece is $20$ times the length of the other.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

**Working**

Let the length of first piece $=a$

Length of second piece $= 20a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 20a      &= 231 \\\\
21a          &= 231 \\\\
a            &= \dfrac{231}{21} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac{21 \times 11}{21} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac{\cancel {21} \times 11}{\cancel {21}} \\\\
a            &= 11 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text {First piece} &=11 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Second piece} &= 20 \times a \\\\
                              &= 20 \times 11 \\\\
                              &= 220 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

Let the length of first piece $=a$

Length of second piece $=100 + 20 = 120 \% \times a = 1.2a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 1.2a                                  &= 231 \\\\
2.2a                                     &= 231 \\\\
a                                        &= \dfrac{231}{2.2} \\\\
a                                        &= \dfrac{231 \times 10}{2.2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                        &= \dfrac{2310}{22} \\\\
a                                        &= \dfrac{11 \times 2 \times 105}{11 \times 2} \\\\
a                                        &= \dfrac{\cancel {11} \times \cancel 2 \times 105}{\cancel {11} \times \cancel 2} \\\\
a                                        &= 105 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{First piece} &= 105 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Second piece} &= 1.2a \\\\
                              &= 1.2 \times 105 \\\\
                              &= 126 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When two fifths of the class are absent, there are $18$ pupil; present. What is the total number of pupils in the class?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When two fifths of the class are absent, there are $18$ pupil; present. What is the total number of pupils in the class?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of pupils in the class $= p$

If two fifths are absent, then the pupils present are $1 - \dfrac {2} {5} = \dfrac {3} {5}$ of the class.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {5} \times p &= 18 \\\\
\dfrac {3p} {5} &= 18 \\\\
p &= \dfrac {18 \times 5} {3} \\\\
p &= \dfrac {3 \times 6 \times 5} {3} \\\\
p &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 6 \times 5} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
p &= 6 \times 5 \\\\
p &= 30
\end{aligned}
$

Total pupils  = $30$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$30$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Each time Peter runs around the school, he travels $\dfrac {1} {4}$ $\text{mile}$. How many times would he need to go around the school to run a total of $3.75\, \text{miles}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</code></pre>
</div>

$
\begin{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Simon is asked to add $15$ to a number and then multiply by $3$. By mistake he first multiplies by $3$ and then adds $15$.

If he gets the answer $105$ what number did he start with and what answer should he have obtained?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Simon is asked to add $15$ to a number and then multiply by $3$. By mistake he first multiplies by $3$ and then adds $15$.
<emptyline>
If he gets the answer $105$ what number did he start with and what answer should he have obtained?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question, 

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \times a + 15             &= 105 \\\\
3a + 15                     &= 105 \\\\
3a                          &= 105 - 15 \\\\
3a                          &= 90 \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {90} {3} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 30} {3} \\\\
a                           &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 30} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
a                           &= 30 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A two litre bottle of lemonade costs $\pounds 1 .44$; a one and half litre  bottle costs $\pounds 1 .05$. Which seems to be better value for money - explain how you decided on your answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A two litre bottle of lemonade costs $\pounds 1 .44$; a one and half litre  bottle costs $\pounds 1 .05$. Which seems to be better value for money - explain how you decided on your answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

First case :

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of 2 litre bottle}   &= 1.44 \\\\
\text{Cost of one litre bottle}  &= \dfrac{1.44}{2} \\\\
                                 &=  \dfrac{1.44}{2} \\\\
                                 &=  \dfrac{1.44 \times 100}{2 \times 100} \\\\ 
                                 &=  \dfrac{144}{2 \times 100} \\\\
                                 &=  \dfrac{72 \times 2}{2 \times 100} \\\\ 
                                 &=  \dfrac{72 \times \cancel 2}{\cancel 2 \times 100} \\\\ 
                                 &=  \dfrac{72}{100} \\\\
                                 &=  \pounds 0.72
\end{aligned}
$

Second case :

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost of one and a half litre bottle} &= 1.05 \\\\
\text{Cost of one litre bottle}             &= \dfrac{1.05 \times 2}{3} \\\\
                                            &=  \dfrac{1.05 \times 2}{3} \\\\
                                            &=  \dfrac{1.05 \times 2 \times 100}{3 \times 100} \\\\ 
                                            &=  \dfrac{105 \times 2}{3 \times 100} \\\\
                                            &=  \dfrac{35 \times 3 \times 2}{3 \times 100} \\\\ 
                                            &=  \dfrac{35 \times \cancel 3 \times 2}{\cancel 3 \times 100} \\\\ 
                                            &=  \dfrac{35 \times 2}{100} \\\\
                                            &=  \dfrac{70}{100} \\\\
                                            &=  \pounds 0.7
\end{aligned}
$

Second option seems to be the better value for money.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.05$

</div>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I think of a number, add $4$ and then multiply by $3$. The result is $63$. What was the number I thought of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number, add $4$ and then multiply by $3$. The result is $63$. What was the number I thought of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number$= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 4) \times 3              &= 63 \\\\
a + 4                        &= \dfrac {63} {3} \\\\
a + 4                       &= \dfrac {21 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a + 4                       &= \dfrac {21 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
a + 4                        &= 21 \\\\
a                            &= 21 - 4 \\\\
a                             &= 17
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 17$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$17$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Edward has a sum of money. He gives one-third to his son George and three-fifths to his daughter Olivia. If George receives $\pounds 15$, how much does Olivia receive? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Edward has a sum of money. He gives one-third to his son George and three-fifths to his daughter Olivia. If George receives $\pounds 15$, how much does Olivia receive? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total sum of money $= a$

George's share $= \dfrac{a}{3}$

Olivia's share $= \dfrac{3a}{5}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {3}                      &= 15 \\\\
a                                   &= 15 \times 3 \\\\
a                                   &= \pounds 45 \\\\

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A minibus costs $\pounds 80$ to hire for the day. Tickets for the theme park cost $\pounds 15$ each. Write a formula for the total cost $'C'$ of hiring $'m'$ minibuses and purchasing $'t'$ tickets.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A minibus costs $\pounds 80$ to hire for the day. Tickets for the theme park cost $\pounds 15$ each. Write a formula for the total cost $'C'$ of hiring $'m'$ minibuses and purchasing $'t'$ tickets.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost per 1 minibus}                &= \pounds 80 \\\\
\text{Cost per } m \text{ minibuses}      &= 80 \times m  \\\\
                                          &= \pounds 80m \\\\
\text {Cost per 1 ticket}                 &= \pounds 15 \\\\
\text{Cost per } t \text{ tickets}        &= 15 \times t \\\\ 
                                          &= \pounds 15t \\\\
\text {Total cost }  C                    &= 80m + 15t
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$80m + 15t$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost per 1 minibus}                &= \pounds 80 \\\\
\text{Cost per } m \text{ minibuses}      &= 80 \times m  \\\\
                                          &= \pounds 80m \\\\
\text {Cost per 1 ticket}                 &= \pounds 15 \\\\
\text{Cost per } t \text{ tickets}        &= 15 \times t \\\\ 
                                          &= \pounds 15t \\\\
\text {Total cost }  C                    &= 80m + 15t
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

**Question**

$5x - 3 = 12$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$5x - 3 = 12$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
5x - 3      &= 12 \\\\
5x          &= 12 + 3 \\\\
5x          &= 15 \\\\
x           &= \dfrac{15} {5} \\\\
x           &= \dfrac{5 \times 3} {5} \\\\
x           &= \dfrac{\cancel {5} \times 3} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
x           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Hareni has twice as many sweets as Dora. 
After eating $18$ sweets each, she has five times as many as Dora. How many sweets did Hareni start with?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Hareni has twice as many sweets as Dora. 
After eating $18$ sweets each, she has five times as many as Dora. How many sweets did Hareni start with?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let at the start number of sweets Dora has $= a$

Number of sweets Hareni has $= 2a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \times (a - 18)       &= 2a - 18 \\\\
5a - 5 \times 18        &= 2a - 18 \\\\
5a - 90                 &= 2a - 18 \\\\
5a - 2a                 &= 90 - 18 \\\\
3a                      &= 72 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {72} {3} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {3 \times 24} {3} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 24} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                       &= 24
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sweets Hareni has initially}       &= 24 \times 2 \\\\
                                         &= 48
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Three cereal bars, two apples and one tube of mints cost $\pounds 3.14$.

Two cereal bars, three apples and four tube of mints cost $\pounds 4.21$.

What is the total cost of buying one cereal bar, one apple and one tube of mints?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Three cereal bars, two apples and one tube of mints cost $\pounds 3.14$.
<emptyline>
Two cereal bars, three apples and four tube of mints cost $\pounds 4.21$.
<emptyline>
What is the total cost of buying one cereal bar, one apple and one tube of mints?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the price of one cereal bar $= c$ 

Price of one apple $= a$

Price of one tube of mint $= m$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3c + 2a + m             &= 3.14 \\\\
2c + 3a + 4m            &= 4.21
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add both the equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
3c + 2a + m + 2c + 3a + 4m          &= 3.14 + 4.21 \\\\
5c + 5a + 5m                        &= 7.35 \\\\
5 \times (c + a + m)                       &= 7.35 \\\\
c + a + m                           &= \dfrac {7.35} {5} \\\\
c + a + m                           &= \pounds 1.47
\end{aligned}
$

Total cost $= \pounds 1.47$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The tables in the Dining Hall can each seat $8$ pupils. 

How many tables are needed to seat $180$ pupils?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The tables in the Dining Hall can each seat $8$ pupils. 
<emptyline>
How many tables are needed to seat $180$ pupils?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total tables needed}                    &= \dfrac {\text{Total pupils}} {\text{Pupil per table}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {180} {8} \\\\
                                              &= 22 \ \text{remainder } 4 \\\\
                                              &\approx 23
\end{aligned}
$

We need $1$ more table for the remaining $4$ pupils.

Total tables = $22 + 1 = 23$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23 \ \text{tables}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jake paid a $\pounds 50$ deposit for a bike, then monthly
payments of $\pounds 25$ each. The bike cost $\pounds 275$. 

How many monthly payments did Jake have to make to buy it?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jake paid a $\pounds 50$ deposit for a bike, then monthly
payments of $\pounds 25$ each. The bike cost $\pounds 275$. 
<emptyline>
How many monthly payments did Jake have to make to buy it?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of payments} &= \dfrac {\text{Total cost} - \text{Deposit}} {\text{Monthly payment}} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {275 - 50} {25} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {225} {25} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {9 \times 25} {25} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel{25}} {\cancel{25}} \\\\
                          &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of monthly payments $= n$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
50 + 25n                                      &= 275 \\\\
25n                                           &= 275 - 50 \\\\
25n                                           &= 225 \\\\
n                                             &= \dfrac {225} {25} \\\\
n                                             &= \dfrac {9 \times 25} {25} \\\\
n                                             &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel{25}} {\cancel{25}} \\\\
n                                             &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number of monthly payments $= 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

There are $500$ pupils at Lily's school.

There are $30$ more girls than boys. 

How many girls are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $500$ pupils at Lily's school.
<emptyline>
There are $30$ more girls than boys. 
<emptyline>
How many girls are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of girls $= g$

Number of boys $= g - 30$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
g + (g - 30)                                         &= 500 \\\\
2g                                                   &= 500 + 30 \\\\
2g                                                   &= 530 \\\\
g                                                    &= \dfrac {530} {2} \\\\
g                                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 265} {2} \\\\
g                                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 265} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
g                                                    &= 265
\end{aligned}
$

Number of girls $= 265$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$265 \ \text{girls}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

The sum of five consecutive whole numbers is $100$. 

What is the smallest of these five numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sum of five consecutive whole numbers is $100$. 
<emptyline>
What is the smallest of these five numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the five consecutive whole numbers $= a - 2, a - 1, a , a + 1, a + 2$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a - 2) + (a - 1) + a + (a + 1) + (a + 2)   &= 100 \\\\

a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times 5} {5} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                   &= 20
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Smallest whole number}        &= a - 2 \\\\
                                    &= 20 - 2 \\\\
                                    &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

The sum of two numbers is $22$ and their difference is $4$. 

What are the two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sum of two numbers is $22$ and their difference is $4$. 
<emptyline>
What are the two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the two numbers are $= a, b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b       &= 22 \\\\
a - b       &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add both the equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b + a - b           &= 22 + 4 \\\\
2a                      &= 26 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {2 \times 13} {2} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 13} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                       &= 13
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $a$ in one of the initial equations to find $b$.

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b                   &= 22 \\\\
b                       &= 22 - a \\\\
b                       &= 22 - 13 \\\\
b                       &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Numbers $= 13, 9$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13$

**Answer**

$9$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Paddy is leading in a race. 

He is $81 \ \text{metres}$ in front of Sam who is in last place. 

Martin is between Paddy and Sam. 

Martin is $40 \ \text{metres}$ from the finish line and is twice as far away from Sam as he is from Paddy. 

How far has Sam left to run?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Paddy is leading in a race. 
<emptyline>
He is $81 \ \text{metres}$ in front of Sam who is in last place. 
<emptyline>
Martin is between Paddy and Sam. 
<emptyline>
Martin is $40 \ \text{metres}$ from the finish line and is twice as far away from Sam as he is from Paddy. 
<emptyline>
How far has Sam left to run?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let distance of Paddy from finish line $= p$

Distance of Sam from finish line $= a + 81$

Distance of Martin from finish line $=40$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
p + 81 - 40             &= 2 \times (40 - p) \\\\
p + 41                  &= 80 - 2p \\\\
p + 2p                  &= 80 - 41 \\\\
3p                      &= 39 \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {39} {3} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {3 \times 13} {3} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 13} { \cancel 3} \\\\
p                       &= 13 \ \text{metres}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Distance Sam left to run}     &= 13 + 81 \\\\
                                                &= 94 \ \text{metres}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$94 \ \text{metres}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I thought of a number, halved it and then subtracted $9$.

I got an answer of $12$.

What was my original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I thought of a number, halved it and then subtracted $9$.
<emptyline>
I got an answer of $12$.
<emptyline>
What was my original number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the original number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {2} - 9              &= 12 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {2}                  &= 12 + 9 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {2}                  &= 21 \\\\
a                               &= 2 \times 21 \\\\
a                               &= 42 
\end{aligned}
$

Original number $= 42$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$42$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fawzan went shopping with $\pounds 100$ in his wallet.

He spent $10 \%$ of his money on a book and $20 \%$ of the rest on a DVD. How much money did he then have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fawzan went shopping with $\pounds 100$ in his wallet.
<emptyline>
He spent $10 \%$ of his money on a book and $20 \%$ of the rest on a DVD. How much money did he then have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money spent on book}              &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 100 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times 100} {100} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {100}} \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 10 \\\\
\text{Money left}            &= 100 - 10 \\\\
                                                &= \pounds 90 \\\\
\text{Money spent on DVD}               &= \dfrac {20} {100} \times 90 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {20 \times 90} {100} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \cancel 0 \times 9 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                        &= 2 \times 9 \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 18 \\\\
\text{Final money left}        &= 90 - 18 \\\\
                                                    &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money left after book purchase}              &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times 100 \\\\
\text{Money left after DVD purchase}               &= \dfrac {80} {100} \times \dfrac {90} {100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {80 \times 90 \times 100} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {8 \cancel 0 \times 9 \cancel 0 \times \cancel {100}} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
                                                        &= 8 \times 9 \\\\
                                                        &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 72$

</div>
</div>

                                        &= \pounds 10 \\\\

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Abdul is making some small snacks for a party.

He cuts $1.2 \ \text{kg}$ of cheese into a number of $30 \ \text{g}$ pieces.

How many pieces does he have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Abdul is making some small snacks for a party.
<emptyline>
He cuts $1.2 \ \text{kg}$ of cheese into a number of $30 \ \text{g}$ pieces.
<emptyline>
How many pieces does he have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pieces}    &= \dfrac {1.2 \ \text{kg}} {30 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1.2 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {30 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1200} {30} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {30 \times 40} {30} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {30} \times 40} {\cancel {30}} \\\\
                                &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                &= \dfrac {30 \times 40} {30} \\\\

                                &= 40
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is $60$.

What is the largest of the three numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is $60$.
<emptyline>
What is the largest of the three numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the three consecutive whole numbers $= a - 1, a, a + 1$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a - 1) + a + (a + 1)                   &= 60 \\\\
3a                                  &= 60 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {60} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                   &= 20 \\\\
\text{Largest number}               &= a + 1 \\\\
                                    &= 20 + 1 \\\\
                                    &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

*ABBR: TODO:: Find the right katex symbol.*

Given that,

$
\begin{aligned}
\spadesuit + \spadesuit                 &= \spadesuit \\\\
\spadesuit + \spadesuit                 &= \spadesuit \\\\
\spadesuit + \spadesuit + \spadesuit    &= \spadesuit 
\end{aligned}
$

how many $\spadesuit$ are equal to $\spadesuit$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

**Working**

Let the value of triangle $= t$

Value of square $= s$

Value of circle $= c$

Value of diamond $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2t              &= s \\\\
s + t           &= c \\\\
d               &= c + s + t
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $s$ from the first equation into the second and third equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
d               &= c + s + t \\\\
d               &= (s + t) + (2t) + t \\\\
d               &= (2t + t) + (2t) + t \\\\
d               &= 6t
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 6$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What number does $m$ stand for, if $m * 6 = 41?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What number does $m$ stand for, if $m * 6 = 41?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
m * 6                   &= 41 \\\\
(5 \times m) + 6        &= 41 \\\\
5m                      &= 41 - 6 \\\\
m                       &= \dfrac {35} {5} \\\\
m                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 7} {5} \\\\
m                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 7} {\cancel 5} \\\\
m                       &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $n * 4 = 8 * n$, what number does $n$ stand for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
n * 4                   &= 8 * n \\\\
(5 \times n) + 4        &= (5 \times 8) + n \\\\
5n + 4                  &= 40 + n \\\\
5n - n                  &= 40 - 4 \\\\
4n                      &= 36 \\\\
n                       &= \dfrac {36} {4} \\\\
n                       &= \dfrac {4 \times 9} {4} \\\\
n                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 9} {\cancel 4} \\\\
n                       &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I thought of a number, halved it and then subtracted $9$.

I got an answer of $12$.

What was my original number ?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I thought of a number, halved it and then subtracted $9$.
<emptyline>
I got an answer of $12$.
<emptyline>
What was my original number ?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the original number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {2} - 9              &= 12 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {2}                  &= 12 + 9 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {2}                  &= 21 \\\\
a                               &= 2 \times 21 \\\\
a                               &= 42 
\end{aligned}
$

Original number $= 42$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$42$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fawzan went shopping with $\pounds 100$ in his wallet.

He spent $10 \%$ of his money on a book and $20 \%$ of the rest on a DVD. How much money did he then have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fawzan went shopping with $\pounds 100$ in his wallet.
<emptyline>
He spent $10 \%$ of his money on a book and $20 \%$ of the rest on a DVD. How much money did he then have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money spent on book}              &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 100 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times 100} {100} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {100}} \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 10 \\\\
\text{Money left}            &= 100 - 10 \\\\
                                                &= \pounds 90 \\\\
\text{Money spent on DVD}               &= \dfrac {20} {100} \times 90 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {20 \times 90} {100} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \cancel 0 \times 9 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                        &= 2 \times 9 \\\\
                                        &= \pounds 18 \\\\
\text{Final money left}        &= 90 - 18 \\\\
                                                    &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money left after book purchase}              &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times 100 \\\\
\text{Money left after DVD purchase}               &= \dfrac {80} {100} \times \dfrac {90} {100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {80 \times 90 \times 100} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {8 \cancel 0 \times 9 \cancel 0 \times \cancel {100}} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
                                                        &= 8 \times 9 \\\\
                                                        &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 72$

</div>

                                                        &= \dfrac {80 \times 90 \times 100} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {8 \cancel 0 \times 9 \cancel 0 \times \cancel {100}} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
                                                        &= 8 \times 9 \\\\
                                                        &= \pounds 72
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

How many pieces does he have?

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is $60$.

What is the largest of the three numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is $60$.
<emptyline>
What is the largest of the three numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the three consecutive whole numbers $= a - 1, a, a + 1$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a - 1) + a + (a + 1)                   &= 60 \\\\
3a                                  &= 60 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {60} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                   &= 20 \\\\
\text{Largest number}               &= a + 1 \\\\
                                    &= 20 + 1 \\\\
                                    &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

What is the smallest positive whole number that divides exactly by

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Value of diamond $= d$

$

d               &= c + s + t \\\\

d               &= 6t
\end{aligned}
$

$6$ triangles are equal to one diamond.

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What number does $m$ stand for, if $m * 6 = 41?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
m * 6            &= 41 \\\\
5 \times m + 6 &= 41 \\\\
5m               &= 41 - 6 \\\\
5m               &= 35 \\\\
m                &= \dfrac{35}{5} \\\\
m                &= \dfrac{5 \times 7}{5} \\\\
m                &= \dfrac{\cancel{5} \times 7}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
m                &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

If $n * 4 = 8 * n$, what number does $n$ stand for?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $n * 4 = 8 * n$, what number does $n$ stand for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
n * 4            &= 8 * n \\\\
5 \times n + 4 &= 5 \times 8 + n \\\\
5n + 4           &= 40 + n \\\\
5n - n           &= 40 - 4 \\\\
4n               &= 36 \\\\
n                &= \dfrac{36}{4} \\\\
n                &= \dfrac{4 \times 9}{4} \\\\
n                &= \dfrac{\cancel{4} \times 9}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
n                &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The sum of two consecutive whole numbers is $91$. 

What is the larger of these two numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The sum of two consecutive whole numbers is $91$. 
<emptyline>
What is the larger of these two numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Second number $= a + 1$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (a + 1)               &= 91 \\\\
2 a + 1                 &= 91 \\\\
2 a                     &= 91 - 1 \\\\
2 a                     &= 90 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {90} {2} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {45 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {45 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                       &= 45 \\\\
\text {Larger number}   &= a + 1 \\\\
                        &= 45 + 1 \\\\
                        &= 46
\end{aligned}
$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$46$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

I thought of a number, doubled it and then subtracted $14$. 

I then divided the result by $3$ and got a final answer of $8$. 

What was the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I thought of a number, doubled it and then subtracted $14$. 
<emptyline>
I then divided the result by $3$ and got a final answer of $8$. 
<emptyline>
What was the original number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {2 a - 14} {3} &= 8 \\\\
2a - 14          &= 8 \times 3 \\\\
2a - 14          &= 24 \\\\
2a               &= 24 + 14 \\\\
2a               &= 38 \\\\
a                &= \dfrac {38} {2} \\\\
a                &= \dfrac {19 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                &= \dfrac {19 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                &= 19
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$19$

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of the water $= w$

Let the weight of the bucket $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
w + b              &= 21.1 \\\\
\dfrac{w}{2} + b   &= 12.5
\end{aligned}
$

Let's subtract the second equation from the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
w + b - (\dfrac{w}{2} + b)  &= 21.1 - 12.5 \\\\
w + b - \dfrac{w}{2} - b    &= 8.6 \\\\
\dfrac{w}{2}                &= 8.6 \\\\
w                           &= 8.6 \times 2 \\\\
w                           &= 17.2 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $w$ in the first equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
w + b                       &= 21.1 \\\\
17.2 + b                      &= 21.1 \\\\
b                           &= 21.1 - 17.2 \\\\
b                           &= 3.9 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of the empty bucket $= 3.9 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3.9 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

Each elf is $55  \ \text{cm}$ taller than each hobbit. How tall is each hobbit. Give your answer in centimetres.

Height of a hobbit $= 110 \ \text{cm}$

$
\begin{aligned}
27 \times 312  &= 54 \times a \\\\
54 \times a                                      &= 27 \times 312 \\\\
a                                                &= \dfrac{27 \times 312}{54} \\\\
a                                                &= \dfrac{27 \times 2 \times 156}{2 \times 27} \\\\
a                                                &= \dfrac{\cancel{27} \times \cancel{2} \times 156}{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{27}} \\\\
a                                                &= 156
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fill the spaces to make all these fractions equal:

$\dfrac{}{3} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{2}{6} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{}{18} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{7}{} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{}{60}
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fill the spaces to make all these fractions equal:
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{}{3} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{2}{6} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{}{18} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{7}{} \quad = 
\quad \dfrac{}{60}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing numerator $= a$, $b$, $c$

Let the missing denominator $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {3} &= \dfrac {2} {6} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {6} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {6} {6} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {\cancel {6}} {\cancel {6}} \\\\
a              &= 1
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {b} {18} &= \dfrac {2} {6} \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {2 \times 18} {6} \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 6} {2 \times 3} \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {3} \times 6} {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
b               &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {7} {d}          &= \dfrac {2} {6} \\\\
\dfrac {7 \times 6} {2} &= d \\\\
d                       &= \dfrac {7 \times 6} {2} \\\\
d                       &= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
d                       &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {2} \times 3} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
d                       &= 7 \times 3 \\\\
d                       &= 21
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {c} {60}  &= \dfrac {2} {6} \\\\
c                &= \dfrac {2 \times 60} {6} \\\\
c                &= \dfrac {2 \times 6 \times 10} {6} \\\\
c                &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel {6} \times 10} {\cancel {6}} \\\\
c                &= 2 \times 10 \\\\
c                &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
