**Question**

If $x  \ \spadesuit \  4 = 23$, what number is $x$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $x  \ \spadesuit \  4 = 23$, what number is $x$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
x  \ \spadesuit \  4        &= 23 \\\\
x \times 4 + 3              &= 23 \\\\
4x                  &= 23 - 3 \\\\
x                           &= \dfrac {20} {4} \\\\
x                           &= \dfrac {4 \times 5} {4} \\\\
x                           &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 5} {\cancel 4} \\\\
x                           &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$5$

</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

y \times y + 3              &= 39 \\\\

y                           &= \sqrt {36} \\\\
y                           &= 6, -6
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

If $x   \ \bigstar \   2 = 30$, what is the number $x$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $x   \ \bigstar \   2 = 30$, what is the number $x$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$2$ is even, so $x \times 2$ is always even. so we multiply:

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
x \ \bigstar \ 2        &= 30 \\\\
x \times 2              &= 30 \\\\
x                       &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
x                       &= \dfrac {2 \times 15} {2} \\\\
x                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 15} {\cancel 2} \\\\
x                       &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $y   \ \bigstar \   3 = 24$, there are two possible values of $y$. What are they?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $y   \ \bigstar \   3 = 24$, there are two possible values of $y$. What are they?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$3$ is odd, so $y \times 3$ is odd when $y$ is odd, and even when $y$ is even.

Case $1$ ($y$ is even):

$
\begin{aligned}
y \ \bigstar \ 3        &= 24 \\\\
y \times 3              &= 24 \\\\
y                       &= \dfrac {24} {3} \\\\
y                       &= \dfrac {3 \times 8} {3} \\\\
y                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 8} {\cancel 3} \\\\
y                       &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Case $2$ ($y$ is odd):

$
\begin{aligned}
y \ \bigstar \ 3        &= 24 \\\\
y + 3                   &= 24 \\\\
y                       &= 24 - 3 \\\\
y                       &= 21
\end{aligned}
$

$y = 8$, $21$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Half of the pupils in a school are boys;
one third of the boys play soccer;
one quarter of the boy soccer players get soccer colours;
one fifth of those who win soccer colours are boys in form 8CC.
There are $10$ boy with soccer in 8CC.

How many pupils are there in the school?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Half of the pupils in a school are boys;
one third of the boys play soccer;
one quarter of the boy soccer players get soccer colours;
one fifth of those who win soccer colours are boys in form 8CC.
There are $10$ boy with soccer in 8CC.
<emptyline>
How many pupils are there in the school?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of pupils in the school $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {5} \times \dfrac {1} {4} \times \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times a                                               &= 10 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2}                                                                                               &= 10 \\\\
a                                                                                                                                       &= 10 \times 5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \\\\
a                                                                                                                                       &= 1200
\end{aligned}
$

Total number of pupils $= 1200$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1200$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Six times a number, minus $4$, is the same as four times the number, plus $10$. What is the number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Six times a number, minus $4$, is the same as four times the number, plus $10$. What is the number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 \times a - 4  &= 4 \times a + 10 \\\\
6a - 4          &= 4a + 10 \\\\
6a - 4a         &= 10 + 4 \\\\
2a              &= 14 \\\\
a               &= \dfrac {14} {2} \\\\
a               &= \dfrac {7 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a               &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a               &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 7$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Sweets**

Luke, Fred and Evie have a bag of sweets.

Luke eats half of the sweets.

Fred eats two-thirds of what is left.

Evie eats the remaining $24$ sweets.

Work out how many sweets were in the bag to begin with.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Sweets**
<emptyline>
Luke, Fred and Evie have a bag of sweets.
<emptyline>
Luke eats half of the sweets.
<emptyline>
Fred eats two-thirds of what is left.
<emptyline>
Evie eats the remaining $24$ sweets.
<emptyline>
Work out how many sweets were in the bag to begin with.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of sweets at the start $= a$

If Luke eats half, then the number of sweets left $= 1 - \dfrac {1} {2} = \dfrac {1} {2}$ of the total sweets.

If Fred eats two-thirds of what is left, then the number of sweets left $= 1 - \dfrac {2} {3} = \dfrac {1} {3}$ of what was left.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times a        &= 24 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {3 \times 2}                             &= 24 \\\\
a                                                  &= 24 \times 3 \times 2 \\\\
a                                                  &= 144
\end{aligned}
$

Number of sweets $= 144$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$144$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Cats and dogs**

A farmer decides to buy some cats and some dogs.

Two cats and three dogs would cost $\pounds 180$.

One cat and four dogs would cost $\pounds 190$.

Work out the total cost of three cats and seven dogs.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Cats and dogs**
<emptyline>
A farmer decides to buy some cats and some dogs.
<emptyline>
Two cats and three dogs would cost $\pounds 180$.
<emptyline>
One cat and four dogs would cost $\pounds 190$.
<emptyline>
Work out the total cost of three cats and seven dogs.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of one cat $= c$

Let the cost of one dog $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2c + 3d             &= 180 \\\\
c + 4d              &= 190
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add both the equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
2c + 3d + c + 4d            &= 180 + 190 \\\\
3c + 7d                     &= \pounds 370
\end{aligned}
$

Total cost $= \pounds 370$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 370$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Bacteria**

Some bacteria are growing in a dish in a laboratory.

Each day the number of bacteria doubles.

On February $1 ^ \text{st}$ there are $200$ bacteria.

On what day does the number of bacteria first become more than one million?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Bacteria**
<emptyline>
Some bacteria are growing in a dish in a laboratory.
<emptyline>
Each day the number of bacteria doubles.
<emptyline>
On February $1 ^ \text{st}$ there are $200$ bacteria.
<emptyline>
On what day does the number of bacteria first become more than one million?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of days $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 ^ a \times 200            &> 1000000 \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> \dfrac {1000000} {200} \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> \dfrac {200 \times 5000} {200} \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> \dfrac {\cancel {200} \times 5000} {\cancel {200}} \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> 5000
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value by using trial and error. Lets find out the value of $a$ that satisfies the above equation.

|  $a$  | $2 ^ a$  |  $> 5000$    |
|:------------:|:------------------:|:------------------:|
|     $10$     |        $1024$      |    No    |
|     $11$     |        $2048$      |    No    |
|     $12$     |        $4096$      |    No    |
|     $13$     |        $8192$      |    Yes   |

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Date it crosses} &= 1 \ \text{February} + 13 \ \text{days} \\\\
                                                                     &= 14 \ \text {February}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$14 \ \text{February}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

</div>

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of days $= a$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
2 ^ a \times 200            &> 1000000 \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> \dfrac {1000000} {200} \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> \dfrac {200 \times 5000} {200} \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> \dfrac {\cancel {200} \times 5000} {\cancel {200}} \\\\
2 ^ a                       &> 5000
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
We can easily infer the value by using trial and error. Lets find out the value of $a$ that satisfies the above equation.
<emptyline>
|  $a$  | $2 ^ a$  |  $> 5000$    |
|:------------:|:------------------:|:------------------:|
|     $10$     |        $1024$      |    No    |
|     $11$     |        $2048$      |    No    |
|     $12$     |        $4096$      |    No    |
|     $13$     |        $8192$      |    Yes   |
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Date it crosses} &= 1 \ \text{February} + 13 \ \text{days} \\\\
                                                                     &= 14 \ \text {February}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The symbol $\spadesuit$ has a special meaning in arithmetic. 

$a \ \spadesuit \ b$ means add $a$ and $b$ and then multiply by $a$. 

For example: 

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \spadesuit \ 2                    &= 4 \times (4 + 2)  \\\\
                            &= 4 \times 6 \\\\
                            &= 24
\end{aligned}
$

</div>

**Question**

Work out the value of $p$ such that $6 \ \spadesuit \ p = 78$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the value of $p$ such that $6 \ \spadesuit \ p = 78$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 \ \spadesuit \ p                &= 78 \\\\
6 \times (6 + p)        &= 78 \\\\
36 + 6p                 &= 78 \\\\
6p                      &= 78 - 36 \\\\
6p                     &= 42 \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {42} {6} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {6 \times 7} {6} \\\\
p                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 7} {\cancel 6} \\\\
p                       &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Value of $p = 7$.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{B} + \text{A} + \text{T}                  &= 17 \\
\text{C} + \text{A} + \text{T}                  &= 25 \\
\text{C} + \text{O} + \text{A} + \text{T}       &= 29 \\
\end{aligned}
$

What is the value of $B + O + A + T?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{B} + \text{A} + \text{T}                  &= 17 \\
\text{C} + \text{A} + \text{T}                  &= 25 \\
\text{C} + \text{O} + \text{A} + \text{T}       &= 29 \\
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
What is the value of $B + O + A + T?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{B} + \text{A} + \text{T}                  &= 17 \\\\
\text{C} + \text{A} + \text{T}                  &= 25 \\\\
\text{C} + \text{O} + \text{A} + \text{T}       &= 29 \\\\
\end{aligned}
$

Let's subtract the $2 ^\text{nd}$ equation from the $3^\text{rd}$ equation.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{C} + \text{O} + \text{A} + \text{T} - (\text{C} + \text{A} + \text{T})    &= 29 - 25 \\\\
\text{C} + \text{O} + \text{A} + \text{T} - \text{C} - \text{A} - \text{T}      &= 29 - 25 \\\\
\text{O}                                                                        &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Now, let's add the value of $O$ to the $1^\text{st}$ equation.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{B} + \text{A} + \text{T} + \text{O}       &= 17 + 4 \\\\
\text{B} + \text{O} + \text{A} + \text{T}       &= 21
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 21$.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$21$

**Working**

Rule: Multiply by 4, then subtract 8.

Let the first missing number $= a$

Let the second missing number $= b$

Let the third missing number $= c$

As per the question

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{First missing number}         &= 10 \times 4 - 8 \\\\
a                                   &= 40 - 8 \\\\
a                                   &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the rule to find b.

$
\begin{aligned}
4b - 8          &= 44 \\\\
4b              &= 44 + 8 \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {52} {4} \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {4 \times 13} {4} \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 13} {\cancel 4} \\\\
b               &= 13
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the rule to find c.

$
\begin{aligned}
4c - 8          &= 2 \\\\
4c              &= 2 + 8 \\\\
c               &= \dfrac {10} {4} \\\\
c               &= \dfrac {10 \times 25} {4 \times 25} \\\\
c               &= \dfrac {250} {100} \\\\
c               &= 2.5
\end{aligned}
$

Missing numbers $= 32, 13, 2.5$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I think of a number. When I multiply this number by $15$ and then subtract $7$ I get $38$. What number am I thinking of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number. When I multiply this number by $15$ and then subtract $7$ I get $38$. What number am I thinking of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 15 - 7                     &= 38 \\\\
a \times 15                         &= 38 + 7 \\\\
a \times 15                         &= 45 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {45} {15} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {15 \times 3} {15} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {15} \times 3} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
a                                   &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alison, Bhavini and Catherine share a bag of sweets.
Alison gets $5$ more sweets than Bhavini and Catherine gets twice as many sweets as Alison.

Catherine gets $22$ sweets. How many sweets are there in the bag?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alison, Bhavini and Catherine share a bag of sweets.
Alison gets $5$ more sweets than Bhavini and Catherine gets twice as many sweets as Alison.
<emptyline>
Catherine gets $22$ sweets. How many sweets are there in the bag?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of sweets Alison gets $= a$.

Bhavini gets $= a - 5$

Catherine gets $= 2 \times a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2a                    &= 22 \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac{22}{2} \\\\
a                     &= 11 \\\\
\text{Alison}         &= 11 \\\\
\text{Bhavini}        &= a - 5 \\\\
                      &= 11 - 5 \\\\
                      &= 6 \\\\
\text{Total sweets}   &= \text{Alison} + \text{Bhavini} + \text{Catherine} \\\\
                      &= 11 + 6 + 22 \\\\
                      &= 39
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$39$

</div>
</div>

y         &= 11
\end{aligned}

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Anwar thinks of a number. He doubles it and subtracts $17$ from the result. He then has $15$.

What was Anwar's original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Anwar thinks of a number. He doubles it and subtracts $17$ from the result. He then has $15$.
<emptyline>
What was Anwar's original number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times a - 17     &= 15 \\\\
2a                  &= 15 + 17 \\\\
2a                  &= 32 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {32} {2} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {16 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {16 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a                   &= 16
\end{aligned}
$

Original number $= 16$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$16$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Casey is using a different 'multiply then add' number machine. When she inputs $3$, the output is $26$. When the input is $5$, 
the output is $36$.

$3$ $\rightarrow$ [$\times {?}$] $\rightarrow$ [$+ {?}$] $\rightarrow$ $26 \\\\$
$5$ $\rightarrow$ [$\times {?}$] $\rightarrow$ [$+ {?}$] $\rightarrow$ $36 \\\\$

Fill in the unknown values for Casey's number machines, so you obtain the same input and output values as she did.

INPUT $\rightarrow$ [$\times \ldots$] $\rightarrow$ [$+ \ldots$] $\rightarrow$ OUTPUT

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Casey is using a different 'multiply then add' number machine. When she inputs $3$, the output is $26$. When the input is $5$, 
the output is $36$.
<emptyline>
$3$ $\rightarrow$ [$\times {?}$] $\rightarrow$ [$+ {?}$] $\rightarrow$ $26 \\\\$
$5$ $\rightarrow$ [$\times {?}$] $\rightarrow$ [$+ {?}$] $\rightarrow$ $36 \\\\$
<emptyline>
Fill in the unknown values for Casey's number machines, so you obtain the same input and output values as she did.
<emptyline>
INPUT $\rightarrow$ [$\times \ldots$] $\rightarrow$ [$+ \ldots$] $\rightarrow$ OUTPUT
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the multiplication factor $= m$

Let the addition factor $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3m + a       &= 26 \\\\
5m + a       &= 36
\end{aligned}
$

Let's subtract the first equation from the second equation.

$
\begin{aligned}
5m + a - (3m + a)     &= 36 - 26 \\\\
5m + a - 3m - a       &= 10 \\\\
2m                    &= 10 \\\\
m                     &= \dfrac{10}{2} \\\\
m                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 2}{2} \\\\
m                     &= \dfrac{5 \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
m                     &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $m$ in the first equation.

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \times 5 + a       &= 26 \\\\
15 + a                  &= 26 \\\\
a                       &= 26 - 15 \\\\
a                       &= 11
\end{aligned}
$

multiplication factor $= 5$

addition factor $= 11$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

multiplier $=$ $5$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

addition $=$ $11$

**Question**

$\dfrac{3}{5} + \dfrac{\boxed{\phantom{3}}}{10} = \dfrac{9}{10}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac{3}{5} + \dfrac{\boxed{\phantom{3}}}{10} = \dfrac{9}{10}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {5} + \dfrac {a} {10}                      &= \dfrac {9} {10} \\\\
\dfrac {3 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {a} {10}    &= \dfrac {9} {10} \\\\
\dfrac {6} {10} + \dfrac {a} {10}                     &= \dfrac {9} {10} \\\\
\dfrac {6 + a} {10}                                   &= \dfrac {9} {10} \\\\
6 + a                                                 &= 9 \\\\
a                                                     &= 9 - 6 \\\\
a                                                     &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Owen did not understand a problem properly. He multiplied by $100$ when he should have divided by $100$. His answer 
was $62800000$. What should his answer have been?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Owen did not understand a problem properly. He multiplied by $100$ when he should have divided by $100$. His answer 
was $62800000$. What should his answer have been?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

**Working**

Let the number Owen started with $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 100            &= 62800000 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {62800000} {100} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {628000 \times 100} {100} \\\\
a               &= \dfrac {628000 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel{100}} \\\\ 
a                       &= 628000 \\\\
\text {Correct Answer}  &= 628000 \div 100 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {628000} {100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {6280 \times 100} {100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {6280 \times \cancel {100}} { \cancel{100}} \\\\
                        &= 6280
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\boxed{\phantom{3}} + (3 \times \boxed{\phantom{3}} ) = 36$

What number does $\boxed{\phantom{3}}$ stand for?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\boxed{\phantom{3}} + (3 \times \boxed{\phantom{3}} ) = 36$
<emptyline>
What number does $\boxed{\phantom{3}}$ stand for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (3 \times a)    &= 36 \\\\
a + 3a              &= 36 \\\\
4a                  &= 36 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {36} {4} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {9 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel {4} } {\cancel{4}} \\\\
a                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I am thinking of a number. One fifth of my number is $8$.

What is one tenth of my number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am thinking of a number. One fifth of my number is $8$.
<emptyline>
What is one tenth of my number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {5} \times a                       &= 8 \\\\
a                                             &= 8 \times 5 \\\\
a                                             &= 40 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {10} \times a             &= \dfrac {1} {10} \times 40 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {40} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {4 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 4$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$4$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number?

$8 \times 7 - 11 = 6 \times 4 + {?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the missing number?
<emptyline>
$8 \times 7 - 11 = 6 \times 4 + {?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
8 \times 7 - 11     &= 6 \times 4 + a \\\\
56 - 11             &= 24 + a \\\\
a + 24              &= 45 \\\\
a                   &= 45 - 24 \\\\
a                   &= 21
\end{aligned}
$

Missing number $= 21$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

For a train journey $t$ tickets cost $c = 8 + 12t$. How many tickets can I get for $\pounds 100?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">For a train journey $t$ tickets cost $c = 8 + 12t$. How many tickets can I get for $\pounds 100?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
c       &= 8 + 12 t \\\\
100     &= 8 + 12 t \\\\
12t     &= 100 - 8 \\\\
12t     &= 92 \\\\
t       &= \dfrac {92} {12} \\\\
t       &= 7 \ \text { remainder } 8
\end{aligned}
$

Max tickets $= 7$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\boxed{\phantom{3}} + (2 \times \boxed{\phantom{3}}) = 27$

What number does $\boxed{\phantom{3}}$ stand for?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\boxed{\phantom{3}} + (2 \times \boxed{\phantom{3}}) = 27$
<emptyline>
What number does $\boxed{\phantom{3}}$ stand for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (2 \times a)    &= 27 \\\\
a + 2a              &= 27 \\\\
3a                  &= 27 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {27} {3} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {9 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel {3} } {\cancel{3}} \\\\
a                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Missing number $= 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I am thinking of a number. One quarter of my number is $5$.

What is one tenth of my number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am thinking of a number. One quarter of my number is $5$.
<emptyline>
What is one tenth of my number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {4} \times a                       &= 5 \\\\
a                                             &= 5 \times 4 \\\\
a                                             &= 20 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {10} \times a             &= \dfrac {1} {10} \times 20 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {20} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 2$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number?

$8 \times 6 - 9 = 6 \times 5 + {?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the missing number?
<emptyline>
$8 \times 6 - 9 = 6 \times 5 + {?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
8 \times 6 - 9      &= 6 \times 5 + a \\\\
48 - 9              &= 30 + a \\\\
39                  &= 30 + a \\\\
a + 30              &= 39 \\\\
a                   &= 39 - 30 \\\\
a                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$9$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The centre pages of a book are numbered $34$ and $35$. How many pages are in the book?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The centre pages of a book are numbered $34$ and $35$. How many pages are in the book?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of pages $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a - 1} {2}          &= 34 \\\\
a - 1                       &= 34 \times 2 \\\\
a - 1                       &= 68 \\\\
a                           &= 68 + 1 \\\\
a                           &= 69
\end{aligned}
$

Number of pages in the book $= 69$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$69$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\boxed{\phantom{5}} + (5 \times \boxed{\phantom{5}}) = 42$

What number does $\boxed{\phantom{5}}$ stand for?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\boxed{\phantom{5}} + (5 \times \boxed{\phantom{5}}) = 42$
<emptyline>
What number does $\boxed{\phantom{5}}$ stand for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (5 \times a)    &= 42 \\\\
a + 5a              &= 42 \\\\
6a                  &= 42 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {42} {6} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {7 \times 6} {6} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {6} } {\cancel{6}} \\\\
a                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number?

$4 \times 7 - 11 = 5 \times 2 + {?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the missing number?
<emptyline>
$4 \times 7 - 11 = 5 \times 2 + {?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 7 - 11     &= 5 \times 2 + a \\\\
28 - 11             &= 10 + a \\\\
17                  &= 10 + a \\\\
a + 10              &= 17 \\\\
a                   &= 17 - 10 \\\\
a                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\boxed{\phantom{4}} + (4 \times \boxed{\phantom{4}} ) = 40$

What number does $\boxed{\phantom{4}}$ stand for?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\boxed{\phantom{4}} + (4 \times \boxed{\phantom{4}} ) = 40$
<emptyline>
What number does $\boxed{\phantom{4}}$ stand for?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + (4 \times a)    &= 40 \\\\
a + 4a              &= 40 \\\\
5a                  &= 40 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {40} {5} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel {5} } {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a                   &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I am thinking of a number. One fifth of my number is $6$.

What is one half of my number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am thinking of a number. One fifth of my number is $6$.
<emptyline>
What is one half of my number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {5} \times a         &= 6 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {5}                  &= 6 \\\\
a                               &= 5 \times 6 \\\\
a                               &= 30 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {2} \times a         &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 30 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {15 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {15 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                                &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 15$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number $= a$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {5} \times a         &= 6 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {5}                  &= 6 \\\\
a                               &= 5 \times 6 \\\\
a                               &= 30 \\\\
\dfrac {1} {2} \times a         &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 30 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {15 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {15 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                                &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Number $= 15$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number?

$8 \times 5 - 9 = 6 \times 5 + {?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the missing number?
<emptyline>
$8 \times 5 - 9 = 6 \times 5 + {?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
8 \times 5 - 9      &= 6 \times 5 + a \\\\
40 - 9              &= 30 + a \\\\
31                  &= 30 + a \\\\
a + 30              &= 31 \\\\
a                   &= 31 - 30 \\\\
a                   &= 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

For a train journey $t$ tickets cost $c = 6 + 10t$. How many tickets can I get for $\pounds 50?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">For a train journey $t$ tickets cost $c = 6 + 10t$. How many tickets can I get for $\pounds 50?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
c       &= 6 + 10 t \\\\
50     &= 6 + 10 t \\\\
10t     &= 50 - 6 \\\\
10t     &= 44 \\\\
t       &= \dfrac {44} {10} \\\\
t       &= 4 \ \text { remainder } 4
\end{aligned}
$

Max tickets $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the value of diamond, sun and club $= d, s, c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
d + s + s           &= 16 \\\\
d + 2s              &= 16 \\\\
d + d + d           &= 12 \\\\
3d                  &= 12 \\\\
c + d + c           &= 18 \\\\
2c + d              &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Let's find the value of d.

$
\begin{aligned}
3d                  &= 12 \\\\
d                   &= \dfrac {12} {3} \\\\
d                   &= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {3} \\\\
d                   &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 4} {\cancel 3} \\\\
d                   &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the value of d to find s.

$
\begin{aligned}
4 + 2s              &= 16 \\\\
2s                  &= 16 - 4 \\\\
s                   &= \dfrac {12} {2} \\\\
s                   &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the value of d to find c.

$
\begin{aligned}
2c + 4              &= 18 \\\\
2c                  &= 18 - 4 \\\\
c                   &= \dfrac {14} {2} \\\\
c                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

The value of diamond $= 4$

The value of sun $= 6$

The value of club $= 7$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Missing value}            &= s + d + c \\\\
                                &= 6 + 4 + 7 \\\\
                                &= 17
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$17$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out what time it is now if the time that has passed since nine o'clock this morning is five times as much as the time that is left before eleven o' clock this morning.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out what time it is now if the time that has passed since nine o'clock this morning is five times as much as the time that is left before eleven o' clock this morning.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the time left before eleven o'clock is $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Time passed since nine o'clock}  &= 5 \times a \\\\
                                        &= 5a
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total time}  &= (11 - 9) \ \text {hours} \\\\
5a + a              &= 2 \ \text{hours} \\\\
6a                  &= (2 \times 60) \ \text {minutes} \\\\
6a                  &= 120 \ \text {minutes} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {120} {6} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {6 \times 20} {6} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times \ 20} {\cancel 6} \\\\
a                   &= 20 \ \text {minutes}
\end{aligned}
$

So, 20 minutes before 11 o'clock $= 10 {:} 40$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10 {:} 40$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Work out how many blue socks he finds.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{White socks}              &= 30 \times \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {30} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {3 \times 10} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 10} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                &= 10 \\\\
\text{Remaining socks}          &= \text{Total socks} - \text{White socks} \\\\
                                &= 30 - 10 \\\\
                                &= 20 \\\\
\text{Blue socks}               &= \dfrac{2} {5} \times 20 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{2 \times 20} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{2 \times 4 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{2 \times 4 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                &= 2 \times 4 \\\\
                                &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

\text{White socks}              &= 30 \times \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {30} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {3 \times 10} {3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 10} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                &= 10 \\\\
\text{Remaining socks}          &= \text{Total socks} - \text{White socks} \\\\
                                &= 30 - 10 \\\\
                                &= 20 \\\\
\text{Blue socks}               &= \dfrac{2} {5} \times 20 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{2 \times 20} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{2 \times 4 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{2 \times 4 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                &= 2 \times 4 \\\\
                                &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bottle contains $150 \ \text{ml}$ of juice. 
Alex drinks $50\%$ more than Jane and these two friends finish the bottle between them. Calculate how much Alex drinks.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bottle contains $150 \ \text{ml}$ of juice. 
Alex drinks $50\%$ more than Jane and these two friends finish the bottle between them. Calculate how much Alex drinks.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of juice Jane drinks $= a$

Amount of juice Alex drinks  $= a + 50 \% \ \text{of} \ a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + a + 50 \% \ \text{of} \ a                          &= 150 \\\\
2a + \dfrac {50a} {100}                                &= 150 \\\\
2a + 0.5a                                       &= 150 \\\\
2.5a                                            &= 150 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {150} {2.5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {150 \times 10} {25} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac { 5 \times 30 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac { \cancel 5 \times 30 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
a                                               &= 60 \ \text {ml} \\\\
\text{Juice Jane drinks}                               &= 60 \ \text {ml} \\\\
\text{Juice Alex drinks}                               &= 60 + 50 \% \times 60 \\\\
                                                       &= 60 + 0.5 \times 60 \\\\
                                                       &= 60 + 30 \\\\
                                                       &= 90 \ \text {ml}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the amount of juice Jane drinks $= a$

2a + 0.5a                                       &= 150 \\\\
2.5a                                            &= 150 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {150} {2.5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {150 \times 10} {25} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac { 5 \times 30 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 5} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac { \cancel 5 \times 30 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
a                                               &= 60 \ \text {ml} \\\\
\text{Juice Jane drinks}                               &= 60 \ \text {ml} \\\\
\text{Juice Alex drinks}                               &= 60 + 50 \% \times 60 \\\\
                                                       &= 60 + 0.5 \times 60 \\\\
                                                       &= 60 + 30 \\\\
                                                       &= 90 \ \text {ml}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

The instruction $(x \ \clubsuit \ y) \ \clubsuit \ z$ means work out $x \ \clubsuit \ y$ first, and then apply $\clubsuit$ again to your answer 
and $z$.

For example:

$
\begin{aligned}
(2 \ \clubsuit \ 3) \ \clubsuit \ 4 &= (2^2 + 3) \ \clubsuit \ 4 \\\\
&= 7 \ \clubsuit \ 4 \\\\
&= 7^2 + 4 \\\\
&= 49 + 4 \\\\
&= 53 
\end{aligned}
$

Work out the value of $(3 \ \clubsuit \ 2) \ \clubsuit \ 8$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The instruction $(x \ \clubsuit \ y) \ \clubsuit \ z$ means work out $x \ \clubsuit \ y$ first, and then apply $\clubsuit$ again to your answer 
and $z$.
<emptyline>
For example:
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
(2 \ \clubsuit \ 3) \ \clubsuit \ 4 &= (2^2 + 3) \ \clubsuit \ 4 \\\\
&= 7 \ \clubsuit \ 4 \\\\
&= 7^2 + 4 \\\\
&= 49 + 4 \\\\
&= 53 
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Work out the value of $(3 \ \clubsuit \ 2) \ \clubsuit \ 8$
</code></pre>
</div>

\begin{aligned}
&= (3 \ \clubsuit \ 2) \ \clubsuit \ 8 \\\\
&= (3^2 + 2) \ \clubsuit \ 8 \\\\
&= (9 + 2) \ \clubsuit \ 8 \\\\
&= 11 \ \clubsuit \ 8 \\\\

&= 121 + 8 \\\\
&= 129
\end{aligned}

**Question**

Work out the value of $b$ if $( b \ \clubsuit \ 1 ) \ \clubsuit \ 7 = 107$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the value of $b$ if $( b \ \clubsuit \ 1 ) \ \clubsuit \ 7 = 107$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
(b \ \clubsuit \ 1) \ \clubsuit \ 7 &= 107 \\\\
(b^2 + 1) \ \clubsuit \ 7           &= 107 \\\\
(b^2 + 1)^2 +7                      &= 107 \\\\
(b^2 + 1)^2                         &= 107 - 7 \\\\
(b^2 + 1)^2                         &= 100 \\\\
b^2 + 1                             &= \sqrt{100} \\\\
b^2 + 1                             &= 10 \\\\
b^2                                 &= 10 - 1 \\\\
b^2                                 &= 9 \\\\
b                                   &= \sqrt{9} \\\\
b                                   &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Please note we are ignore $b^2 + 1 = \sqrt{100} = -10$ as the left side is positive.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

What is the value of $a$ if $9 \ \spadesuit \ a = 31$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the value of $b$ if $b \ \spadesuit \ 10 = 16 \ \spadesuit \ b$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the value of $b$ if $b \ \spadesuit \ 10 = 16 \ \spadesuit \ b$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
b \ \spadesuit \ 10 &= 16 \ \spadesuit \ b \\\\
2 \times b + 10     &= 2 \times 16 + b \\\\
2b + 10             &= 32 + b \\\\
2b - b              &= 32 - 10 \\\\
b                   &= 22
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Whilst driving to work Alison noticed that there were nine lamp posts equally spaced along a road. 
The distance from the first to the third is $60 \ \text{m}$. How far is it from the first to the last? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Whilst driving to work Alison noticed that there were nine lamp posts equally spaced along a road. 
The distance from the first to the third is $60 \ \text{m}$. How far is it from the first to the last? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the space between lamp posts $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2a                                     &= 60 \\\\
a                                      &= \dfrac {60} {2} \\\\
a                                      &= \dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                                      &= \dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                                      &= 30  \\\\
\text{Total distance} &= 8a \\\\
                                       &= 8 \times 30 \\\\
                                       &= 240 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$240 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3  \ast  a &= 6 \\\\
(a - 3) \times 3        &= 6 \\\\
a - 3                 &= \dfrac {6} {3} \\\\
a - 3                 &= 2 \\\\
a                    &= 2 + 3 \\\\
a                       &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Anastasia thinks of a positive integer, which Barry then doubles. Next, Charlie trebles Barry's number. Finally, Damien multiplies Charlie's number by six. Eve notices that the sum of these four numbers is a perfect square.

What is the smallest number that Anastasia could have thought of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Anastasia thinks of a positive integer, which Barry then doubles. Next, Charlie trebles Barry's number. Finally, Damien multiplies Charlie's number by six. Eve notices that the sum of these four numbers is a perfect square.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number that Anastasia could have thought of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number Anastasia thought of $= a$

Barry's number $= 2a$

Charlie's number $= 3 \times 2a = 6a$

Damien's number $= 6 \times 6a = 36a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum} &= a + 2a + 6a + 36a \\\\
&= 45a
\end{aligned}
$

Factors of $45a = 3 \times 3 \times 5 \times a$

For this to be a perfect square, we must multiply by at least another $5$.

$a = 5$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find in the missing number :

$ \dfrac {15} {\boxed{\phantom{15}}} = \dfrac {1} {3} = \dfrac{\boxed{\phantom{15}}} {12}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find in the missing number :
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}

b               &= \dfrac {3 \times 4} {3} \\\\
b               &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 4} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
b               &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Missing numbers $= 45$, $4$
