<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A girl is $5\ \text{years}$ older than her brother. If the sum of their ages is $17$, how old are they?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A girl is $5\ \text{years}$ older than her brother. If the sum of their ages is $17$, how old are they?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let her brother's age $= a$

Girl's age $= a + 5$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + a + 5   &= 17 \\\\
2a + 5      &= 17 \\\\
2a          &= 17 - 5 \\\\
2a          &= 12 \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {12} {2} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {2 \times 6} {2} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 6} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a           &= 6 \ \text {years}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Brother's age}   &= a \\\\
                        &= 6 \ \text {years} \\\\
\text {Girl's age}      &= a + 5 \\\\
                        &= 6 + 5 \\\\
                        &= 11 \ \text {years}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6 \ \text {years}$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11 \ \text {years}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mary's telephone number is made up of $6$ digits. The first digit is $1$ and the last is $8$. It is also known that the sum of any three consecutive digits in it is $12$. What is Mary's telephone number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

1 + d2 + d3 &= 12 \\\\

d3 + d4 + d5 &= 12 \\\\

\end{aligned}

Let's find the value of $d4$.

\begin{aligned}
1 + d2 + d3 &= 12 \\\\
d2 + d3 &= 12 - 1 \\\\

d2 + d3 + d4 &= 12 \\\\

d4 &= 1
\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}

d5 &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Let's find the value of $d3$.

$
\begin{aligned}
d3 + d4 + d5 &= 12 \\\\
d3 + 1 + 3 &= 12 \\\\
d3 &= 12 - 4 \\\\
d3 &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Let's find the value of $d2$.

$
\begin{aligned}
1 + d2 + d3 &= 12 \\\\
1 + d2 + 8 &= 12 \\\\
d2 &= 12 - 9 \\\\
d2 &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two farmers were taking cows to a market. One said to the other, If you give me one of your cows we shall have the same number. The other farmer replied, if you give me one of yours, I shall have twice as many as you. How many cows did each have? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two farmers were taking cows to a market. One said to the other, If you give me one of your cows we shall have the same number. The other farmer replied, if you give me one of yours, I shall have twice as many as you. How many cows did each have? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of cows with the first farmer $= a$

Let the number of cows with the second farmer $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 1 &= b - 1 \\\\
b + 1 &= 2(a - 1)
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add both the equations to eliminate $b$.

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 1) + (b + 1) &= (b - 1) + 2(a - 1) \\\\
a + 1 + b + 1 &= b - 1 + 2a - 2 \\\\
2a - a + b - b &= 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 \\\\
a &= 5 \ \text{cows}
\end{aligned}
$

Substitute $a = 5$ in the first simplified equation.

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 1 &= b - 1 \\\\
5 + 1 &= b - 1 \\\\
b &= 6 + 1 \\\\
b &= 7 \ \text{cows}
\end{aligned}
$

First farmer has $= 5$ cows

Second farmer has $= 7$ cows
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I am thinking of a number.
I multiply it by $4$ and add $3$ to it.
My solution is $23$.

What is my number?

-  $5$
-  $80$
-  $6.5$
-  $8.75$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am thinking of a number.
I multiply it by $4$ and add $3$ to it.
My solution is $23$.
<emptyline>
What is my number?
<emptyline>
-  $5$
-  $80$
-  $6.5$
-  $8.75$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times a + 3                                  &= 23 \\\\
4a                                      &= 23 - 3 \\\\
4a                                              & = 20 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {20} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
a                                               &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 5$
</div>

**Answer**

$5$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A hexagon is worth $6$ points.
A square is worth $4$ points.
How much is triangle worth?

![papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q15-i00.png](/assets/papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q15-i00.png "papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q15-i00.png")

-  Can't tell
-  $1$
-  $2$
-  $4$


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A hexagon is worth $6$ points.
A square is worth $4$ points.
How much is triangle worth?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
-  Can't tell
-  $1$
-  $2$
-  $4$
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the worth of triangle $= t$

Let the worth of circle $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 + 4 + 6 + c                                  &= 6 + c + 4 + 4 + t + t \\\\
16 + c                                         &= 14 + c + 2t \\\\
2t + c - c                                   &= 16 - 14 \\\\
2t                                             &= 2 \\\\
t                                              &= \dfrac {2} {2} \\\\
t                                              &= 1
\end{aligned}
$

Worth of triangle $= 1$ point
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Here is a pattern made from grey and white tiles.

![papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i00.png](/assets/papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i00.png "papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i00.png")
![papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i01.png](/assets/papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i01.png "papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i01.png")
![papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i02.png](/assets/papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i02.png "papers/eltham-college/2019/sample-paper-1/s01-q16-i02.png")

A shape in the pattern has $28$ grey tiles.

How many white tiles does it have?

-  $28$
-  $15$
-  $14$
-  $9$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Here is a pattern made from grey and white tiles.
<emptyline>
%image%
%image%
%image%
<emptyline>
A shape in the pattern has $28$ grey tiles.
<emptyline>
How many white tiles does it have?
<emptyline>
-  $28$
-  $15$
-  $14$
-  $9$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the diagram,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{No. of white tiles}                      &= \dfrac {\text{No. of grey tiles}} {2} + 1 \\\\
                                               &= \dfrac {28} {2} + 1 \\\\
                                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 14} {2} + 1 \\\\
                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 14} {\cancel{2}} + 1 \\\\
                                               &= 14 + 1 \\\\
                                               &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kieran thinks of a number.
He doubles it and adds $6$.
He then divides it by $2$.
The answer is $8$.
What was his original number?

- $5$
- $11$
- $20$
- $-2$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Kieran thinks of a number.
He doubles it and adds $6$.
He then divides it by $2$.
The answer is $8$.
What was his original number?
<emptyline>
- $5$
- $11$
- $20$
- $-2$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the original number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1}{2} \times (2 \times a + 6)                                   &= 8 \\\\
2a + 6                                                       &= 8 \times 2 \\\\
2a + 6                                                       &= 16 \\\\
2a                                                           &= 16 -6 \\\\
2a                                                           &= 10 \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {10} {2} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
a                                                            &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Original number $= 5$
</div>
</div>

<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Solve $3x + 7 = 25$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
3x + 7 &= 25 \\\\
3x     &= 25 - 7 \\\\
3x     &= 18 \\\\
x      &= \dfrac{18}{3} \\\\
x      &= \dfrac{3 \times 6}{3} \\\\
x      &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 6}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
x      &= 6
\end{aligned}$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When two numbers are added together the total is $32$. When the same two numbers are subtracted the result is $6$.

Find the two numbers.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When two numbers are added together the total is $32$. When the same two numbers are subtracted the result is $6$.
<emptyline>
Find the two numbers.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first number $= a$

Let the second number $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
a + b                    &= 32 \\\\
a - b                    &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's use elimination to reduce it to just one variable. 

Add the first equation to the second to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b + a - b       &= 32 + 6 \\\\
2a                  &= 38 \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {38} {2} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {19 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {19 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                   &= 19
\end{aligned}
$

Let's find the second number. Using equation $1$ we get,

$
\begin{aligned} 
a + b                    &= 32 \\\\
19 + b                   &= 32 \\\\
b                        &= 32 - 19 \\\\
b                        &= 13
\end{aligned}
$

First number $= 19$

Second number $= 13$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13$

</div>
</div>

a                                                &= 56
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sophie thinks of a number, doubles it and adds $8$.

The answer was $26$. What was the number she was thinking of? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sophie thinks of a number, doubles it and adds $8$.
<emptyline>
The answer was $26$. What was the number she was thinking of? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times a + 8                                      &= 26 \\\\
2a                                          &= 26 - 8 \\\\
2a                                                  &= 18 \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac {18} {2} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac {9 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
a                                                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 9$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

$1$ glass of Megapop

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$1$ glass of Megapop
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of $1$ Gigaburger $= g$

Let the cost of $1$ glass of Megapop $= m$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
g + 2m                    &= 2.80 \\\\
2g + 5m                   &= 6.10
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's eliminate to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply the first equation by $2$.

$
\begin{aligned} 
2 \times g + 2 \times 2m     &= 2 \times 2.80 \\\\
2g + 4m                      &= 5.60
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract the first equation from the second to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
2g + 5m - (2g + 4m)        &=  6.10 - 5.60 \\\\
2g + 5m - 2g - 4m          &= 0.50 \\\\
m                          &= \pounds 0.50
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of $1$ glass of Megapop $= \pounds 0.50$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 0.50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mayank thinks of a number. He doubles it and then adds $4$ and gets the answer $40$.

What was Mayank's number? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mayank thinks of a number. He doubles it and then adds $4$ and gets the answer $40$.
<emptyline>
What was Mayank's number? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times a + 4 &= 40 \\\\
2a + 4         &= 40 \\\\
2a             &= 40 - 4 \\\\
2a             &= 36 \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {36} {2} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {2 \times 18} {2} \\\\
a              &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 18} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a              &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 18$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$0.126$ is halfway between two numbers.

One of the numbers is $0.11$.

What is the other number? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$0.126$ is halfway between two numbers.
<emptyline>
One of the numbers is $0.11$.
<emptyline>
What is the other number? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the other number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1}{2} \times (0.11 + a)     &= 0.126 \\\\
0.11 + a                             &= 2 \times 0.126 \\\\
0.11 + a                             &= 0.252 \\\\
a                                    &= 0.252 - 0.11 \\\\
a                                    &= 0.142
\end{aligned}
$

Other number $= 0.142$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$0.142$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Hiring a Sports Hall costs a $\pounds 30$ booking fee and then $\pounds 10 \ \text{per hour}$.

Chris hires it and pays $\pounds 120$.

How many hours did Chris hire the hall for? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Hiring a Sports Hall costs a $\pounds 30$ booking fee and then $\pounds 10 \ \text{per hour}$.
<emptyline>
Chris hires it and pays $\pounds 120$.
<emptyline>
How many hours did Chris hire the hall for? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let Chris hired the hall for (in $ \text{hours} $) $= t$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
30 + 10t          &= 120 \\\\
10t               &= 120 - 30 \\\\
10t               &= 90 \\\\
t                 &= \dfrac {90} {10} \\\\
t                 &= \dfrac {9 \times 10} {10} \\\\
t                 &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {10}} \\\\
t                 &= 9 \ \text {hours}
\end{aligned}
$

Number of hours $= 9 \ \text {hours}$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9 \ \text {hours}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let Chris hired the hall for (in $ \text{hours} $) $= t$

t                 &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {10}} \\\\

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On the planet Zog the wibbles and the wobbles are having their annual conference.

A wibble has $6$ arms and a wobble has $5$ arms.

There are $11$ wibbles and a total of $81$ arms at the conference.

How many wobbles are there? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On the planet Zog the wibbles and the wobbles are having their annual conference.
<emptyline>
A wibble has $6$ arms and a wobble has $5$ arms.
<emptyline>
There are $11$ wibbles and a total of $81$ arms at the conference.
<emptyline>
How many wobbles are there? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of wobbles $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 \times 11 + 5 \times a &= 81 \\\\
66 + 5a &= 81 \\\\
5a &= 81 -66 \\\\
5a &= 15 \\\\
a &= \dfrac {15} {5} \\\\
a &= \dfrac {3 \times 5} {5} \\\\
a &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a &= 3 
\end{aligned}
$

Number of wobbles $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Theo thinks of a number and finds out  that three quarters of it is $24$.

What was the number he first thought of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {4} \times a        &= 24 \\\\
\dfrac {3a} {4}                &= 24 \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac{24 \times 4} {3} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac{8 \times 3 \times 4} {3} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac{8 \times \cancel {3} \times 4} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
a                              &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 32$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Amrit, Brenda and Clare share $13$ sweets. Amrit gets three times as many as Brenda, and Brenda get three times as many as Clare. How many do they each get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Amrit, Brenda and Clare share $13$ sweets. Amrit gets three times as many as Brenda, and Brenda get three times as many as Clare. How many do they each get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of sweets Clare get $= c$

Number of sweets Brenda get $= 3c$

Number of sweets Amrit get $= 9c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
c + 3c + 9c     &= 13 \\\\
4c + 9c         &= 13 \\\\
13c             &= 13 \\\\
c               &= \dfrac {13} {13} \\\\
c               &= 1 \\\\
\text{Sweets Clare get}    &= 1 \\\\
\text{Sweets Brenda get}   &= 3c \\\\
                                     &= 3 \times 1 \\\\
                                     &= 3 \\\\
\text{Sweets Amrit get}    &= 9c \\\\
                                     &= 9 \times 1 \\\\ 
                                     &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Amrit $=$ $9$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bob has $15$ more Match Dfex cards than Alan.

Colin gives Bob $25$ cards. Bob now has $3$ times as many as Alan.

How many has Alan got?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bob has $15$ more Match Dfex cards than Alan.
<emptyline>
Colin gives Bob $25$ cards. Bob now has $3$ times as many as Alan.
<emptyline>
How many has Alan got?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of cards Alan has $= a$

Number of cards Bob has $= a + 15$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 15 + 25 &= 3a \\\\
a + 40      &= 3a \\\\
3a - a      &= 40 \\\\
2a          &= 40 \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {40} {2} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {20 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a           &= 20
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cards Alan has $= 20$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Eve bought $4$ pencils and $5$ crayons.
Each pencil cost $22 \ \text{p}$.
She paid with a $\pounds 2$ coin and received $32 \ \text{p}$ change.
How much did each crayon cost? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Eve bought $4$ pencils and $5$ crayons.
Each pencil cost $22 \ \text{p}$.
She paid with a $\pounds 2$ coin and received $32 \ \text{p}$ change.
How much did each crayon cost? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of each crayon $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \times a + 4 \times 22\ \text{p}           &= \pounds 2 - 32p \\\\
5a + 4 \times 22\ \text{p}           &= 200\ \text{p} - 32\ \text{p} \\\\
5a + 88                             &= 200 - 32 \\\\
5a + 88                             &= 168 \\\\
5a                                  &= 168 - 88 \\\\
5a                                  &= 80 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac{80} {5} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac{5 \times 16} {5} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 16} {\cancel 5} \\\\
a                                   &= 16 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of each crayon $= 16 \ \text{p}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16 \ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bill and Ben are packing Easter eggs in crates. They have a total of $103$ Easter eggs to pack.

After a while Bill has filled $5$ crates and has $12$ Easter eggs left over, and Ben has filled $3$ crates and has $19$ Easter eggs still to pack.

How many Easter eggs fit in each crate? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bill and Ben are packing Easter eggs in crates. They have a total of $103$ Easter eggs to pack.
<emptyline>
After a while Bill has filled $5$ crates and has $12$ Easter eggs left over, and Ben has filled $3$ crates and has $19$ Easter eggs still to pack.
<emptyline>
How many Easter eggs fit in each crate? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of eggs that fit in each crate $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5a + 12 + 3a + 19 &= 103 \\\\
8a + 31           &= 103 \\\\
8a                &= 103 - 31 \\\\
8a                &= 72 \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {72} {8} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {9 \times 8} {8} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel 8} {\cancel 8} \\\\
a                 &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Egg per crate $= 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alana has to take $10 \ \text{millilitres}$ of medicine three times a day.
How long would a $180 \ \text{millilitre}$ bottle last her? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alana has to take $10 \ \text{millilitres}$ of medicine three times a day.
How long would a $180 \ \text{millilitre}$ bottle last her? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of days} &= \dfrac {\text{Total medicine}} {\text{Medicine per day}} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {180} {10 \times 3} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {10 \times 3 \times 6} {30} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac { \cancel {10} \times \cancel {3} \times 6} {\cancel {10} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
                                 &= 6 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of day $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \times 3 \times a    &= 180 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {180} {10 \times 3} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {6 \times 10 \times 3} {10 \times 3} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel {10} \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {10} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
a                       &= 6 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Number of days $= 6$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6 \ \text{days}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tomasc adds the same number to $23$ and to $8$ so that the first is then double the second. What was the number he used?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tomasc adds the same number to $23$ and to $8$ so that the first is then double the second. What was the number he used?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
23 + a &= 2 \times (8 + a) \\\\
23 + a &= 16 + 2a \\\\
2a- a  &= 23 - 16 \\\\
a      &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 7$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Rosie's plant doubles its height every day.

It is $4 \ \text{cm}$ tall on Monday. On what day does it become taller than two metres?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Rosie's plant doubles its height every day.
<emptyline>
It is $4 \ \text{cm}$ tall on Monday. On what day does it become taller than two metres?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We can easily infer the day using trial and error. 

|    Day    |        Height        | $> 200 \ \text{cm}?$ |
| :-------: | :------------------: | :-------------------: |
|   Monday  |        $4$           |           No          |
|  Tuesday  |   $4 \times 2 = 8$   |           No          |
| Wednesday |   $8 \times 2 = 16$  |           No          |
|  Thursday |  $16 \times 2 = 32$  |           No          |
|   Friday  |  $32 \times 2 = 64$  |           No          |
|  Saturday |  $64 \times 2 = 128$ |           No          |
|   Sunday  | $128 \times 2 = 256$ |        Yes        |

Answer is Sunday
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the days after it become taller than two metres $= n$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{cm} \times 2^n  &> 2 \ \text{m} \\\\
4 \ \text{cm} \times 2^n  &> 200 \ \text{cm} \\\\
4 \times 2^n              &> 200 \\\\
2^n                       &> \dfrac {200} {4} \\\\
2^n                       &> \dfrac {50 \times 4} {4} \\\\
2^n                       &> \dfrac {50 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
2^n                       &> 50
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value by using trial and error. Lets find out a number that satisfies the above equation.

|  $n$         |   $2 ^ n$          |       $> 50?$      |
|:------------:|:------------------:|:------------------:|
|     $3$      |        $8$         |        No         |
|     $4$      |        $16$        |        No        |
|     $5$      |        $32$        |        No        |
|     $6$      |        $64$        |        Yes        |

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Day of the week} &= \text{Monday} + 6 \ \text{days} \\\\
                                                &= \text{Sunday}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Sunday

</div>
</div>

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \ \text{cm} \times 2^n  &> 2 \ \text{m} \\\\
4 \ \text{cm} \times 2^n  &> 200 \ \text{cm} \\\\
4 \times 2^n              &> 200 \\\\
2^n                       &> \dfrac {200} {4} \\\\
2^n                       &> \dfrac {50 \times 4} {4} \\\\
2^n                       &> \dfrac {50 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
2^n                       &> 50
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
We can easily infer the value by using trial and error. Lets find out a number that satisfies the above equation.
<emptyline>
|  $n$         |   $2 ^ n$          |       $> 50?$      |
|:------------:|:------------------:|:------------------:|
|     $3$      |        $8$         |        No         |
|     $4$      |        $16$        |        No        |
|     $5$      |        $32$        |        No        |
|     $6$      |        $64$        |        Yes        |
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Day of the week} &= \text{Monday} + 6 \ \text{days} \\\\
                                                &= \text{Sunday}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jonathan thinks of a whole number, multiplies it by itself  and adds $9$. He says that the answer is $47$.
Daisy think Jonathan has made a mistake. Do you agree? Explain your reasoning. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a^2 + 9 &= 47 \\\\
a^2 &= 47 - 9 \\\\
a^2 &= 38 
\end{aligned}
$

$38$ is not a perfect square and hence Jonathan has made a mistake.
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Yes

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a Latin test, Suril got $6$ times as many marks as Krishan.
Ashwini has twice as many as Krishan.

Ashiwini got $30$ marks. How many marks did Suril get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a Latin test, Suril got $6$ times as many marks as Krishan.
Ashwini has twice as many as Krishan.
<emptyline>
Ashiwini got $30$ marks. How many marks did Suril get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let marks Krishan got $= k$ 

Marks Suril got $= 6k$

Marks Ashwini got $= 2k$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times k &= 30 \\\\
k          &= \dfrac {30} {2} \\\\
k          &= \dfrac {2 \times 15} {2} \\\\
k          &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 15} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
k          &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Marks Suril got} &= 6 \times 15 \\\\
                       &= 90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$90$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Morose's team has lost $3$ times as many matches as they have won.

They have not drawn any matches. They have played $24$ matches.

How many matches they have won?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Morose's team has lost $3$ times as many matches as they have won.
<emptyline>
They have not drawn any matches. They have played $24$ matches.
<emptyline>
How many matches they have won?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of matches they won $= a$

Number of matches they lost $= 3a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 3a        &= 24 \\\\
4a            &= 24 \\\\
a             &= \dfrac {24} {4} \\\\
a             &= \dfrac {6 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a             &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
a             &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

Number of matches won $= 6$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$4$ oranges and $7$ apples weigh $51 \ \text{ounces}$.
$7$ oranges and $4$ apples weigh $48 \ \text{ounces}$.

What do $1$ apple and $1$ orange weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$4$ oranges and $7$ apples weigh $51 \ \text{ounces}$.
$7$ oranges and $4$ apples weigh $48 \ \text{ounces}$.
<emptyline>
What do $1$ apple and $1$ orange weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of $1$ apple $= a$

Let the weight of $1$ orange $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4b + 7a           &= 51 \\\\
7b + 4a           &= 48
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add both the equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
(4b + 7a) + (7b + 4a)           &= 51 + 48 \\\\
7a + 4a + 4b + 7b           &= 99 \\\\
11a + 11b                   &= 99 \\\\
11 \times ( a + b )         &= 99 \\\\
a + b                       &= \dfrac {99} {11} \\\\
a + b                       &= \dfrac {11 \times 9} {11} \\\\
a + b                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {11} \times 9} {\cancel {11}} \\\\
a + b                       &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Weight $= 9 \ \text{ounces}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9 \ \text{ounces}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a bag there are twice as many blue balls as red balls. There are $18$ balls altogether. How many blue balls are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a bag there are twice as many blue balls as red balls. There are $18$ balls altogether. How many blue balls are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of red balls $= r$

Number of blue balls $= 2r$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
r + 2r &= 18 \\\\
3r &= 18 \\\\
r &= \dfrac{18}{3} \\\\
r &= \dfrac{6 \times 3}{3} \\\\
r &= \dfrac{6 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
r &= 6 \\\\
\text{Number of blue balls} &= 2r \\\\
&= 2 \times 6 \\\\
&= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let number of red balls $= r$
<emptyline>
Number of blue balls $= 2r$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
r + 2r &= 18 \\\\
3r &= 18 \\\\
r &= \dfrac{18}{3} \\\\
r &= \dfrac{6 \times 3}{3} \\\\
r &= \dfrac{6 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
r &= 6 \\\\
\text{Number of blue balls} &= 2r \\\\
&= 2 \times 6 \\\\
&= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ayesha has some sweets. He gives $\dfrac{1}{6}$ of them to Neelesh.

Neelesh immediately eats one of them.

Neelesh now has $4$ left.

How many has Ayesha got left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ayesha has some sweets. He gives $\dfrac{1}{6}$ of them to Neelesh.
<emptyline>
Neelesh immediately eats one of them.
<emptyline>
Neelesh now has $4$ left.
<emptyline>
How many has Ayesha got left? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of sweets Ayesha had initially $= a$

Number of sweets Neelesh receives $= \dfrac{a}{6}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{a}{6} - 1 &= 4 \\\\
\dfrac{a}{6} &= 4 + 1 \\\\
\dfrac{a}{6} &= 5 \\\\
a &= 5 \times 6 \\\\
a &= 30 \\\\
\text{Sweets Neelesh received} &= 5 \\\\
\text{Sweets Ayesha has left} &= a - 5 \\\\
&= 30 - 5 \\\\
&= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the missing number in the following? 

$36 \div \boxed{?} = 4$

- $32$
- $8$
- $9$
- $12$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- $9$
- $12$ 
</code></pre>

a                   &= \dfrac {36} {4} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {4 \times 9} {4} \\\\
a                   &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 9} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 9$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I have a jar of sweets; after I have given each of the children in my class one sixteenth of sweets in the jar I have one quarter of the sweets left. How many children do I have in my class?

- $4$
- $9$
- $16$
- $12$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I have a jar of sweets; after I have given each of the children in my class one sixteenth of sweets in the jar I have one quarter of the sweets left. How many children do I have in my class?
<emptyline>
- $4$
- $9$
- $16$
- $12$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of children $= c$

Let the number of sweets in the jar $= w$

Each child gets $= \dfrac {1} {16} \times w$

If I am left with one quarter of the sweets, I must have given away $1 - \dfrac {1} {4} = \dfrac {3} {4}$ of the sweets.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
c \times \dfrac {1} {16} \times w                  &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times w \\\\
\dfrac {c \times w} {16}                           &= \dfrac {3 \times w} {4} \\\\
\dfrac {c \times w} {w}                           &= \dfrac {3 \times 16} {4} \\\\
\dfrac {c \times \cancel w} {\cancel w}            &= \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 4} {4} \\\\
c                                                &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4 \times 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
c                                                &= 3 \times 4 \\\\
c                                                &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

Number of children $= 12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>D</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The pie chart shows the proportions of different drinks chosen from a machine in one day.
There were $15$ cartons of pineapple juice taken. How many cartons of orange juice were taken? 

![papers/halifax-grammar-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q05-i00.png](/assets/papers/halifax-grammar-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q05-i00.png "papers/halifax-grammar-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q05-i00.png")

- $33$
- $35$
- $45$
- $120$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The pie chart shows the proportions of different drinks chosen from a machine in one day.
There were $15$ cartons of pineapple juice taken. How many cartons of orange juice were taken? 
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
- $33$
- $35$
- $45$
- $120$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of juices chosen $= c$

As per the pie chart,

$
\begin{aligned}
\% \ \text{of oranges}      &= 100 - 13 - 11 - 28 - 15 \\\\
                            &= 33 \%
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {11} {100} \times c              &= 15 \\\\
c                                       &= \dfrac {15 \times 100} {11} \\\\
\text{Orange juice cartons}             &= \dfrac {33} {100} \times c \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {33} {100} \times \dfrac {15 \times 100} {11} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {33 \times 15 \times 100} {100 \times 11} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 11 \times 15 \times 100} {100 \times 11} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {11} \times 15 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel {100} \times \cancel {11}} \\\\
                                        &= 3 \times 15 \\\\
                                        &= 45
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cartons of oranges $= 45$
</div>
</div>

<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<p>C</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$45$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$120$ pupils are sitting an exam. The pupils can choose whether to write in pencil or pen.

Two-fifths of the pupils are boys.

Three-quarters of the boys are writing in pencil.

One-third of the girls are writing in pen.

How many pupils are writing in pencil?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$120$ pupils are sitting an exam. The pupils can choose whether to write in pencil or pen.
<emptyline>
Two-fifths of the pupils are boys.
<emptyline>
Three-quarters of the boys are writing in pencil.
<emptyline>
One-third of the girls are writing in pen.
<emptyline>
How many pupils are writing in pencil?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of boys }             &= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 120 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 120} {5} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                    &= 48 \\\\
\text {Number of girls }            &= 120 - 48 \\\\
                                    &= 72
\end{aligned}
$

If one third of the girls are writing in pen, then the remaining $1 - \dfrac{1}{3} = \dfrac{2}{3}$ must be writing in pencil.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Girls writing with pencil }         &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 72 \\\\ 
\text{Boys writing with pencil }          &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 48 \\\\ 
\text{Total pupils writing with pencil}   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 72 + \dfrac {3} {4} \times 48 \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 72} {3}  + \dfrac {3 \times 48} {4} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times 3} {3}  + \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}}  + \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
                                          &= 2 \times 24 + 3 \times 12 \\\\
                                          &= 48 + 36 \\\\
                                          &= 84
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$84$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}

                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 120} {5} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                    &= 48 \\\\
\text {Number of girls }            &= 120 - 48 \\\\
                                    &= 72
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
If one third of the girls are writing in pen, then the remaining $1 - \dfrac{1}{3} = \dfrac{2}{3}$ must be writing in pencil.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Girls writing with pencil }         &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 72 \\\\ 
\text{Boys writing with pencil }          &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 48 \\\\ 
\text{Total pupils writing with pencil}   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 72 + \dfrac {3} {4} \times 48 \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 72} {3}  + \dfrac {3 \times 48} {4} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times 3} {3}  + \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}}  + \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
                                          &= 2 \times 24 + 3 \times 12 \\\\
                                          &= 48 + 36 \\\\
                                          &= 84
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tim is going paintballing. Entry into paintballing costs $\pounds 23$, but then you also have to pay $\pounds 6$ per $100$ paintballs that you use.

Tim spent $\pounds 65$ in total. How many paintballs did he use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tim is going paintballing. Entry into paintballing costs $\pounds 23$, but then you also have to pay $\pounds 6$ per $100$ paintballs that you use.
<emptyline>
Tim spent $\pounds 65$ in total. How many paintballs did he use?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount spent on paintballs} &= 65 - 23 \\\\
                                  &= \pounds 42 \\\\
\text{Number of sets of 100}      &= \dfrac{42}{6} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac{6 \times 7}{6} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac{\cancel 6 \times 7}{\cancel 6} \\\\
                                  &= 7 \\\\
\text{Total paintballs used}      &= 7 \times 100 \\\\
                                  &= 700
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$700$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Janice is running a bath. She  mixes hot water with cold water to make sure the temperature is just right.

She uses $5$ times more hot water than cold water. Janice's bath holds $90 \ \text{litres}$ of water in total. 
How much hot water does she use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Janice is running a bath. She  mixes hot water with cold water to make sure the temperature is just right.
<emptyline>
She uses $5$ times more hot water than cold water. Janice's bath holds $90 \ \text{litres}$ of water in total. 
How much hot water does she use?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of cold water $= c$

Amount of hot water $= 5c$

As per the question,

$\begin{aligned}
c + 5c &= 90 \\\\
6c &= 90 \\\\
c &= \dfrac{90}{6} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{6 \times 15}{6} \\\\
c &= \dfrac{\cancel 6 \times 15}{\cancel 6} \\\\
c &= 15 \ \text{litres} \\\\
\text{Hot water used} &= 5c \\\\
                      &= 5 \times 15 \\\\
                      &= 75 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the volume of hot water $= a$

Volume of cold water $= 90 - a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \ \text{litres} : 1 \ \text{litres}           &= a \ \text{litres} : (90 - a) \ \text{litres} \\\\
\dfrac {5} {1}                                  &= \dfrac {a} {90 - a} \\\\
5 \times (90 - a)                               &= 1 \times a \\\\
450 - 5a                                        &= a \\\\
450                                             &= a + 5a \\\\
a + 5a                                          &= 450 \\\\
6a                                              &= 450 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {450} {6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 75} {6} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 75} {\cancel 6} \\\\
a                                               &= 75 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$

Hot water used $= 75 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{total water}                        &:& \text{hot water} \\\\
= & 5 + 1                                     &:& 5  \\\\
= & 6                          &:& 5  \\\\
= & 6 \times 15                               &:& 5 \times 15 \\\\
= & 90 \ \text{litres}                        &:& 75 \ \text{litres}
\end{array}
$

Hot water used $= 75 \ \text{litres}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$75 \ \text{litres}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bob the Builder is filling a hole with a mixture of gravel and sand.
$234 \ \text{kg}$ of sand are needed to make $400 \ \text{kg}$ of the mixture.

Bob makes $1000 \ \text{kg}$ of the mixture.

How much gravel does Bob need?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bob the Builder is filling a hole with a mixture of gravel and sand.
$234 \ \text{kg}$ of sand are needed to make $400 \ \text{kg}$ of the mixture.
<emptyline>
Bob makes $1000 \ \text{kg}$ of the mixture.
<emptyline>
How much gravel does Bob need?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using whole to part ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{mixture}                    &:& \text{gravel} \\\\
= & 400 \ \text{kg}                   &:& (400 - 234) \ \text{kg} \\\\
= & 400                               &:& 166 \\\\
= & 1                                 &:& \dfrac {166} {400} \\\\
= & 1 \times 1000                     &:& \dfrac {166 \times 1000} {400} \\\\
= & 1000                              &:& \dfrac {2 \times 83 \times 200 \times 5} {2 \times 200} \\\\
= & 1000                              &:& \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 83 \times \cancel {200} \times 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel {200}} \\\\
= & 1000                              &:& 83 \times 5 \\\\
= & 1000 \ \text{kg}                  &:& 415 \ \text{kg}
\end{array}
$

Gravel needed $= 415 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$415 \ \text{kg}$
