<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Victoria the vet is weighing her pets.

Her rabbit and her cat together weigh $10 \ \text{kg}$.

Her cat and dog together weigh $24 \ \text{kg}$.

Her dog and rabbit together weigh $20 \ \text{kg}$.

How much do all $3$ of her pets weigh when weighed together?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Victoria the vet is weighing her pets.
<emptyline>
Her rabbit and her cat together weigh $10 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
Her cat and dog together weigh $24 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
Her dog and rabbit together weigh $20 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
How much do all $3$ of her pets weigh when weighed together?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of rabbit $= r$

Let the weight of cat $= c$

Let the weight of dog $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
r + c       &= 10 \\\\
c + d       &= 24 \\\\
d + r       &= 20
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add all the three equations together.

$
\begin{aligned}
(r + c) + (c + d) + (d + r)       &= 10 + 24 + 20 \\\\
2r + 2 c + 2d               &= 54 \\\\
2 \times (r + c + d)        &= 54 \\\\
r + c + d                   &= \dfrac {54} {2} \\\\
r + c + d                   &= \dfrac {2 \times 27} {2} \\\\
r + c + d                   &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 27} {\cancel 2} \\\\
r + c + d                   &= 27 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight $= 27 \ \text{kg}$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27 \ text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

In the town of Mathsville there are $360$ residents.

$45 \%$ of the residents are children, the rest are adults.

How many adults are there in Mathsville?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the town of Mathsville there are $360$ residents.
<emptyline>
$45 \%$ of the residents are children, the rest are adults.
<emptyline>

What percentage of the pupils are boys?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$

$

**Question**

The price of a bus ticket from Mathsville to Numbertown has **increased** by $50\%$ in the past year. 
A bus ticket now costs $\pounds 1.80$.

What did it cost a year ago?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The price of a bus ticket from Mathsville to Numbertown has **increased** by $50\%$ in the past year. 
A bus ticket now costs $\pounds 1.80$.
<emptyline>
What did it cost a year ago?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of bus ticket a year ago $= a$

If the bus ticket cost increased by $50 \%$, then the new cost will be $100 + 50 = 150 \%$ of the previous price.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {150} {100} \times a &= 1.80 \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {1.80 \times 100} {150} \\\\
a                        &=  \dfrac {0.60 \times 3 \times 50 \times 2} {50 \times 3} \\\\
a                        &=  \dfrac {0.60 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel {50} \times 2} {\cancel {50} \times \cancel 3} \\\\
a                        &= 0.60 \times 2 \\\\
a                        &= \pounds 1.20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.20$

</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mathsville Maths Supplies is a shop selling maths equipment.

Tina bought $4$ calculators and $3$ protractors for $\pounds 16.10$.
Ahmed bought $2$ calculators and $1$ protractors for $\pounds 7.50$.

How much does a calculator cost, and how much does a protractor cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mathsville Maths Supplies is a shop selling maths equipment.
<emptyline>
Tina bought $4$ calculators and $3$ protractors for $\pounds 16.10$.
Ahmed bought $2$ calculators and $1$ protractors for $\pounds 7.50$.
<emptyline>
How much does a calculator cost, and how much does a protractor cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a calculator $= c$

Let the cost of a protractor $= p$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4c + 3p &= 16.10 \\\\
2c + p  &= 7.50
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them .Let's use elimination to reduce it to just one variable. 

Multiply second equation by $3$.

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \times 2c + 3 \times p    &= 3 \times 7.50 \\\\
6c + 3p                     &= 22.5
\end{aligned}
$

Subtract first equation from the above equations.

$
\begin{aligned} 
6c + 3p - (4c + 3p)         &= 22.50 - 16.10 \\\\
6c + 3p - 4c - 3p           &= 6.40 \\\\
2c                          &= 6.40 \\\\
c                           &= \pounds 3.20
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the above value in second equation

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times 3.20 + p  &= 7.50 \\\\
6.40 + p           &= 7.50 \\\\
p                 &= 7.50 - 6.40 \\\\
p                 &= \pounds 1.10
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a calculator $= \pounds 3.20$

Cost of a protractor $= \pounds 1.10$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

caclulator $=$ $\pounds 3.20$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

protractor $=$ $\pounds 1.10$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Football is very popular in Numbertown.

Two fifths of the population support London Mathletic.

The rest support either Mathsville United or the Counting Crows.

Twice as many people support Mathsville United than support the Counting Crows.

$500$ people supporting the Counting Crows.

What is the total population of Numbertown?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Football is very popular in Numbertown.

Twice as many people support Mathsville United than support the Counting Crows.

What is the total population of Numbertown?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total population of Numbertown $= a$

People supporting London Mathletic $= \dfrac {2a} {5}$

People supporting rest $= a - \dfrac {2a} {5} = \dfrac {3a} {5}$

People supporting Couting Crows $= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3a} {5}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3a} {5} &= 500 \\\\
a &= \dfrac {500 \times 5 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a &= \dfrac {500 \times 5 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a &= 500 \times 5 \\\\
a &= 2500
\end{aligned}
$

Total population of Numbertown $= 2500$
</div>

Javier buys $4$ hamsters and $3$ gerbils.

**Question**

Chickens and chicks all have $2$ wings. There are $8$ chickens in the shop, and each of these $8$ chickens has $5$ chicks.

How many wings are there in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Chickens and chicks all have $2$ wings. There are $8$ chickens in the shop, and each of these $8$ chickens has $5$ chicks.
<emptyline>
How many wings are there in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of chicks} &= 8 \times 5 \\\\
                        &= 40 \\\\
\text{Total wings}  &= 8 \times 2 + 40 \times 2 \\\\

**Question**

$7$ cat bowls cost the same as $4$ dog leads.
$3$ cat bowls cost $\pounds 72$.

What does a dog lead cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$7$ cat bowls cost the same as $4$ dog leads.
$3$ cat bowls cost $\pounds 72$.
<emptyline>
What does a dog lead cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of a cat bowl}  &= \dfrac {72} {3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {3 \times 24} {3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 24} {\cancel3} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 24
\end{aligned}
$

Let the cost of a dog lead $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times d                  &= 7 \times 24 \\\\
d                           &= \dfrac {7 \times 24} {4} \\\\
d                           &= \dfrac {7 \times 6 \times 4} {4} \\\\
d                           &= \dfrac {7 \times 6 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
d                           &= \pounds 42
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a dog lead $= \pounds 42 $
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The shop has a sale on stick insects: "buy $3$ stick insects and get a $4 ^\text{th}$ stick insect free".

Ahmed paid $\pounds 17.85$ for $20$ insects. What is the cost of $1$ stick insect?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The shop has a sale on stick insects: "buy $3$ stick insects and get a $4 ^\text{th}$ stick insect free".
<emptyline>
Ahmed paid $\pounds 17.85$ for $20$ insects. What is the cost of $1$ stick insect?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the offer, Ahmed only pays for $3$ out of every $4$ insects he buys.

He bought $20$ insects in total. So, he received $20 \div 4 = 5$ insects for free and paid for the remaining $15$ insects.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{ Cost of 1 stick insect} &= \dfrac {17.85} {20 - 5} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac {17.85} {15} \\\\
                               &= \pounds 1.19
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.19$

</div>
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a charity fun run, one sixth of the runners were adults, and the rest were children.
There were $120$ adults in the race. 

How many children were running the race?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a charity fun run, one sixth of the runners were adults, and the rest were children.
There were $120$ adults in the race. 
<emptyline>
How many children were running the race?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of runners $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{1} {6} \times a &= 120 \\\\
\dfrac{a} {6}                 &= 120 \\\\
a                             &= 120 \times 6 \\\\
a                             &= 720
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of children} &= \dfrac{5} {6} \times 720 \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac{5 \times 720} {6} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac{5 \times 6 \times 120} {6} \\\\
                                  &= \dfrac{5 \times \cancel 6 \times 120} {\cancel 6} \\\\
                                  &= 5 \times 120 \\\\
                                  &= 600
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tickets to enter a fairground cost $\pounds 7.00$ for adults and $\pounds 3.00$ for children. 
Once inside the fairground, each ride costs $\pounds 3.00$ for adults and $\pounds 1.50$ for children.

Joe and his $2$ grandchildren, Amy and Peter, go to the fairground. Joe goes on $2$ rides, and Peter goes on four times as many rides 
as Amy.

In total they spend $\pounds 34.00$ between them. How many rides did Peter go on?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tickets to enter a fairground cost $\pounds 7.00$ for adults and $\pounds 3.00$ for children. 
Once inside the fairground, each ride costs $\pounds 3.00$ for adults and $\pounds 1.50$ for children.
<emptyline>
Joe and his $2$ grandchildren, Amy and Peter, go to the fairground. Joe goes on $2$ rides, and Peter goes on four times as many rides 
as Amy.
<emptyline>
In total they spend $\pounds 34.00$ between them. How many rides did Peter go on?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of rides Amy goes to $= a$

Number of rides Peter goes to $= 4a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(7 + 3 \times 2) + (3 \times 2 + 1.5 \times a + 1.5 \times 4a) &= 34 \\\\
7 + 6 + 6 + 1.5a + 6a                                      &= 34 \\\\
7.5a + 19                                                  &= 34 \\\\
7.5a                                                       &= 34 - 19 \\\\
7.5a                                                       &= 15 \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac {15} {7.5} \\\\
a                                                       &= \dfrac {15 \times 10} {75} \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac {150} {75} \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac {75 \times 2} {75} \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac {\cancel {75} \times 2} {\cancel{75}} \\\\
a                                                          &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of rides Peter goes to} &= 4a \\\\
                                     &= 4 \times 2 \\\\
                                     &= 8 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A watch shop has a $2$ day winter sale. On the first day, two thirds of all the watches are sold. 
On the second day, a quarter of the remaining watches are sold.

The shop sold $72$ watches on the first day. How many watches were sold on the second day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A watch shop has a $2$ day winter sale. On the first day, two thirds of all the watches are sold. 
On the second day, a quarter of the remaining watches are sold.
<emptyline>
The shop sold $72$ watches on the first day. How many watches were sold on the second day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of watches $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {2} {3} \times a &= 72 \\\\
\dfrac {2a} {3}                &= 72 \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac {72 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 3} {2} \\\\
a                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 36 \times 3} {\cancel 2} \\\\
a                              &=  36 \times 3 \\\\
a                              &=  108
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Watches remaining after first day} &= 108 - 72 \\\\
                                        &= 36 \\\\
\text{Watches sold on the second day} &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 36 \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {36} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {4 \times 9} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 9} {\cancel 4} \\\\                
                                                &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A rectangle is split into two smaller rectangles, labelled $A$ and $B$. Rectangle $A$ is shaded. One seventh of the original rectangle 
is shaded.

![papers/highgate-school/sample/sample-paper-b/s01-q02-s04-i00.png](/assets/papers/highgate-school/sample/sample-paper-b/s01-q02-s04-i00.png "papers/highgate-school/sample/sample-paper-b/s01-q02-s04-i00.png")

With scissors, I cut off and remove a third of rectangle $B$. What fraction of the remaining shape is now shaded?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A rectangle is split into two smaller rectangles, labelled $A$ and $B$. Rectangle $A$ is shaded. One seventh of the original rectangle 
is shaded.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
With scissors, I cut off and remove a third of rectangle $B$. What fraction of the remaining shape is now shaded?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let area of rectangle A $= a$

Area of rectangle B $= 6a$

If we remove one third of rectangle B, the new area of rectangle B will be $1 - \dfrac{1}{3} = \dfrac{2}{3}$ of its original area.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New area of rectangle B} &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times  6a \\\\
                               &= \dfrac {2 \times 6a} {3} \\\\
                               &= 4a
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of shaded shape} &= \dfrac {a} {a + 4a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {a} {5a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel a} {5 \times \cancel a} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1} {5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {5} $

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A bag contains $600$ sweets. Sweets are either red, blue or green. There are $8$ more red sweets than blue sweets. 
$30\%$ of the sweets are blue. How many sweets are green?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bag contains $600$ sweets. Sweets are either red, blue or green. There are $8$ more red sweets than blue sweets. 
$30\%$ of the sweets are blue. How many sweets are green?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of blue sweets}  & = \dfrac {30} {100} \times 600 \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {30 \times 600} {100} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {30 \times 6 \times 100} {100} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {30 \times 6 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel{100}} \\\\
                              &= 30 \times 6  \\\\
                              &= 180 \\\\
\text{Number of red sweets}   &= 180 + 8 \\\\
                              &= 188 \\\\
\text{Number of green sweets} &= 600 - 188 - 180  \\\\
                              &= 232
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

In a sale, the price of a toy car is reduced by $40\%$. 

I buy the toy car for $\pounds 42$. What did it cost before the sale?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a sale, the price of a toy car is reduced by $40\%$. 
<emptyline>
I buy the toy car for $\pounds 42$. What did it cost before the sale?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of toy car before sale $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a - \dfrac {40} {100} \times a                     &= 42 \\\\
a - 0.4a                                       &= 42 \\\\
0.6a                                          &= 42 \\\\
a                                         &= \dfrac {42} {0.6} \\\\
a                                         &= \dfrac {42 \times 10} {6} \\\\
a                                         &= \dfrac {7 \times 6 \times 10} {6} \\\\
a                                         &= \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 7 \times 10} {\cancel 6} \\\\
a                                         &= 7 \times 10 \\\\
a                                         &= \pounds 70
\end{aligned}
$

Cost before sale $= \pounds 70$
</div>

**Question**

Fido the Dog ate $16$ pork sausages and $24$ lamb sausages. What percentage of Fido's sausages were lamb?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fido the Dog ate $16$ pork sausages and $24$ lamb sausages. What percentage of Fido's sausages were lamb?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Lamb sausage \%} &= \dfrac{24} {24 + 16} \times 100 \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac{24} {40} \times 100 \\\\ 
                                                    &= \dfrac{24 \times 100} {40}  \\\\  
                                                    &= \dfrac{4 \times 6 \times 10 \times 10} {4 \times 10}  \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac{\cancel 4 \times 6 \times \cancel {10} \times 10} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel {10}}  \\\\
                                                    &= 6 \times 10 \\\\
                                                    &= 60 \% 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jack and Jill are buying chocolates in a Chocolate Shop.

Jack bought $6$ chocolate frogs and $5$ truffles for $\pounds 9.55$.

Jill bought $3$ chocolate frogs and $3$ truffles for $\pounds 5.25$.

How much does a chocolate frog cost, and how much does a truffle cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jack and Jill are buying chocolates in a Chocolate Shop.
<emptyline>
Jack bought $6$ chocolate frogs and $5$ truffles for $\pounds 9.55$.
<emptyline>
Jill bought $3$ chocolate frogs and $3$ truffles for $\pounds 5.25$.
<emptyline>
How much does a chocolate frog cost, and how much does a truffle cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of a chocolate frog $= c$

Let the cost of a truffle $= t$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6c + 5t &= 9.55 \\\\
3c + 3t &= 5.25 
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's use elimination to reduce it to just one variable. 

Let's multiply the second equation by $2$.

$
\begin{aligned}
3c \times 2 + 3t \times 2   &= 5.25 \times 2 \\\\
6c + 6t                     &= 10.50
\end{aligned}
$

Let's subtract the first equation from the above equation.

$
\begin{aligned} 
6c + 6t - (6c + 5t)         &= 10.50 - 9.55 \\\\
6c + 6t - 6c - 5t         &= 10.50 - 9.55 \\\\
t                        &= 0.95 
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $t$ in second equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
3c + 3 \times 0.95 &= 5.25 \\\\
3c                 &= 5.25 - 2.85 \\\\
3c                 &= 2.4 \\\\
c                  &= \dfrac{2.4}{3} \\\\
c                  &= \pounds 0.80
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of a chocolate frog $= \pounds 0.80$

Cost of a truffle $= \pounds 0.95$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Chocolate frog $=$ $ \pounds 0.80$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the cost of a chocolate frog $= c$

Let the cost of a truffle $= t$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
6c + 5t &= 9.55 \\\\
3c + 3t &= 5.25 
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's use elimination to reduce it to just one variable. 
<emptyline>
Let's multiply the second equation by $2$.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
3c \times 2 + 3t \times 2   &= 5.25 \times 2 \\\\
6c + 6t                     &= 10.50
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's subtract the first equation from the above equation.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned} 
6c + 6t - (6c + 5t)         &= 10.50 - 9.55 \\\\
6c + 6t - 6c - 5t         &= 10.50 - 9.55 \\\\
t                        &= 0.95 
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Substituting the value of $t$ in second equation,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
3c + 3 \times 0.95 &= 5.25 \\\\
3c                 &= 5.25 - 2.85 \\\\
3c                 &= 2.4 \\\\
c                  &= \dfrac{2.4}{3} \\\\
c                  &= \pounds 0.80
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Cost of a chocolate frog $= \pounds 0.80$
<emptyline>
Cost of a truffle $= \pounds 0.95$
</code></pre>

**Question**

An artist mixes red, yellow and white paint to create a new shade of orange.

Two fifths of the mixture is yellow paint.

The artist uses three times as much red paint as white paint.

In total, the artist mixes $180 \ \text{ml}$ orange paint.

How much red paint does the artist need?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An artist mixes red, yellow and white paint to create a new shade of orange.
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let white paint used $= a$

Red paint used $= 3a $

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 3a + \dfrac {2} {5} \times 180  &= 180 \\\\
4a                                  &= 180 - \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5} \\\\
4a                                  &= 180 - \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 5} {5} \\\\
4a                                  &= 180 - \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5} \\\\
4a                                  &= 180 - 72 \\\\
4a                                  &= 108 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {108} {4} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {4 \times 27} {4} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 27} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                   &= 27 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Red paint used}               &= 3a \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 27 \\\\
                                    &= 81 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$81 \ \text{ml}$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tanya mixes cranberry juice and lemonade to make a refreshing drink.
She uses $3$ times more lemonade than cranberry juice to make the drink.

Tanya uses $759 \ \text{ml}$ of lemonade.

How much of the drink does she make?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tanya mixes cranberry juice and lemonade to make a refreshing drink.
She uses $3$ times more lemonade than cranberry juice to make the drink.
<emptyline>
Tanya uses $759 \ \text{ml}$ of lemonade.
<emptyline>
How much of the drink does she make?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the amount of cranberry juice used $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
1 \ \text{ml} : 3 \ \text{ml}    &= a \ \text{ml} : 759 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\dfrac{1} {3}                                              &= \dfrac{a} {759} \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac{759} {3} \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac{3 \times 253} {3} \\\\
a                                                          &= \dfrac{\cancel 3 \times 253} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                                          &= 253 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total volume of drink}      &= 253 + 759 \\\\
                                  &= 1012 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{lemonade}                    &:& \text{cranberry juice} \\\\
= & 3                                  &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                                  &:& \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
= & 759                                &:& \dfrac {759} {3} \\\\
= & 759                                &:& \dfrac {3 \times 253} {3} \\\\
= & 759                                &:& \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 253} {\cancel 3} \\\\
= & 759 \ \text{ml}                    &:& 253 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total volume of drink}      &= 253 + 759 \\\\
                                  &= 1012 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1012 \ \text{ml}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a maths test pupils have to answer all $20$ questions. $3$ marks are awarded for each correct answer, 
but $1$ mark is subtracted for each incorrect answer.

Bobby answers $4$ more questions correctly than Tim, and between them they score $48$ marks in total. 
How many questions did Tim answer correctly?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a maths test pupils have to answer all $20$ questions. $3$ marks are awarded for each correct answer, 
but $1$ mark is subtracted for each incorrect answer.
<emptyline>
Bobby answers $4$ more questions correctly than Tim, and between them they score $48$ marks in total. 
How many questions did Tim answer correctly?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of correct answers by Tim $= t$

Incorrect answers by Tim $= 20 - t$

Number of correct answers by Bobby $= t + 4$

Incorrect answers by Bobby $= 20 - (t + 4)$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \times t + 3 \times (t + 4) - (20 - t) - (20 - (t + 4))   &= 48 \\\\
3t + 3t + 12 - 20 + t -20 + t + 4                &= 48 \\\\
8t                               &= 48 - 12 + 20 + 20 - 4 \\\\
8t                                                          &= 72 \\\\
t                                                           &= \dfrac {72} {8} \\\\
t                                                           &= \dfrac {8 \times 9} {8} \\\\
t                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel 8 \times 9} {\cancel 8} \\\\
t                                                           &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number of correct answers by Tim $= 9$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

In the mathematics puzzles below, the numbers in the square boxes are found by multiplying the two numbers in the circles it is 
joined to together.

Fill in all of the missing numbers in both the circles and the squares. The first puzzle has been solved for you as an example.

![papers/highgate-school/sample/sample-paper-c/s01-q03-s04-i00.png](/assets/papers/highgate-school/sample/sample-paper-c/s01-q03-s04-i00.png "papers/highgate-school/sample/sample-paper-c/s01-q03-s04-i00.png")

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the mathematics puzzles below, the numbers in the square boxes are found by multiplying the two numbers in the circles it is

<emptyline>

<emptyline>
%image%

**Working**

TODO Make multiple sub subquestions if necessary.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Value in the first square}            &= 7 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= 21 \\\\
\text{Value in the first circle}            &= \dfrac {18} {3} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {6 \times 3} {3} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                            &= 6 \\\\
\text{Value in the second square}           &= 7 \times 6 \\\\
                                            &= 42 \\\\
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the value in first circle $= a$

Value in second circle $= b$

Value in third circle $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times b    &= 12 \\\\
b \times c    &= 20 \\\\
c \times a    &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Let's multiply all the equation together to get the product of a, b and c.

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times b \times b \times c \times c \times a   &= 12 \times 20 \times 15 \\\\
a \times a \times b \times b \times c \times c   &= 3600 \\\\
a ^ 2 \times b ^ 2 \times c ^ 2                  &= 3600 \\\\
(a \times b \times c) ^ 2                        &= 3600 \\\\
a \times b \times c                              &= \sqrt {3600} \\\\
a \times b \times c                              &= 60
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the product of a \times b \times c  to find the value of c.

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a \times b \times c} {a \times b}                                   &= \dfrac {60} {12} \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel a \times \cancel b \times c} {\cancel a \times \cancel b}   &= \dfrac {12 \times 5} {12} \\\\
c                                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 5} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
c                                                                           &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the product of a \times b \times c  to find the value of a.

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a \times b \times c} {b \times c}                                   &= \dfrac {60} {20} \\\\
\dfrac {a \times \cancel b \times \cancel c} {\cancel b \times \cancel c}   &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {20} \\\\
a                                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {20} \times 3} {\cancel {20}} \\\\
a                                                                           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

Let's use the product of a \times b \times c  to find the value of c.

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a \times b \times c} {c \times a}                                   &= \dfrac {60} {15} \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel a \times b \times \cancel c} {\cancel c \times \cancel a}   &= \dfrac {15 \times 4} {15} \\\\
c                                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {15} \times 4} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
c                                                                           &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Value in first circle $= 3$.

Value in second circle $= 4$.

Value in third circle $= 5$.

                                            &= \dfrac {75 \times 5} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {375} {100} \\\\
                                            &= 3.75
\end{aligned}
$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the value in first circle $= a$

Value in third circle $= c$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
a \times b    &= 12 \\\\
b \times c    &= 20 \\\\
c \times a    &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's multiply all the equation together to get the product of a, b and c.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
a \times b \times b \times c \times c \times a   &= 12 \times 20 \times 15 \\\\
a \times a \times b \times b \times c \times c   &= 3600 \\\\
a ^ 2 \times b ^ 2 \times c ^ 2                  &= 3600 \\\\
(a \times b \times c) ^ 2                        &= 3600 \\\\
a \times b \times c                              &= \sqrt {3600} \\\\
a \times b \times c                              &= 60
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's use the product of a \times b \times c  to find the value of c.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a \times b \times c} {a \times b}                                   &= \dfrac {60} {12} \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel a \times \cancel b \times c} {\cancel a \times \cancel b}   &= \dfrac {12 \times 5} {12} \\\\
c                                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 5} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
c                                                                           &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's use the product of a \times b \times c  to find the value of a.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a \times b \times c} {b \times c}                                   &= \dfrac {60} {20} \\\\
\dfrac {a \times \cancel b \times \cancel c} {\cancel b \times \cancel c}   &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {20} \\\\
a                                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {20} \times 3} {\cancel {20}} \\\\
a                                                                           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's use the product of a \times b \times c  to find the value of c.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a \times b \times c} {c \times a}                                   &= \dfrac {60} {15} \\\\
\dfrac {\cancel a \times b \times \cancel c} {\cancel c \times \cancel a}   &= \dfrac {15 \times 4} {15} \\\\
c                                                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {15} \times 4} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
c                                                                           &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Value in first circle $= 3$.

Value in second circle $= 4$.
<emptyline>
Value in third circle $= 5$.

**Question**

Mr Rossi owns an ice cream van.
Yesterday he had $140$ customers. $35\%$ of them bought a choc ice.

How many people bought a choc ice?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr Rossi owns an ice cream van.
Yesterday he had $140$ customers. $35\%$ of them bought a choc ice.
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of people} &= 35 \% \ \text{of} \ 140 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {35} {100} \times 140 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {35 \times 140 } {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times 2 \times 7 \times 10 } {2 \times 5 \times 10} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 7 \times \cancel 2 \times 7 \times \cancel{10} } {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel{10}} \\\\
                                            &= 7 \times 7 \\\\
                                            &= 49
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$49$

**Question**

Mr Rossi has a sale on fizzy drinks. He has reduced his prices by $30\%$. A can of cola now costs $98 \ \text{pence}$.

What did a can of cola cost before the sale?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost $= a$

If the price is reduced by $30\%$, then the new price $=100 - 30 = 70 \%$ of the original price.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}

\dfrac {70a} {100}                                &= 98 \\\\

a                                                 &= \dfrac {14 \times \cancel 7 \times \cancel {10} \times 10} {\cancel 7 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
a                                                 &= 140 \ \text{p} \\\\
a                                                 &= \pounds 1.40
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tori bought $5$ jelly worms and $7$ sherbet dib-dabs for $\pounds 3.37$.
Meera bought $5$ jelly worms and $2$ sherbet dib-dabs for $\pounds 1.57$.

How much does a jelly worm cost, and how much does a sherbet dib-dab cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tori bought $5$ jelly worms and $7$ sherbet dib-dabs for $\pounds 3.37$.
Meera bought $5$ jelly worms and $2$ sherbet dib-dabs for $\pounds 1.57$.
<emptyline>
How much does a jelly worm cost, and how much does a sherbet dib-dab cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cost of jelly worm $= w$

Let the cost of sherbet dib-dab $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5w + 7d &= 3.37 \\\\
5w + 2d &= 1.57
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Let's use elimination to reduce it to just one variable. 

Subtract second equation from the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
5w + 7d - (5w + 2d)  &= 3.37 - 1.57 \\\\
5w + 7d - 5w - 2d    &= 3.37 - 1.57 \\\\
5d                 &= 1.8 \\\\
d                  &= \dfrac{1.8}{5} \\\\
d                  &= \pounds 0.36
\end{aligned}
$

Let's substitute the value of $b$ in one of the equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
5w + 2d &= 1.57 \\\\
5w + 2 \times 0.36 &= 1.57 \\\\
5w + 0.72          &= 1.57 \\\\
5w                 &= 1.57 - 0.72 \\\\
5w                 &= 0.85 \\\\
w                  &= \dfrac {0.85} {5} \\\\
w                  &= \pounds 0.17
\end{aligned}
$

Cost of jelly worm $= \pounds 0.17$

Cost of sherbet dib-dab $= \pounds 0.36$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Jelly worm $=$ $\pounds 0.17 $

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Sherbet dib-dab $=$ $ \pounds 0.36$

</div>
</div>

<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr Rossi is looking at his monthly accounts.

Two fifths of his money was made from selling ice cream.

The rest of his money came from selling sweets and from selling fizzy drinks.

He made twice as much money from selling fizzy drinks than from sweets.

He made $\pounds 330$ from selling fizzy drinks.

How much money does he make in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr Rossi is looking at his monthly accounts.
<emptyline>
Two fifths of his money was made from selling ice cream.
<emptyline>
The rest of his money came from selling sweets and from selling fizzy drinks.
<emptyline>
He made twice as much money from selling fizzy drinks than from sweets.
<emptyline>
He made $\pounds 330$ from selling fizzy drinks.
<emptyline>
How much money does he make in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total money $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money from ice cream}                 &= \dfrac {2} {5} a \\\\
\text{Money from sweets and drinks}         &= a - \dfrac {2} {5} a \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {a \times 5} {5}  - \dfrac {2a} {5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5a} {5}  - \dfrac {2a} {5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5a -2a} {5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {3a} {5} \\\\
\text{Money from fizzy drinks}              &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {3a} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {3a} {5}   &= 330 \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {330 \times 3 \times 5} {3 \times 2} \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {165 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5} {3 \times 2} \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {165 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times 5} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
a                                       &= \dfrac {165 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times 5} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
a                                       &= 165 \times 5 \\\\
a                                       &= \pounds 825
\end{aligned}
$

Total money $= \pounds 825$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 825$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Roger drops his ball onto a hard surface. 
Each time it bounces, it rebounds to exactly one third of the height from which it fell. 
After the second bounce the ball rises to a height of $9 \ \text{cm}$. 

From what height was it originally dropped?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Roger drops his ball onto a hard surface. 
Each time it bounces, it rebounds to exactly one third of the height from which it fell. 
After the second bounce the ball rises to a height of $9 \ \text{cm}$. 
<emptyline>
From what height was it originally dropped?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the height it was originally dropped from $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {3} \times a  &= 9 \\\\
a                           &= 9 \times 3 \times 3 \\\\
a                           &= 81 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$81 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A comb for horses has $100$ teeth, each $1 \ \text{mm}$ wide. The gaps between the teeth are also $1 \ \text{mm}$ wide.

How long is the comb in centimetres?

![papers/james-allens-girls-school/2020/sample-paper-2/s01-q14-i00.png](/assets/papers/james-allens-girls-school/2020/sample-paper-2/s01-q14-i00.png "papers/james-allens-girls-school/2020/sample-paper-2/s01-q14-i00.png")  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A comb for horses has $100$ teeth, each $1 \ \text{mm}$ wide. The gaps between the teeth are also $1 \ \text{mm}$ wide.
<emptyline>
How long is the comb in centimetres?
<emptyline>
%image%  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length} = &= \text{(width of 100 teeth)} + \text{(width of 99 gaps)} \\\\  
                          &= 100 \times 1 + 99 \times 1 \\\\
                            &= 100  + 99  \\\\
                            &= 199 \ \text {mm} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {199} {10} \ \text{cm} \\\\
                            &= 19.9 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19.9 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jack likes to eat lots of fruit. 
He finds that four apples and two oranges cost $\pounds 1.54$ and that two oranges and four bananas 
cost $\pounds 1.70$. 

How much would he have to pay if he bought one apple, one orange and one banana? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jack likes to eat lots of fruit. 
He finds that four apples and two oranges cost $\pounds 1.54$ and that two oranges and four bananas 
cost $\pounds 1.70$. 
<emptyline>
How much would he have to pay if he bought one apple, one orange and one banana? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let cost of an apple $= a$

Let cost of a banana $= b$

Let cost of an orange $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
4a + 2c       &= 1.54 \\\\
2c + 4b       &= 1.70
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add both the equations.

$
\begin{aligned}
4a + 2c + (2c + 4b)    &= 1.54 + 1.70 \\\\
4a + 4b + 4c         &= 3.24 \\\\
4 \times (a + b + c) &= 3.24 \\\\
a + b + c            &= \dfrac {3.24} {4} \\\\
a + b + c            &= \pounds 0.81 
\end{aligned}
$

Total cost $= \pounds 0.81$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two fifths of the children in a swimming pool are boys.

There are $72$ girls in the pool. How many boys are there? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two fifths of the children in a swimming pool are boys.
<emptyline>
There are $72$ girls in the pool. How many boys are there? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total students $= a$

If the boys are two fifths, then the girls are $1 - \dfrac {2} {5} = \dfrac {3} {5}$ of the children.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {5} \times a                        &= 72 \\\\
\dfrac {3a} {5}                                 &= 72 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {72 \times 5} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {24 \times 3 \times 5} {3} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {24 \times \cancel {3} \times 5} {\cancel {3} } \\\\
a                                               &= 24 \times 5 \\\\
a                                               &= 120 
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of boys}  &= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 120 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 120} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 24 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                        &= 2 \times 24 \\\\
                        &= 48
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Pauline has $90 \ \text{p}$ that she wants to share between $7$ girls and $4$ boys so that the girls each have twice as much as the boys. 
How much does each girl and each boy receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pauline has $90 \ \text{p}$ that she wants to share between $7$ girls and $4$ boys so that the girls each have twice as much as the boys. 
How much does each girl and each boy receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let each boy gets $= a$

Each girl gets $= 2a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
7 \times 2a + 4 \times a        &= 90 \\\\
14a + 4a                &= 90 \\\\
18a                     &= 90 \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {90} {18} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {18 \times 5} {18} \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {18} \times 5} {\cancel {18}} \\\\
a                       &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Each boy gets}  &= 5\ \text{p} \\\\
\text{Each girl gets} &= 2 \times 5 \\\\
                      &= 10\ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

boy $=$ $5\ \text{p}$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

girl $=$ $10\ \text{p}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let each boy gets $= a$

a                       &= \dfrac {\cancel {18} \times 5} {\cancel {18}} \\\\
a                       &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

\begin{aligned}

\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A menswear shop sells $7$ times as many white shirts as checked shirts. $72$ shirts are sold in total. How many white shirts are sold? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A menswear shop sells $7$ times as many white shirts as checked shirts. $72$ shirts are sold in total. How many white shirts are sold? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of checked shirts sold $= a$

Then, the number of white shirts sold $= 7a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 7 a &= 72 \\\\
8 a     &= 72 \\\\
a       &= \dfrac {72} {8} \\\\
a       &= \dfrac {8 \times 9} {8} \\\\
a       &= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 9} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
a       &= 9 \\\\
\text{Number of white shirts sold} &= 7 \times a \\\\
                                   &= 7 \times 9 \\\\
                                   &= 63
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$63$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sara thinks of a number. 
She subtracts twelve, then divides by two and then adds fifteen. 
Her answer is $37$. What is the number that Sara first thought of? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sara thinks of a number. 
She subtracts twelve, then divides by two and then adds fifteen. 
Her answer is $37$. What is the number that Sara first thought of? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {1} {2} \times (a - 12) + 15   &= 37 \\\\
\dfrac {a - 12} {2}        &= 37 - 15 \\\\
\dfrac {a - 12} {2}        &= 22 \\\\
a - 12                     &= 22 \times 2 \\\\
a                          &= 44 + 12 \\\\
a                          &= 56
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$56$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

An orange drink is made by mixing water with concentrated orange juice.

$\dfrac{3}{4}$ of the orange drink is water.

How many litres of water will be in $12 \ \text{litres}$ of orange drink?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An orange drink is made by mixing water with concentrated orange juice.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{3}{4}$ of the orange drink is water.
<emptyline>
How many litres of water will be in $12 \ \text{litres}$ of orange drink?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Water in the orange}  &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times 12 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {3 \times 12} {4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {3 \times 3 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {3 \times 3 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
                            &= 3 \times 3 \\\\
                            &= 9 \ \text {litres}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9 \ \text {litres}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A teacher has $5$ bags of marbles and $3$ extra marbles.
Each bag has $n$ marbles inside.

She ask: 'How many marbles are there altogether?'

The pupil's say:


Nia: $8n$

Vijay: $3 + 5n$

Sam: $8$

Jo: $15n$

Karen: $5 \times n + 3$

Glyn: $(3 + 5)n$

There are $88$ marbles altogether.

Fill in one pupil's right answer to help you complete the equation.

Solve the equation to find $n$, the the number of marbles in a bag.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A teacher has $5$ bags of marbles and $3$ extra marbles.
Each bag has $n$ marbles inside.
<emptyline>
She ask: 'How many marbles are there altogether?'
<emptyline>
The pupil's say:
<emptyline>

Nia: $8n$
<emptyline>
Vijay: $3 + 5n$
<emptyline>
Sam: $8$
<emptyline>
Jo: $15n$
<emptyline>
Karen: $5 \times n + 3$
<emptyline>
Glyn: $(3 + 5)n$
<emptyline>
There are $88$ marbles altogether.
<emptyline>
Fill in one pupil's right answer to help you complete the equation.
<emptyline>
Solve the equation to find $n$, the the number of marbles in a bag.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The correct expressions that match this are $3 + 5n$ and $5 \times n + 3$.

Using the expression,

$
\begin{aligned}
5 \times n + 3  &= 88 \\\\
5n + 3          &= 88 \\\\
5n              &= 88 - 3 \\\\
5n              &= 85 \\\\
n               &= \dfrac {85} {5} \\\\
n               &= \dfrac {17 \times 5} {5} \\\\
n               &= \dfrac {17 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
n               &= 17
\end{aligned}
$

Number of marbles in each bag $= 17$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$17$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

How much does a pack of balloons cost?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How much does a pack of balloons cost?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
