<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

To make porridge, Goldilocks mixes $3$ bags of oats with $1$ bag containing $20\%$ wheat bran and $80\%$ oats. 
All the bags have the same volume. What percentage of the porridge mix is wheat bran?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">To make porridge, Goldilocks mixes $3$ bags of oats with $1$ bag containing $20\%$ wheat bran and $80\%$ oats. 
All the bags have the same volume. What percentage of the porridge mix is wheat bran?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the volume of each bag $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage}   &= \dfrac {\text{wheat bran}}{\text{total mix}} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {20 \% \text{ of } a} { 4a} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {0.2a} { 4a} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {20} { 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 5} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                    &= 5 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5 \%$

</div>
</div>

                    &= \dfrac {20 \% \text{ of } a} { 4a} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {0.2a} { 4a} \times 100 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {20} { 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {4} \\\\

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When a glass is full of water the total mass is $400 \ \text{g}$. 
When the glass is half full of water the total mass is $320 \ \text{g}$. Find the mass of the glass.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When a glass is full of water the total mass is $400 \ \text{g}$. 
When the glass is half full of water the total mass is $320 \ \text{g}$. Find the mass of the glass.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the mass of water $= w$

Let the mass of glass $= g$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
w + g                                              &= 400 \\\\
\dfrac{w}{2} + g                                   &= 320
\end{aligned}
$

We have $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them. Lets eliminate to reduce it to just one variable.

Let's subtract the second equation from the first to reduce it to one variable.

$
\begin{aligned}
w + g  - (\dfrac{w}{2} + g)     &= 400 - 320 \\\\
w + g  - \dfrac{w}{2} - g       &= 80 \\\\
\dfrac{w}{2}                    &= 400 - 320 \\\\
w                               &= 80 \times 2 \\\\
w                               &= 160 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $w$ in second equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
w + g                                              &= 400 \\\\
160 + g                                            &= 400 \\\\
g                                                  &= 400 - 160 \\\\
g                                                  &= 240 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$

Mass of glass $= 240 \ \text{g}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$240 \ \text{g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A ball is dropped and bounces up to a height that is $75\%$ of the height from which it
was dropped. It then bounces again to a height that is $75\%$ of the previous height and 
so on. How many bounces does it make before it bounces to a height that is less than 
$25\%$ of the original height?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A ball is dropped and bounces up to a height that is $75\%$ of the height from which it
was dropped. It then bounces again to a height that is $75\%$ of the previous height and 
so on. How many bounces does it make before it bounces to a height that is less than 
$25\%$ of the original height?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

| $25\%$    | Multiple                             |
| :--------------: | :--------------------------------------------------: |
| $ \dfrac{1}{4} $ | $ \dfrac{4}{4 \times 4} = \dfrac{4}{16} $            |
| $ \dfrac{1}{4} $ | $ \dfrac{16}{4 \times 16} = \dfrac{16}{64} $         |
| $ \dfrac{1}{4} $ | $ \dfrac{64}{4 \times 64} = \dfrac{64}{256} $        |
| $ \dfrac{1}{4} $ | $ \dfrac{256}{4 \times 256} = \dfrac{256}{1024} $    |

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Height after 1st bounce} &= \dfrac{3h}{4} \\\\
\text{Height after 2nd bounce} &= \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{3h}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{9h}{16}  \\\\
\text{Height after 3rd bounce} &= \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{9h}{16} \\\\
&= \dfrac{27h}{64} \\\\
\text{Height after 4th bounce} &= \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{27h}{64} \\\\
&= \dfrac{81h}{256} \\\\
\text{Height after 5th bounce} &= \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{81h}{256} \\\\
&= \dfrac{243h}{1024}
\end{aligned}$

Since $\dfrac{243}{1024} < \dfrac{256}{1024}$, the height is less than $25\%$ of the original height after the $5$th bounce.

Number of bounces $= 5$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

x  &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Fazal has $\pounds 2.60$ and Gareth has $\pounds 5.30$. Gareth gives Fazal some $5 \ \text{p}$ coins. 
Each boy now has the same amount of money. How many $5 \ \text{p}$ coins did Gareth give Fazal?

\end{aligned}
$

Number of coins $= 27$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If: $\dfrac{3}{x} \times \dfrac{4}{7} = \dfrac{3}{14}$ 

Calculate the value of $x$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If: $\dfrac{3}{x} \times \dfrac{4}{7} = \dfrac{3}{14}$ 
<emptyline>
Calculate the value of $x$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {x} \times \dfrac {4} {7}  &= \dfrac {3} {14} \\\\
\dfrac {3 \times 4} {x \times 7}      &= \dfrac {3} {14} \\\\
\dfrac {1} {x}                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 7} {3 \times 4 \times 14} \\\\
x                                     &= \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 14} {3 \times 7} \\\\
x                                     &= \dfrac {3 \times 4 \times 7 \times 2} {3 \times 7} \\\\
x                                     &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 4 \times \cancel {7} \times 2} {\cancel {3} \times \cancel {7}} \\\\  
x                                     &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

Write down an expression in algebra for the number of heads that remain in the field.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Half of the cows and one quarter of the horses leave the field. 
Write down an expression in algebra for the number of heads that remain in the field.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total number of heads}                        &= (x - \dfrac{x}{4}) + (y - \dfrac{y}{2}) + 1 \\\\
                                                    &= (\dfrac{x \times 4}{1 \times 4} - \dfrac{x \times 1}{4 \times 1}) + (\dfrac{y \times 2}{1 \times 2} - \dfrac{y \times 1}{2 \times 1}) +  1 \\\\
                                                    &= (\dfrac{4x}{4} - \dfrac{x}{4}) + (\dfrac{2y}{2} - \dfrac{y}{2}) +  1 \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac{4x - x}{4} + \dfrac{2y-y}{2} + 1 \\\\
                                                    &= \dfrac{3x}{4} + \dfrac{y}{2} + 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{3x}{4} + \dfrac{y}{2} + 1$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A "double-decker" sandwich has three slices of bread and two layers of filling. 
(e.g. bread/filling/bread/filling/bread). 
Each slice of bread has to be buttered on each side that is in contact with the filling. 
I make as many of these sandwiches as possible from a sliced loaf which has $22$ usable slices, 
excluding crusts which are not used. How many sides of bread do I have to butter?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A "double-decker" sandwich has three slices of bread and two layers of filling. 
(e.g. bread/filling/bread/filling/bread). 
Each slice of bread has to be buttered on each side that is in contact with the filling. 
I make as many of these sandwiches as possible from a sliced loaf which has $22$ usable slices, 
excluding crusts which are not used. How many sides of bread do I have to butter?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Each sandwich has $3$ slices of bread and $4$ buttered sides.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of sandwiches}    &= \dfrac{22}{3} \\\\
                               &= 7 \ \ \text{remainder} \ \ 1 \\\\
                               &\approx 7 \\\\
\text{Sides to butter}         &= 7 \times 4 \\\\
                               &= 28  
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$28$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jenn's fish tank was filled half way. She added $9 \ \text{gallons}$ of water to the tank and found that it was then $\dfrac{7}{8}$ full. 

How much water can the tank hold altogether?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jenn's fish tank was filled half way. She added $9 \ \text{gallons}$ of water to the tank and found that it was then $\dfrac{7}{8}$ full. 
<emptyline>
How much water can the tank hold altogether?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the capacity of the tank $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{a}{2} + 9                                    &=  \dfrac{7a}{8} \\\\
\dfrac{7a}{8} - \dfrac{a}{2}                        &= 9 \\\\
\dfrac{7a}{8} - \dfrac{4 \times a}{4 \times 2}      &= 9 \\\\
\dfrac{7a}{8} - \dfrac{4a}{8}                       &= 9 \\\\
\dfrac{7a - 4a}{8}                                  &= 9 \\\\
\dfrac{3a}{8}                                       &= 9 \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{9 \times 8}{3} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{3 \times 3 \times 8}{3} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{3 \times \cancel{3} \times 8}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
a                                                   &= 3 \times 8 \\\\
a                                                   &= 24 \ \text{gallons}
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 24 \ \text{gallons}$  
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24 \ \text{gallons}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two girls were on a sponsored walk from Pangbourne to Goring.

One of them gave up $5 \ \text{km}$ after she had passed the half-way check-point.

She was then $10 \ \text{km}$ from Goring.

How far apart are the towns?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two girls were on a sponsored walk from Pangbourne to Goring.
<emptyline>
One of them gave up $5 \ \text{km}$ after she had passed the half-way check-point.
<emptyline>
She was then $10 \ \text{km}$ from Goring.
<emptyline>
How far apart are the towns?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the distance between towns $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{d}{2} + 5 + 10                           &=  d \\\\
d - \dfrac{d}{2}                           &= 15 \\\\
\dfrac{d}{2}                                    &= 15 \\\\
d                                               &= 15 \times 2 \\\\
d                                               &= 30 \ \text{km}
\end{aligned}
$

Distance between two towns $= 30 \ \text{km}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$30 \ \text{km}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mrs Jones prints books.

![papers/north-london-collegiate-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q20-i00.png](/assets/papers/north-london-collegiate-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q20-i00.png "papers/north-london-collegiate-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q20-i00.png")

Jon pays $\pounds 4.35$ for his book, **including the cover**.

How many **pages** are in his book?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mrs Jones prints books.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Jon pays $\pounds 4.35$ for his book, **including the cover**.
<emptyline>
How many **pages** are in his book?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of pages $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3 \times a + 75 \ \text{p} &= \pounds 4.35 \\\\
3a + 75 \ \text{p} &= 435 \ \text{p} \\\\
3a + 75          &= 435 \\\\
3a               &= 435 - 75 \\\\
3a               &= 360 \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {360} {3} \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {120 \times 3} {3} \\\\
a                        &= \dfrac {120 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
a                        &= 120
\end{aligned}
$

Number of pages in the book = $120$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$120$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A boy ate $100$ cookies in $\text{five}$ days. Each day he ate $6$ more then the day before. How many cookies did he eat on the first day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A boy ate $100$ cookies in $\text{five}$ days. Each day he ate $6$ more then the day before. How many cookies did he eat on the first day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the cookies ate on first day $= c$

As per the question

$
\begin{aligned}
c + (c + 6) + (c + 12) + (c + 18) + (c + 24) &= 100 \\\\
5c + 60  &= 100 \\\\
5c       &= 100 - 60 \\\\
5c       &= 40 \\\\
c       &= \dfrac{40}{5} \\\\
c       &= \dfrac{8 \times 5}{5} \\\\
c       &= \dfrac{8 \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
c       &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

Cookies he ate on first day $= 8$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Three ducks and two ducklings weigh $32 \ \text{kg}$. Four ducks and three ducklings weigh $44 \ \text{kg}$. All ducks weigh the same as each other and all ducklings weigh the same as each other.

What is the weight of two ducks and one duckling?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Three ducks and two ducklings weigh $32 \ \text{kg}$. Four ducks and three ducklings weigh $44 \ \text{kg}$. All ducks weigh the same as each other and all ducklings weigh the same as each other.
<emptyline>
What is the weight of two ducks and one duckling?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of one duck $= d$

Let the weight of one duckling $= k$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
3d + 2k &= 32 \\\\
4d + 3k &= 44
\end{aligned}
$

We have got $2$ variables and we have $2$ equations to solve them.
Let's use elimination to reduce it to just one variable.

Let's multiply the first equation by $3$:

$
\begin{aligned}
(3d + 2k) \times 3 &= 32 \times 3 \\\\
9d + 6k &= 96
\end{aligned}
$

Let's multiply the second equation by $2$:

$
\begin{aligned}
(4d + 3k) \times 2 &= 44 \times 2 \\\\
8d + 6k &= 88
\end{aligned}
$

Now subtract the second from the first:

$
\begin{aligned}
(9d + 6k) - (8d + 6k) &= 96 - 88 \\\\
9d + 6k - 8d - 6k     &= 96 - 88 \\\\
d                       &= 8 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Substituting the value of $d$ in first equation,

$
\begin{aligned}
3d + 2k &= 32 \\\\
3 \times 8 + 2k &= 32 \\\\
24 + 2k &= 32 \\\\
2k &= 32 - 24 \\\\
2k &= 8 \\\\
k &= \dfrac{8}{2} \\\\
k &= 4 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Weight 2 ducks and 1 duckling} &= 2d + k  \\\\
&= 2 \times 8 + 4 \\\\
&= 16 + 4 \\\\
&= 20 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight $= 20 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

If $(6 \ \spadesuit \ n) \ \spadesuit \ 10 = 8$, what is the number $n?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $(6 \ \spadesuit \ n) \ \spadesuit \ 10 = 8$, what is the number $n?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$\begin{aligned}
(6 \ \spadesuit \ n) \ \spadesuit \ 10 &= 8 \\\\
(2 \times 6 - n) \ \spadesuit \ 10 &= 8 \\\\
(12 - n) \ \spadesuit \ 10 &= 8 \\\\
2 \times (12 - n) - 10 &= 8 \\\\
24 - 2n - 10 &= 8 \\\\
14 - 2n &= 8 \\\\
2n &= 14 - 8 \\\\
2n &= 6 \\\\
n &= \dfrac{6}{2} \\\\
n &= 3
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3$

\begin{aligned}
9 \div a                                 &= 36 \\\\

a                                        &= \dfrac {9} {9 \times 4} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac{\cancel{9}} {\cancel{9} \times 4} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {1} {4}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Robert enjoyed his summer holiday. He spent half of it working in a music store. He spent half of the remaining time reading and relaxing at home, and, after spending $4$ days at a friend's house, he had exactly $2$ weeks left to attend a summer camp. How long (in days) was his summer holiday ?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Robert enjoyed his summer holiday. He spent half of it working in a music store. He spent half of the remaining time reading and relaxing at home, and, after spending $4$ days at a friend's house, he had exactly $2$ weeks left to attend a summer camp. How long (in days) was his summer holiday ?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of days in summer holiday $= d$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{1}{2} \times d + \dfrac{1}{2} \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times d + 4 + 14 &= d \\\\
\dfrac{d}{2} + \dfrac{d}{4}  + 18                              &= d \\\\
d - \dfrac{d}{2} - \dfrac{d}{4}                           &= 18 \\\\
\dfrac{4 \times d}{4} - \dfrac{2 \times d}{2 \times 2} - \dfrac{d}{4} &= 18 \\\\
\dfrac{4d}{4} - \dfrac{2d}{4} - \dfrac{d}{4} &= 18 \\\\
\dfrac{4d - 2d - d}{4}                           &= 18 \\\\
\dfrac{d}{4}                            &= 18 \\\\
d                                       &= 18 \times 4 \\\\
d                                       &= 72 \ \text{days}
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 72 \ \text{days}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$72 \ \text{days}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

![papers/oundle-school/2008/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i00.png](/assets/papers/oundle-school/2008/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i00.png "papers/oundle-school/2008/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i00.png")   ![papers/oundle-school/2008/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i01.png](/assets/papers/oundle-school/2008/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i01.png "papers/oundle-school/2008/sample-paper-1/s01-q22-i01.png")

As his hobby, Fred builds $3$-legged stools and $4$-legged tables. Last month he used $72$ legs and he built $3$ more stools than tables. How many stools and how many tables did he build ? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%image%   %image%
<emptyline>
As his hobby, Fred builds $3$-legged stools and $4$-legged tables. Last month he used $72$ legs and he built $3$ more stools than tables. How many stools and how many tables did he build ? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of tables $= t$

Number of stools $= t + 3$

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times t + 3 \times (t + 3)           &= 72 \\\\
4t + 3t + 9                             &= 72 \\\\
7t + 9                                  &= 72 \\\\
7t                                      &= 72 - 9 \\\\
7t                                      &= 63 \\\\
t                                       &= \dfrac{63}{7} \\\\
t                                       &= \dfrac{9 \times 7}{7} \\\\
t                                       &= \dfrac{9 \times \cancel{7}}{\cancel{7}} \\\\
t                                       &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of tables}                 &= 9 \\\\
\text{Numbers of stools}                &= t + 3 \\\\
                                        &= 9 + 3 \\\\
                                        &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

stools $=$ $12$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

tables $=$ $9$

</div>
</div>

7t                                      &= 63 \\\\

$
<emptyline>

$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Adam, Ben and Carl are weighing themselves.

Together, Adam and Ben weigh $102 \ \text{kg}$.

Ben and Carl weigh $97 \ \text{kg}$.

Adam and Carl weigh $93 \ \text{kg}$.

What is their total weight in $\text{kg}?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Adam, Ben and Carl are weighing themselves.
<emptyline>
Together, Adam and Ben weigh $102 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
Ben and Carl weigh $97 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
Adam and Carl weigh $93 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
What is their total weight in $\text{kg}?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of Adam $= a$

Let the weight of Ben $= b$

Let the weight of Carl $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + b &= 102 \\\\
b + c &= 97 \\\\
a + c &= 93
\end{aligned}
$

Let's add all three equations together.

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + b) + (b + c) + (a + c) &= 102 + 97 + 93 \\\\
a + b + b + c + a + c       &= 292 \\\\
2a + 2b + 2c                &= 292 \\\\
2(a + b + c)                &= 292 \\\\
a + b + c                   &= \dfrac{292}{2} \\\\
a + b + c                   &= \dfrac{2 \times 146}{2} \\\\
a + b + c                   &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times 146}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
a + b + c                   &= 146 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Total Weight $= 146 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$146 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$a$ and $b$ are two *different* positive whole numbers which make the following statement true

$3a + 2b = 30$ 

Find two possible pairs of numbers which make the statement true.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$a$ and $b$ are two *different* positive whole numbers which make the following statement true
<emptyline>
$3a + 2b = 30$ 
<emptyline>
Find two possible pairs of numbers which make the statement true.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

For $a =10$,

$
\begin{aligned}
3a + 2b                             &= 30 \\\\
3 \times 10 + 2b                    &= 30 \\\\
30 + 2b                             &= 30 \\\\
2b                                  &= 30 - 30 \\\\
2b                                  &= 0 \\\\
b                                   &= 0
\end{aligned}
$

For $a= 2$,

$
\begin{aligned}
3a + 2b                             &= 30 \\\\
3 \times 2 + 2b                     &= 30 \\\\
2b                                  &= 30 - 6 \\\\
2b                                  &= 24 \\\\
b                                   &= \dfrac {24} {2} \\\\
b                                   &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
b                                   &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$a = 10,b = 0 \\
a = 2,b = 12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$p$ and $q$ are whole numbers. $p$ is $150$ greater than $q$.

The following statement is also true
                       
$\large p + q = 1000$

Calculate the numbers $p$ and $q$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$p$ and $q$ are whole numbers. $p$ is $150$ greater than $q$.
<emptyline>
The following statement is also true
<emptyline>
$\large p + q = 1000$
<emptyline>
Calculate the numbers $p$ and $q$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$p = 150 + q$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
p + q         &= 1000 \\\\
150 + q + q   &= 1000 \\\\
150 + 2 q     &= 1000 \\\\
2 q           &= 1000 - 150 \\\\
2 q           &= 850 \\\\
q             &= \dfrac {850} {2} \\\\
q             &= \dfrac {425 \times 2} {2} \\\\
q             &= \dfrac {425 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
q             &= 425
\end{aligned}
$

\begin{aligned}

p  &= 150 + 425 \\\\
p  &= 575
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two workers are paid a total of $\pounds 506$ by their employer. If one is paid $20\%$ more than the other, how much do they each earn? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two workers are paid a total of $\pounds 506$ by their employer. If one is paid $20\%$ more than the other, how much do they each earn? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first worker earns $= a$

Second worker earns $= 100 + 20 = 120 \% \times a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 120 \% \times a                                         &= 506 \\\\
a + \dfrac{120}{100} \times a                                         &= 506 \\\\
a + 1.2a                                                 &= 506 \\\\
2.2a                                                             &= 506 \\\\
a                                                                &= \dfrac{506}{2.2} \\\\
a                                                                &= \dfrac{506 \times 10}{2.2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                                                &= \dfrac{506 \times 10}{22} \\\\
a                                                                &= \dfrac{11 \times 2 \times 23 \times 10}{11 \times 2} \\\\
a                                                                &= \dfrac{\cancel{11} \times \cancel{2} \times 23 \times 10}{\cancel{11} \times \cancel{2}} \\\\   
a                                                                &= \pounds 230 \\\\
\text{First worker}                                                &= \pounds 230 \\\\
\text{Second worker}                                                &= 506 - 230 \\\\
                                                                            &= \pounds 276
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

$\pounds 230$

**Question**

I think of a number, multiply it by six, then subtract nine. The result is thirty-three. 

What was the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned}

a                                   &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {6}} {\cancel {6}} \\\\
a                                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 7$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned}
2100 \times a &= 84000 \\\\
a             &= \dfrac {84000} {2100} \\\\
a             &= \dfrac {21 \times 4 \times 1000} {21 \times 100} \\\\
a             &= \dfrac {\cancel {21} \times 4 \times 10 \cancel {00}} {\cancel {21} \times 1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
a             &= 4 \times 10 \\\\
a             &= 40
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Albert has five times as many apples as Bertie. If Albert gives Bertie $26$ apples, they will each have the same number of apples.

How many apples do they have in total between them? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Albert has five times as many apples as Bertie. If Albert gives Bertie $26$ apples, they will each have the same number of apples.
<emptyline>
How many apples do they have in total between them? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of apples Bertie has $= a$

Number of apples Albert has $= 5a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5a - 26                         &= a + 26 \\\\
5a - a                          &= 26 + 26 \\\\
4a                              &= 52 \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac{52}{4} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac{13 \times 4}{4} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac{13 \times \cancel{4}}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
a                               &= 13 \\\\
\text{Total number of apples}   &= a + 5a \\\\
                                &= 6a \\\\
                                &= 6 \times 13 \\\\
                                &= 78 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$78$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

I think of a number, add five and then divide by two. My answer is $-19$.

What number was I thinking of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

a                               &= -38 - 5 \\\\
a                               &= -43
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Twice a number added to half of the same number gives $250$.

What was the number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Twice a number added to half of the same number gives $250$.
<emptyline>
What was the number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 a + \dfrac{a} {2}                                &= 250 \\\\
\dfrac {2 a \times 2} {2} + \dfrac{a} {2} &= 250 \\\\
\dfrac{4 a} {2} + \dfrac {a} {2}                   &= 250 \\\\
\dfrac{4 a + a} {2}                                &= 250 \\\\
\dfrac{5a} {2}                                     &= 250 \\\\
a                                                  &= \dfrac {250 \times 2} {5} \\\\
a                                                  &= \dfrac {50 \times 5 \times 2} {5} \\\\
a                                                  &= \dfrac {50 \times \cancel {5} \times 2} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a                                                  &= 50 \times 2 \\\\
a                                                  &= 100
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

When eighteen is added to twice the square of a number, the result is $50$.

What are the two possible starting numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When eighteen is added to twice the square of a number, the result is $50$.
<emptyline>
What are the two possible starting numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
18 + 2a ^ 2                   &= 50 \\\\
2a ^ 2                        &= 50 - 18 \\\\
2a ^ 2                        &= 32 \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= \dfrac {32} {2} \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= \dfrac {16 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= 16 \\\\
a                               &= \sqrt{16} \\\\
a                               &= + 4 \text{ or } -4
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

When three tenths of a number is subtracted from ninety-five hundreds of the same number, the result is $1.95$.

What was the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When three tenths of a number is subtracted from ninety-five hundreds of the same number, the result is $1.95$.
<emptyline>
What was the original number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {95 a} {100} - \dfrac {3 a} {10}                       &= 1.95 \\\\
0.95 a - 0.3 a                                               &= 1.95 \\\\
0.65a                                                        &= 1.95 \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {1.95} {0.65} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {1.95 \times 100} {0.65 \times 100} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {195} {65} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {13 \times 3 \times 5} {13 \times 5} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 13 \times 3 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {13} \times \cancel {5}} \\\\
a                                                            &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$a$ and $b$ are two *different, positive* whole numbers which make the following statement true

$4a + 3b = 48$


Find two possible pairs of numbers which make the statement above true.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$a$ and $b$ are two *different, positive* whole numbers which make the following statement true
<emptyline>
$4a + 3b = 48$
<emptyline>

Find two possible pairs of numbers which make the statement above true.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's try for $a =12$

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 12 + 3b                                &= 48 \\\\
48 + 3b                                         &= 48 \\\\
3b                                              &= 48 - 48 \\\\
b                                               &= 0
\end{aligned}
$

Let's try for $a =3$

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 3 + 3b                                 &= 48 \\\\
12 + 3b                                         &= 48 \\\\
3b                                              &= 48 - 12 \\\\
3b                                              &= 36 \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {36} {3} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {12 \times 3} {3} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
b                                               &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$a=12, b=0 \\ a=3, b=12$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let's try for $a =12$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 12 + 3b                                &= 48 \\\\
48 + 3b                                         &= 48 \\\\
3b                                              &= 48 - 48 \\\\
b                                               &= 0
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's try for $a =3$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 3 + 3b                                 &= 48 \\\\
12 + 3b                                         &= 48 \\\\
3b                                              &= 48 - 12 \\\\
3b                                              &= 36 \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {36} {3} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {12 \times 3} {3} \\\\
b                                               &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
b                                               &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A large sack holds $20\%$ more potatoes than a small sack. If one large sack and one small sack together contain $77$ potatoes, how many potatoes does each sack hold?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A large sack holds $20\%$ more potatoes than a small sack. If one large sack and one small sack together contain $77$ potatoes, how many potatoes does each sack hold?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the potatoes in small sack $= a$

Potatoes in large sack $= 100 + 20 = 120 \% \times a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a + 120 \% \times a                              &= 77 \\\\
a + \dfrac{120}{100} \times a                     &= 77 \\\\
a + 1.2a                       &= 77 \\\\
2.2a                       &= 77 \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{77}{2.2} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{77 \times 10}{2.2 \times 10} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{770}{22} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{7 \times 11 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 11} \\\\
a                                                   &= \dfrac{7 \times \cancel{11} \times \cancel 2 \times 5}{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{11}} \\\\
a                                                   &= 35 \\\\
\text{Potatoes in small sack}                     &= 35 \\\\
\text{Potatoes in large sack}                       &= 77 - 35 \\\\
                                                    &= 42
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

I think of a number, multiply it by six, then subtract nine. The result is thirty-three. 

What was the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number, multiply it by six, then subtract nine. The result is thirty-three. 
<emptyline>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 \times a - 9                      &= 33 \\\\
6a                          &= 33 + 9 \\\\
6a                          &= 42 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {42} {6} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {7 \times 6} {6} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {6}} {\cancel {6}} \\\\
a                                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= 7$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sophia did push-ups every day for $7$ days. Each day after the first day, she did $5$ more push-ups than the day before. In total she did $175$ push-ups. How many push-ups did Sophia do on the last day?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sophia did push-ups every day for $7$ days. Each day after the first day, she did $5$ more push-ups than the day before. In total she did $175$ push-ups. How many push-ups did Sophia do on the last day?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of push-ups on the first day $= p$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
p + (p + 5) + (p + 10) + (p + 15) + (p + 20) + (p + 25) + (p + 30)  &= 175 \\\\
7p + 105                                                            &= 175 \\\\
7p                                                                  &= 175 - 105 \\\\
7p                                                                  &= 70 \\\\
p                                                                   &= \dfrac{70}{7} \\\\
p                                                                   &= \dfrac{10 \times 7}{7} \\\\
p                                                                   &= \dfrac{10 \times \cancel{7}}{\cancel{7}} \\\\
p                                                                   &= 10 \\\\
\text{Number of pushups on the last day}                                &= p + 30 \\\\
                                                                    &= 10 + 30 \\\\
                                                                    &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I think of a number, add five and then divide by two. My answer is $-17$.

What number was I thinking of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number, add five and then divide by two. My answer is $-17$.
<emptyline>
What number was I thinking of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 5) \div 2                  &= -17 \\\\
\dfrac{a + 5}{2}     &= -17 \\\\
a + 5                           &= -17 \times 2 \\\\
a + 5                           &= -34 \\\\
a                               &= -34 - 5 \\\\
a                               &= -39
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$-39$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Twice a number added to half of the same number gives $90$.
<emptyline>
What was the number?
</code></pre>

$
\begin{aligned}

**Question**

When two is added to twice the square of a number, the result is $100$.

What are the two possible starting numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When two is added to twice the square of a number, the result is $100$.
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 + 2a ^ 2                    &= 100 \\\\
2a ^ 2                        &= 100 - 2 \\\\
2a ^ 2                        &= 98 \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= \dfrac {98} {2} \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= \dfrac {49 \times 2} {2} \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= \dfrac {49 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
a ^ 2                           &= 49 \\\\
a                               &= \sqrt {49} \\\\
a                               &= + 7 \text{ or } -7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

When three tenths of a number is subtracted from ninety-five hundreds of the same number, the result is $1.95$.

What was the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When three tenths of a number is subtracted from ninety-five hundreds of the same number, the result is $1.95$.
<emptyline>
What was the original number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {95 a} {100} - \dfrac {3 a} {10}                       &= 1.95 \\\\
0.95 a - 0.3 a                                               &= 1.95 \\\\
0.65a                                                        &= 1.95 \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {1.95} {0.65} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {1.95 \times 100} {0.65 \times 100} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {195} {65} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {13 \times 3 \times 5} {13 \times 5} \\\\
a                                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 13 \times 3 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {13} \times \cancel {5}} \\\\
a                                                            &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$-16.25$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$3x - 9 = \dfrac{1}{4}x + \dfrac{1}{2}$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3x - 9 = \dfrac{1}{4}x + \dfrac{1}{2}$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
3x - 9                                              &= \dfrac {1} {4}x + \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
3x - \dfrac {x} {4}                                 &= \dfrac {1} {2} + 9 \\\\
\dfrac {3x \times 4} {1 \times 4} - \dfrac {x} {4}  &= \dfrac {1} {2} + \dfrac {9 \times 2} {1 \times 2} \\\\
\dfrac {12x} {4} - \dfrac {x} {4}                   &= \dfrac {1} {2} + \dfrac {18} {2} \\\\
\dfrac {12x - x} {4}                                &= \dfrac {1 + 18} {2} \\\\
\dfrac {11 x} {4}                                   &= \dfrac {19} {2} \\\\
x                                                   &= \dfrac {19 \times 4} {2 \times 11} \\\\
x                                                   &= \dfrac {19 \times 2 \times 2} {2 \times 11} \\\\
x                                                   &= \dfrac {19 \times 2 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2} \times 11} \\\\
x                                                   &= \dfrac {19 \times 2} {11} \\\\
x                                                   &= \dfrac {38} {11} \\\\
x                                                   &= 3 \dfrac {5} {11}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

Five times a number is eight less than three times the number.

Find the number.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

a                                   &= -4       
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John thought of a number. He subtracted ten and then divided by three.

The result was the same as when multiplying the original number by two.

What number did John think of?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John thought of a number. He subtracted ten and then divided by three.
<emptyline>
The result was the same as when multiplying the original number by two.
<emptyline>
What number did John think of?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number John thought of $= a$

As per the the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a - 10) \div 3                                                &= 2a \\\\
\dfrac{a - 10}{3}                                              &= 2a \\\\
a- 10                                                          &= 3 \times 2a \\\\
a- 10                                                          &= 6a \\\\
6a - a                                                       &= -10 \\\\
5a                                                             &= -10 \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac{-10}{5} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac{-2 \times 5}{5} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac{-2 \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
a                                                              &= -2
\end{aligned}
$

Number $= -2$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The width of a rectangle is four times its height. 

The perimeter is $12 \ \text{cm}$.

Find the dimensions of the rectangle.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The width of a rectangle is four times its height. 
<emptyline>
The perimeter is $12 \ \text{cm}$.
<emptyline>
Find the dimensions of the rectangle.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Perimeter of rectangle} = 2 \times (\text{length} + \text{width})$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the height of rectangle $= h$

Width of rectangle $= 4h$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 \times (4h + h)          &= 12 \\\\
2 \times 5h                      &= 12 \\\\
10h                                &= 12 \\\\
h                                  &= \dfrac{12}{10} \\\\
h                                  &= 1.2 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Height}                      &= 1.2 \ \text{cm} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

An iPhone used to cost $\pounds 500$. Since Brexit the price has increased by $22\%$. How much does it cost now? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An iPhone used to cost $\pounds 500$. Since Brexit the price has increased by $22\%$. How much does it cost now? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the iPhone cost increased by $22 \%$, then the new cost will be $100 + 22 = 122 \%$ of the previous price. 

Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {iPhone cost after increase}    &= \dfrac {122} {100} \times 500 \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {122 \times 500} {100} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {122 \times 5 \times 100}{100} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {122 \times 5 \times \cancel{100}}{\cancel{100}} \\\\
                                      &= 122 \times 5 \\\\
                                      &= \pounds 610 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 610$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$a$ and $b$ are two different, positive whole numbers which make the following statement true

$3a + 2b = 48$

Find two possible pairs of numbers which make the statement above true.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\begin{aligned}

\end{aligned}
$

2b                                              &= 48 - 12 \\\\
2b                                              &= 36 \\\\
b                                               &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
6900 \div a          &= 23000 \\\\

a                    &= \dfrac{3 \times 2300}{10 \times 2300} \\\\
a                    &= \dfrac{3 \times \cancel{2300}}{10 \times \cancel{2300}} \\\\
a                    &= \dfrac{3}{10} \\\\
a                    &= 0.3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

I think of a number, multiply it by six, then subtract nine. The result is minus thirty nine. 

What was the original number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I think of a number, multiply it by six, then subtract nine. The result is minus thirty nine. 
<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
6 \times a - 9                                          &= -39 \\\\
6a                                              &= -39 + 9 \\\\
6a                                              &= -30 \\\\
a                                                       &= \dfrac{-30}{6} \\\\
a                                                       &= \dfrac{-5 \times 6}{6} \\\\
a                                                       &= \dfrac{-5 \times \cancel{6}}{\cancel{6}} \\\\
a                                                       &= -5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}

2a                                                      &= -3 + 12 \\\\

a                                                               &= \dfrac{9}{2}
\end{aligned}
$

$3x -7 = 5x + 7$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3x -7 = 5x + 7$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
3x - 7                  &= 5x + 7 \\\\
5x - 3x         &= - 7 - 7 \\\\
2x                     &= -14 \\\\
x                               &= -\dfrac {14} {2} \\\\
x                               &= - \dfrac {7 \times 2} {2} \\\\
x                               &= - \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
x                           &= -7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

$\dfrac{1}{2}x - 3 = \dfrac{x}{3} + 5$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac{1}{2}x - 3 = \dfrac{x}{3} + 5$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{1}{2}x - 3                                                   &= \dfrac{x}{3} + 5 \\\\
\dfrac{x}{2} - \dfrac{x}{3}                                         &= 5 + 3 \\\\
\dfrac{x \times 3}{2 \times 3} - \dfrac{x \times 2}{3 \times 2}     &= 8 \\\\
\dfrac{3x}{6} - \dfrac{2x}{6}                                       &= 8 \\\\
\dfrac{3x - 2x}{6}                                                  &= 8 \\\\
\dfrac{x}{6}                                                        &= 8 \\\\
x                                                                   &= 8 \times 6 \\\\
x                                                                   &= 48
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
